    · rintro (⟨a, ha, h⟩ | ⟨a, ha, h⟩)
      · exact ⟨a, ha, Or.inl h⟩
      · exact ⟨a, ha, Or.inr h⟩
  have hA0E : ∀ x ∈ A0, x ∈ E := by
    intro x hx
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hx with ⟨e, he, rfl⟩
    exact e.property
  have hdisj : Disjoint A0 (A0.image r) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro x hx0 hxr
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hxr with ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact (hE y).mp (hA0E y hy) (hA0E (r y) hx0)
  have hRcard : (A0.image r).card = A0.card := by
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective]
    exact hr.injective
  let U : Finset α := A0 ∪ A0.image r
  have hUcard : U.card = 2 * A.card := by
    dsimp [U]
    rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisj, hRcard, hA0card]
    omega
  have hUsub : U ⊆ Finset.univ.filter (fun x : α => c x ∈ V) := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hx with hx | hx
    · apply Finset.mem_union_left
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    · rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hx with ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      apply Finset.mem_union_right
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  have hfiltercard :
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : α => c x ∈ V)).card = 4 * V.card := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_card_fiberwise_eq_card_filter (Finset.univ : Finset α) V c]
    calc
      (∑ b ∈ V, (Finset.univ.filter fun x : α => c x = b).card) =
          ∑ b ∈ V, 4 := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro b hb
            exact hfour b
      _ = 4 * V.card := by simp [Nat.mul_comm]
  have hcount : 2 * A.card ≤ 4 * V.card := by
    rw [← hUcard, ← hfiltercard]
    exact Finset.card_le_card hUsub
  rw [hslots]
  change A.card ≤ (V ×ˢ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2))).card
  rw [Finset.card_product, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  omega

theorem endpoint_slot_bijection{α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    (r : α → α) (c : α → β) (hr : Function.Involutive r)
    (hfour : ∀ b, (Finset.univ.filter fun x : α => c x = b).card = 4)
    (E : Finset α) (hE : ∀ x, x ∈ E ↔ r x ∉ E) :
    ∃ f : {x : α // x ∈ E} → β × Fin 2, Function.Bijective f ∧
      ∀ e, (f e).1 = c e.1 ∨ (f e).1 = c (r e.1) := by
  classical
  let slots : {x : α // x ∈ E} → Finset (β × Fin 2) :=
    fun e => endpointSlots r c e.1
  obtain ⟨f, hfinj, hfmem⟩ :=
    (Finset.all_card_le_biUnion_card_iff_exists_injective slots).mp
      (endpointSlots_hall r c hr hfour E hE)
  have hcard : Fintype.card {x : α // x ∈ E} = Fintype.card (β × Fin 2) :=
    edge_representative_card_eq_slots r c hr hfour E hE
  have hbij : Function.Bijective f :=
    (Fintype.bijective_iff_injective_and_card f).2 ⟨hfinj, hcard⟩
  refine ⟨f, hbij, ?_⟩
  intro e
  have he := hfmem e
  simp only [slots, endpointSlots, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_image,
    Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at he
  rcases he with ⟨k, hk⟩ | ⟨k, hk⟩
  · left
    exact (congrArg Prod.fst hk).symm
  · right
    exact (congrArg Prod.fst hk).symm

theorem exists_balanced_dart_orientation{α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    (r : α → α) (c : α → β) (hr : Function.Involutive r) (hfix : ∀ x, r x ≠ x)
    (hfour : ∀ b, (Finset.univ.filter fun x : α => c x = b).card = 4) :
    ∃ T : Finset α, (∀ x, x ∈ T ↔ r x ∉ T) ∧
      ∀ b, (T.filter fun x => c x = b).card = 2 := by
  classical
  let q := Fintype.equivFin α
  let E : Finset α := Finset.univ.filter (fun x => q x < q (r x))
  have hE_mem (x : α) : (x ∈ E) ↔ q x < q (r x) := by
    simp only [E, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  have hqne (x : α) : q x ≠ q (r x) := by
    intro h
    apply hfix x
    exact q.injective h.symm
  have hExor (x : α) : (x ∈ E) ↔ r x ∉ E := by
    rw [hE_mem, hE_mem, hr x]
    have hn := hqne x
    omega
  obtain ⟨f, hfbij, hfend⟩ := endpoint_slot_bijection r c hr hfour E hExor
  let d : {x : α // x ∈ E} → α := fun e =>
    if (f e).1 = c e.1 then e.1 else r e.1
  have hcd (e : {x : α // x ∈ E}) : c (d e) = (f e).1 := by
    unfold d
    split_ifs with h
    · exact h.symm
    · rcases hfend e with he | he
      · exact False.elim (h he)
      · exact he.symm
  have hd_cases (e : {x : α // x ∈ E}) : d e = e.1 ∨ d e = r e.1 := by
    unfold d
    split_ifs
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr rfl
  have hd_inj : Function.Injective d := by
    intro e e' heq
    unfold d at heq
    by_cases he : (f e).1 = c e.1
    · by_cases he' : (f e').1 = c e'.1
      · rw [if_pos he, if_pos he'] at heq
        exact Subtype.ext heq
      · rw [if_pos he, if_neg he'] at heq
        exfalso
        have herE : r e'.1 ∈ E := by
          rw [← heq]
          exact e.2
        exact (hExor e'.1).mp e'.2 herE
    · by_cases he' : (f e').1 = c e'.1
      · rw [if_neg he, if_pos he'] at heq
        exfalso
        have herE : r e.1 ∈ E := by
          rw [heq]
          exact e'.2
        exact (hExor e.1).mp e.2 herE
      · rw [if_neg he, if_neg he'] at heq
        exact Subtype.ext (hr.injective heq)
  let T : Finset α := Finset.univ.image d
  have hT_mem (x : α) : x ∈ T ↔ ∃ e : {x : α // x ∈ E}, d e = x := by
    simp only [T, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  have hT_pair (e : {x : α // x ∈ E}) :
      (e.1 ∈ T ↔ d e = e.1) ∧ (r e.1 ∈ T ↔ d e = r e.1) := by
    constructor
    · constructor
      · intro heT
        obtain ⟨e', he'⟩ := (hT_mem e.1).mp heT
        rcases hd_cases e' with hd' | hd'
        · have heq : e' = e := Subtype.ext (hd'.symm.trans he')
          simpa only [heq] using he'
        · have heval : e'.1 = r e.1 := by
            calc
              e'.1 = r (r e'.1) := (hr e'.1).symm
              _ = r e.1 := congrArg r (hd'.symm.trans he')
          exfalso
          have : r e.1 ∈ E := heval ▸ e'.2
          exact (hExor e.1).mp e.2 this
      · intro he
        exact (hT_mem e.1).mpr ⟨e, he⟩
    · constructor
      · intro heT
        obtain ⟨e', he'⟩ := (hT_mem (r e.1)).mp heT
        rcases hd_cases e' with hd' | hd'
        · exfalso
          have : r e.1 ∈ E := (hd'.symm.trans he') ▸ e'.2
          exact (hExor e.1).mp e.2 this
        · have heq : e' = e := Subtype.ext (hr.injective (hd'.symm.trans he'))
          simpa only [heq] using he'
      · intro he
        exact (hT_mem (r e.1)).mpr ⟨e, he⟩
  have hxor_rep (e : {x : α // x ∈ E}) : e.1 ∈ T ↔ r e.1 ∉ T := by
    rcases hd_cases e with hd | hd
    · have heT : e.1 ∈ T := (hT_pair e).1.mpr hd
      have hreT : r e.1 ∉ T := by
        intro h
        have hde := (hT_pair e).2.mp h
        exact hfix e.1 (hd.symm.trans hde).symm
      exact iff_of_true heT hreT
    · have heT : e.1 ∉ T := by
        intro h
        have hde := (hT_pair e).1.mp h
        exact hfix e.1 (hde.symm.trans hd).symm
      have hreT : r e.1 ∈ T := (hT_pair e).2.mpr hd
      exact iff_of_false heT (fun h => h hreT)
  have hTxor (x : α) : x ∈ T ↔ r x ∉ T := by
    by_cases hx : x ∈ E
    · exact hxor_rep ⟨x, hx⟩
    · have hrxE : r x ∈ E := by
        apply (hExor (r x)).mpr
        simpa only [hr x] using hx
      have hy := hxor_rep ⟨r x, hrxE⟩
      have hy' : r x ∈ T ↔ x ∉ T := by
        simpa only [hr x] using hy
      constructor
      · intro hxT hrxT
        exact (hy'.mp hrxT) hxT
      · intro hrxnot
        by_contra hxnot
        exact hrxnot (hy'.mpr hxnot)
  refine ⟨T, hTxor, ?_⟩
  intro b
  let S : Finset {x : α // x ∈ E} :=
    Finset.univ.filter (fun e => c (d e) = b)
  have hfilter : T.filter (fun x => c x = b) = S.image d := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      have hxT := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).1
      have hcx := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2
      obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := (hT_mem x).mp hxT
      apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
      refine ⟨e, ?_, he⟩
      apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
      refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ e, ?_⟩
      rw [he]
      exact hcx
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨e, heS, he⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
      apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
      constructor
      · exact (hT_mem x).mpr ⟨e, he⟩
      · have hce := (Finset.mem_filter.mp heS).2
        rw [← he]
        exact hce
  calc
    (T.filter fun x => c x = b).card = (S.image d).card := congrArg Finset.card hfilter
    _ = S.card := Finset.card_image_of_injective S hd_inj
    _ = (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2)).card := by
      apply Finset.card_bij (fun e _ => (f e).2)
      · intro e he
        exact Finset.mem_univ _
      · intro e₁ he₁ e₂ he₂ hsecond
        apply hfbij.1
        apply Prod.ext
        · have hc₁ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp he₁).2
          have hc₂ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp he₂).2
          calc
            (f e₁).1 = c (d e₁) := (hcd e₁).symm
            _ = b := hc₁
            _ = c (d e₂) := hc₂.symm
            _ = (f e₂).1 := hcd e₂
        · exact hsecond
      · intro i hi
        obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hfbij.2 (b, i)
        refine ⟨e, ?_, ?_⟩
        · apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
          refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ e, ?_⟩
          calc
            c (d e) = (f e).1 := hcd e
            _ = b := congrArg Prod.fst he
        · exact congrArg Prod.snd he
    _ = 2 := by
      simp only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]

theorem balanced_orientation_has_matching{α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    (r : α → α) (c : α → β) (hr : Function.Involutive r)
    (hfour : ∀ b, (Finset.univ.filter fun x : α => c x = b).card = 4)
    (T : Finset α) (horient : ∀ x, x ∈ T ↔ r x ∉ T)
    (hout : ∀ b, (T.filter fun x => c x = b).card = 2) :
    ∃ M : Finset α, M ⊆ T ∧
      (∀ b, (M.filter fun x => c x = b).card = 1) ∧
      ∀ b, (M.filter fun x => c (r x) = b).card = 1 := by
  classical
  have hin : ∀ b, (T.filter fun x => c (r x) = b).card = 2 := by
    intro b
    let U : Finset α := (Finset.univ.filter fun x => c x = b) \ T
    have hcard : (T.filter fun x => c (r x) = b).card = U.card := by
      apply Finset.card_bij' (fun x _ => r x) (fun x _ => r x)
      · intro x hx
        simp only [U, Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hx ⊢
        exact ⟨hx.2, (horient x).mp hx.1⟩
      · intro x hx
        simp only [U, Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hx ⊢
        constructor
        · rw [horient]
          simpa only [hr x] using hx.2
        · simpa only [hr x] using hx.1
      · intro x hx
        exact hr x
      · intro x hx
        exact hr x
    rw [hcard]
    have hinter : T ∩ (Finset.univ.filter fun x => c x = b) = T.filter fun x => c x = b := by
      ext x
      simp only [Finset.mem_inter, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    change ((Finset.univ.filter fun x => c x = b) \ T).card = 2
    rw [Finset.card_sdiff, hinter, hfour b, hout b]
  let N : β → Finset β := fun b => (T.filter fun x => c x = b).image fun x => c (r x)
  have hHall : ∀ A : Finset β, A.card ≤ (A.biUnion N).card := by
    intro A
    let E : Finset α := T.filter fun x => c x ∈ A
    let H : Finset β := A.biUnion N
    have hEcard : E.card = 2 * A.card := by
      rw [show E = T.filter (fun x => c x ∈ A) from rfl]
      rw [← Finset.sum_card_fiberwise_eq_card_filter T A c]
      simp_rw [hout]
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, Nat.nsmul_eq_mul]
      omega
    have hHcard : (T.filter fun x => c (r x) ∈ H).card = 2 * H.card := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_card_fiberwise_eq_card_filter T H (fun x => c (r x))]
      simp_rw [hin]
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, Nat.nsmul_eq_mul]
      omega
    have hsub : E ⊆ T.filter fun x => c (r x) ∈ H := by
      intro x hx
      simp only [E, Finset.mem_filter] at hx
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter]
      refine ⟨hx.1, ?_⟩
      simp only [H, Finset.mem_biUnion]
      refine ⟨c x, hx.2, ?_⟩
      simp only [N, Finset.mem_image]
      refine ⟨x, ?_, rfl⟩
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter]
      exact ⟨hx.1, trivial⟩
    have hc := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    rw [hEcard, hHcard] at hc
    change A.card ≤ H.card
    omega
  obtain ⟨f, hfinj, hfN⟩ := (Finset.all_card_le_biUnion_card_iff_exists_injective N).mp hHall
  have hex : ∀ b, ∃ x, x ∈ T ∧ c x = b ∧ c (r x) = f b := by
    intro b
    have h := hfN b
    simp only [N, Finset.mem_image] at h
    rcases h with ⟨x, hx, hhead⟩
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at hx
    exact ⟨x, hx.1, hx.2, hhead⟩
  choose e heT hec hehead using hex
  have heinj : Function.Injective e := by
    intro b₁ b₂ h
    have hc := congrArg c h
    rw [hec b₁, hec b₂] at hc
    exact hc
  have hfsurj : Function.Surjective f := Finite.surjective_of_injective hfinj
  let M : Finset α := Finset.univ.image e
  have hMsub : M ⊆ T := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [M, Finset.mem_image] at hx
    rcases hx with ⟨b, hb, hbx⟩
    rw [← hbx]
    exact heT b
  refine ⟨M, hMsub, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro b
    have hset : M.filter (fun x => c x = b) = {e b} := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at hx
        rcases hx with ⟨hxM, hcx⟩
        simp only [M, Finset.mem_image] at hxM
        rcases hxM with ⟨b', hb', hbx⟩
        have hbb : b' = b := by
          calc
            b' = c (e b') := (hec b').symm
            _ = c x := congrArg c hbx
            _ = b := hcx
        subst b'
        simp only [Finset.mem_singleton]
        exact hbx.symm
      · intro hx
        simp only [Finset.mem_singleton] at hx
        subst x
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter]
        constructor
        · exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨b, Finset.mem_univ b, rfl⟩
        · exact hec b
    rw [hset]
    exact Finset.card_singleton _
  · intro b
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hfsurj b
    have hset : M.filter (fun x => c (r x) = b) = {e a} := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at hx
        rcases hx with ⟨hxM, hheadx⟩
        simp only [M, Finset.mem_image] at hxM
        rcases hxM with ⟨a', ha', hax⟩
        have hfa : f a' = f a := by
          calc
            f a' = c (r (e a')) := (hehead a').symm
            _ = c (r x) := congrArg (fun y => c (r y)) hax
            _ = b := hheadx
            _ = f a := ha.symm
        have haa : a' = a := hfinj hfa
        subst a'
        simp only [Finset.mem_singleton]
        exact hax.symm
      · intro hx
        simp only [Finset.mem_singleton] at hx
        subst x
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter]
        constructor
        · exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨a, Finset.mem_univ a, rfl⟩
        · rw [hehead a, ha]
    rw [hset]
    exact Finset.card_singleton _

theorem four_regular_dart_two_factor{α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    (r : α → α) (c : α → β) (hr : Function.Involutive r) (hfix : ∀ x, r x ≠ x)
    (hfour : ∀ b, (Finset.univ.filter fun x : α => c x = b).card = 4) :
    ∃ S : Finset α, (∀ x, x ∈ S ↔ r x ∈ S) ∧
      ∀ b, (S.filter fun x => c x = b).card = 2 := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨T, horient, hout⟩ :=
    exists_balanced_dart_orientation r c hr hfix hfour
  obtain ⟨M, hMT, htail, hhead⟩ :=
    balanced_orientation_has_matching r c hr hfour T horient hout
  let S : Finset α := M ∪ M.image r
  refine ⟨S, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    have hclosed : ∀ y, y ∈ S → r y ∈ S := by
      intro y hy
      change y ∈ M ∪ M.image r at hy
      change r y ∈ M ∪ M.image r
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hy with hyM | hyI
      · exact Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨y, hyM, rfl⟩)
      · rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hyI with ⟨z, hzM, hz⟩
        apply Finset.mem_union_left
        have : r y = z := by
          rw [← hz, hr z]
        simpa only [this] using hzM
    constructor
    · exact hclosed x
    · intro hx
      have h := hclosed (r x) hx
      simpa only [hr x] using h
  · intro b
    have hdisj : Disjoint M (M.image r) := by
      rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
      intro x hxM hxI
      rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hxI with ⟨y, hyM, hyx⟩
      have hyT : y ∈ T := hMT hyM
      have hrnyT : r y ∉ T := (horient y).mp hyT
      apply hrnyT
      rw [hyx]
      exact hMT hxM
    change ((M ∪ M.image r).filter fun x => c x = b).card = 2
    rw [Finset.filter_union]
    rw [Finset.card_union_of_disjoint]
    · rw [htail b]
      have himage : ((M.image r).filter fun x => c x = b).card = 1 := by
        rw [Finset.filter_image]
        rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hr.injective]
        exact hhead b
      rw [himage]
    · exact Finset.disjoint_filter_filter hdisj

theorem exists_rev_closed_two_per_fiber{n : ℕ} {c : Fin (4 * n) → Fin n}
    (h : ∀ i, #{j : Fin (4 * n) | c j = i} = 4) :
    ∃ S : Finset (Fin (4 * n)), (∀ j, j ∈ S ↔ j.rev ∈ S) ∧
      ∀ i, #({j ∈ S | c j = i}) = 2 := by
  classical
  refine four_regular_dart_two_factor (r := Fin.rev) (c := c) Fin.rev_involutive ?_ ?_
  · intro j hj
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val hj
    simp only [Fin.rev, Fin.val_mk] at hv
    omega
  · intro i
    exact h i

theorem rev_pair_weight{m : ℕ} (j : Fin m) :
    ((j : ℕ) + 1) + (((j.rev : Fin m) : ℕ) + 1) = m + 1 := by
  cases m with
  | zero => exact Fin.elim0 j
  | succ k =>
      have h := Fin.add_rev_cast j
      omega

theorem card_eq_two_mul_of_fiber_cards{n : ℕ} {c : Fin (4 * n) → Fin n} {S : Finset (Fin (4 * n))}
    (hS : ∀ i, #({j ∈ S | c j = i}) = 2) : S.card = 2 * n := by
  classical
  rw [Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (s := S) (t := Finset.univ) (f := c) (by
    intro x hx
    show c x ∈ Finset.univ
    exact Finset.mem_univ (c x))]
  simp only [hS, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Nat.card_fin, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
  change n * 2 = 2 * n
  exact Nat.mul_comm n 2

theorem sum_eq_half_of_rev_closed{n : ℕ} {S : Finset (Fin (4 * n))}
    (hclosed : ∀ j, j ∈ S ↔ j.rev ∈ S) (hcard : S.card = 2 * n) :
    ∑ j ∈ S, ((j : ℕ) + 1) = n * (4 * n + 1) := by
  classical
  let w : Fin (4 * n) → ℕ := fun j => (j : ℕ) + 1
  let K : ℕ := 4 * n + 1
  have hrev : ∑ j ∈ S, w j.rev = ∑ j ∈ S, w j := by

theorem intervalAverage_nat_mul_close_aux{f : ℝ → ℂ} {T η : ℝ} {z : ℂ}

        (f := f) (μ := MeasureTheory.volume)

    rw [interval_average_eq, sub_zero, ← hsum]
    simp_rw [hblock]
    rw [← Finset.smul_sum]
    simp only [Complex.real_smul]
    rw [← mul_assoc]
    congr 1
    norm_cast
    field_simp

    convert hwindow ((k : ℝ) * T) using 1 <;> push_cast <;> ring

theorem intervalAverage_extend_close_aux{f : ℝ → ℂ} {C T η X L : ℝ} {z : ℂ}

    (hC : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ C) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hη : 0 ≤ η)
    (hX : 0 < X) (hL : 0 < L) (hLX : L ≤ X) (hrem : X - L ≤ T)

    ‖(⨍ x in 0..X, f x) - z‖ ≤ η + T * (C + ‖z‖) / X := by

    have hn : 0 ≤ ‖f 0‖ := norm_nonneg _

    have h := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const

    (hint 0 L) (hint L X)

        (L / X) • ((⨍ x in 0..L, f x) - z) +
          X⁻¹ • ((∫ x in L..X, f x) - (X - L) • z) := by
    rw [interval_average_eq, interval_average_eq]
    simp only [sub_zero]
    rw [← hsplit]
    simp only [Complex.real_smul]
    push_cast
    field_simp [hX.ne', hL.ne']
    ring

  have hratio1 : L / X ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hX).2 hLX

    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hratio0]
    nlinarith
  have hsum0 : 0 ≤ C + ‖z‖ := add_nonneg hC0 (norm_nonneg z)
  have htailerr :
      ‖(∫ x in L..X, f x) - (X - L) • z‖ ≤
        (X - L) * (C + ‖z‖) := by
    calc
      ‖(∫ x in L..X, f x) - (X - L) • z‖
          ≤ ‖∫ x in L..X, f x‖ + ‖(X - L) • z‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ C * (X - L) + (X - L) * ‖z‖ := by
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hXL]

    calc

          ≤ X⁻¹ * ((X - L) * (C + ‖z‖)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htailerr hXinv0
      _ ≤ X⁻¹ * (T * (C + ‖z‖)) := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hrem hsum0) hXinv0
      _ = T * (C + ‖z‖) / X := by
        rw [div_eq_mul_inv]

    ‖(L / X) • ((⨍ x in 0..L, f x) - z) +
          X⁻¹ • ((∫ x in L..X, f x) - (X - L) • z)‖

theorem intervalAverage_eventually_close_window_aux{f : ℝ → ℂ} {C T η : ℝ} {z : ℂ}
    (hint : ∀ a b, IntervalIntegrable f MeasureTheory.volume a b)
    (hC : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ C) (hT : 0 < T) (hη : 0 ≤ η)

    dsimp only [K]

  have hXT : T < X := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hXlarge
  have hX : 0 < X := hT.trans hXT

    have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hth hgap
    rw [add_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ K (ne_of_gt hgap)] at hmul
    nlinarith

  let L : ℝ := (n : ℝ) * T
  have hdiv : 0 ≤ X / T := (div_pos hX hT).le

    exact (one_lt_div hT).2 hXT |>.le

    dsimp only [n]
    exact Nat.floor_le hdiv
  have hLX : L ≤ X := by
    dsimp only [L]
    exact (le_div_iff₀ hT).mp hfloor
  have hfloor' : X / T < (n : ℝ) + 1 := by
    dsimp only [n]
    exact Nat.lt_floor_add_one (X / T)

    dsimp only [L]
    have := (div_lt_iff₀ hT).mp hfloor'
    nlinarith
  have hrem : X - L ≤ T := by
    linarith
  have hL : 0 < L := by
    dsimp only [L]
    positivity
  have hclose : ‖(⨍ x in 0..L, f x) - z‖ ≤ η := by
    simpa only [L] using intervalAverage_nat_mul_close_aux hint hT hwindow n hn

theorem unifAP_intervalAverage_cauchy_aux{f : ℝ → ℂ} (hf : IsUnifAlmostPeriodic f) :

    dsimp [T]

      _ = ε / 8 * (1 + 16 * B * l / ε) := by

        <;> ring

  have hwindow_lt : ∀ a, ‖(⨍ x in a..a + T, f x) - z‖ < ε / 4 := by
    intro a

    calc

        simpa only [z] using hw
      _ < ε / 8 + ε / 8 := by linarith
      _ = ε / 4 := by ring
  have hwindow : ∀ a, ‖(⨍ x in a..a + T, f x) - z‖ ≤ ε / 4 :=
    fun a ↦ (hwindow_lt a).le
  have hevent : ∀ᶠ X in Filter.atTop, ‖(⨍ x in 0..X, f x) - z‖ < ε / 2 := by

  refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
  intro m hm n hn

    _ < ε / 2 + ε / 2 := add_lt_add hmz hnz'

theorem positive_collinear_opposite_rays_endpoint_mem_segment{p e : Fin 2 → ℝ} {sa tb sc td k : ℝ}

theorem negative_collinear_opposite_rays_endpoint_mem_segment{p e : Fin 2 → ℝ} {sa tb sc td k : ℝ}
  (hsa : 0 < sa) (htb : 0 < tb) (hsc : 0 < sc) (htd : 0 < td) (hk : k < 0) :
  p - tb • e ∈ segment ℝ (p + sc • (k • e)) (p - td • (k • e)) ∨
    p + sc • (k • e) ∈ segment ℝ (p + sa • e) (p - tb • e) := by
  by_cases h : -sc * k ≤ tb
  · right
    rw [segment_eq_image' ℝ]
    refine ⟨(sa - sc * k) / (sa + tb), ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hden : 0 < sa + tb := add_pos hsa htb
      have hsck : sc * k < 0 := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hsc hk
      constructor
      · exact div_nonneg (le_of_lt (sub_pos.mpr (lt_trans hsck hsa))) (le_of_lt hden)
      · apply (div_le_one hden).2
        have h' : -(sc * k) ≤ tb := by
          simpa only [neg_mul] using h
        simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] using add_le_add_left h' sa
    · have hden : 0 < sa + tb := add_pos hsa htb
      ext i
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hden]
      ring
  · left
    rw [segment_eq_image' ℝ]
    refine ⟨(-tb - sc * k) / ((-k) * (sc + td)), ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hden : 0 < (-k) * (sc + td) :=
        mul_pos (neg_pos.mpr hk) (add_pos hsc htd)
      have hlt : tb < -sc * k := lt_of_not_ge h
      have hnum : 0 < -tb - sc * k := by
        calc
          0 < (-sc * k) - tb := sub_pos.mpr hlt
          _ = -tb - sc * k := by ring
      constructor
      · exact div_nonneg (le_of_lt hnum) (le_of_lt hden)
      · apply (div_le_one hden).2
        calc
          -tb - sc * k = (-sc * k) - tb := by ring
          _ ≤ -sc * k := sub_le_self _ (le_of_lt htb)
          _ ≤ -sc * k + (-k) * td := le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (neg_pos.mpr hk)) (le_of_lt htd))
          _ = (-k) * (sc + td) := by ring
    · have hden : 0 < (-k) * (sc + td) :=
        mul_pos (neg_pos.mpr hk) (add_pos hsc htd)
      have hsum : 0 < sc + td := add_pos hsc htd
      ext i
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      field_simp [ne_of_lt hk, ne_of_gt hsum]
      ring

theorem dependent_opposite_rays_endpoint_mem_segment{p e f a b c d : Fin 2 → ℝ} {sa tb sc td : ℝ}
  (he : e ≠ 0) (hf : f ≠ 0) (hsa : 0 < sa) (htb : 0 < tb)
  (hsc : 0 < sc) (htd : 0 < td)
  (ha : a = p + sa • e) (hb : b = p - tb • e)
  (hc : c = p + sc • f) (hd : d = p - td • f)
  (hdep : ¬ LinearIndependent ℝ ![e, f]) :
  a ∈ segment ℝ c d ∨ b ∈ segment ℝ c d ∨
    c ∈ segment ℝ a b ∨ d ∈ segment ℝ a b := by
  rw [LinearIndependent.pair_iff' he] at hdep
  push_neg at hdep
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hdep
  have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := by
    intro hkzero
    subst k
    simp only [zero_smul] at hk
    exact hf hk.symm
  rw [← hk] at hc hd
  subst a
  subst b
  subst c
  subst d
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hk0 with hkneg | hkpos
  · rcases negative_collinear_opposite_rays_endpoint_mem_segment hsa htb hsc htd hkneg with hbd | hca
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl hbd)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl hca))
  · rcases positive_collinear_opposite_rays_endpoint_mem_segment hsa htb hsc htd hkpos with hacd | hca
    · exact Or.inl hacd
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl hca))

theorem linearIndependent_pair_signed_nonnegative_coordinates_r2{e f q : Fin 2 → ℝ} (hlin : LinearIndependent ℝ ![e, f]) :
  (∃ α β : ℝ, 0 ≤ α ∧ 0 ≤ β ∧ q = α • e + β • f) ∨
  (∃ α β : ℝ, 0 ≤ α ∧ 0 ≤ β ∧ q = α • e + β • (-f)) ∨
  (∃ α β : ℝ, 0 ≤ α ∧ 0 ≤ β ∧ q = α • (-e) + β • f) ∨
  (∃ α β : ℝ, 0 ≤ α ∧ 0 ≤ β ∧ q = α • (-e) + β • (-f)) := by
  let b : Module.Basis (Fin 2) ℝ (Fin 2 → ℝ) :=
    basisOfLinearIndependentOfCardEqFinrank hlin (by
      rw [Module.finrank_fin_fun]
      rfl)
  let A : ℝ := b.repr q 0
  let B : ℝ := b.repr q 1
  have hq : q = A • e + B • f := by
    rw [← b.sum_repr q]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp only [A, B, b, coe_basisOfLinearIndependentOfCardEqFinrank,
      Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons]
  by_cases hA : 0 ≤ A
  · by_cases hB : 0 ≤ B
    · exact Or.inl ⟨A, B, hA, hB, hq⟩
    · right
      left
      refine ⟨A, -B, hA, by linarith, ?_⟩
      simpa only [smul_neg, neg_smul, neg_neg] using hq
  · by_cases hB : 0 ≤ B
    · right
      right
      left
      refine ⟨-A, B, by linarith, hB, ?_⟩
      simpa only [smul_neg, neg_smul, neg_neg] using hq
    · right
      right
      right
      refine ⟨-A, -B, by linarith, by linarith, ?_⟩
      simpa only [smul_neg, neg_smul, neg_neg] using hq

theorem convex_no_opposite_translates_of_radon_fin4{C : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)} (hC : Convex ℝ C) {x : Fin 4 → Fin 2 → ℝ}
  {I : Set (Fin 4)} {u v : Fin 2 → ℝ}
  (hRad : (convexHull ℝ (x '' I) ∩ convexHull ℝ (x '' Iᶜ)).Nonempty)
  (hu : ∀ i, x i + u ∈ C ↔ i ∈ I)
  (hv : ∀ i, x i + v ∈ C ↔ i ∈ Iᶜ) : False := by
  classical
  have empty_I (hI : I = ∅) : False := by
    rcases hRad with ⟨z, hz, _⟩
    rw [hI, Set.image_empty, convexHull_empty] at hz
    exact hz
  have empty_Ic (hIc : Iᶜ = ∅) : False := by
    rcases hRad with ⟨z, _, hz⟩
    rw [hIc, Set.image_empty, convexHull_empty] at hz
    exact hz
  have singleton_I (i : Fin 4) (hI : I = {i}) : False := by
    rcases hRad with ⟨z, hzI, hzIc⟩
    rw [hI, Set.image_singleton, convexHull_singleton] at hzI
    have hzi : z = x i := hzI
    rw [hzi] at hzIc
    have hsub : x '' Iᶜ ⊆ (fun p => p + v) ⁻¹' C := by
      rintro p ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
      exact (hv j).2 hj
    have hxiv : x i + v ∈ C :=
      (convexHull_min hsub (hC.translate_preimage_left v)) hzIc
    have hiIc : i ∈ Iᶜ := (hv i).1 hxiv
    have hiI : i ∈ I := by
      rw [hI]
      exact Set.mem_singleton i
    exact hiIc hiI
  have singleton_Ic (i : Fin 4) (hIc : Iᶜ = {i}) : False := by
    rcases hRad with ⟨z, hzI, hzIc⟩
    rw [hIc, Set.image_singleton, convexHull_singleton] at hzIc
    have hzi : z = x i := hzIc
    rw [hzi] at hzI
    have hsub : x '' I ⊆ (fun p => p + u) ⁻¹' C := by
      rintro p ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
      exact (hu j).2 hj
    have hxiu : x i + u ∈ C :=
      (convexHull_min hsub (hC.translate_preimage_left u)) hzI
    have hiI : i ∈ I := (hu i).1 hxiu
    have hiIc : i ∈ Iᶜ := by
      rw [hIc]
      exact Set.mem_singleton i
    exact hiIc hiI
  have pair_case (a b c d : Fin 4) (hI : I = {a, b}) (hIc : Iᶜ = {c, d}) : False := by
    have hcross := hRad
    rw [hIc] at hcross
    rw [hI, Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_singleton, convexHull_pair,
      Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_singleton, convexHull_pair] at hcross
    have ha : a ∈ I := by
      rw [hI]
      exact Set.mem_insert a {b}
    have hb : b ∈ I := by
      rw [hI]
      exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem a (Set.mem_singleton b)
    have hc : c ∈ Iᶜ := by
      rw [hIc]
      exact Set.mem_insert c {d}
    have hd : d ∈ Iᶜ := by
      rw [hIc]
      exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem c (Set.mem_singleton d)
    have hgens : ({x a + u, x b + u, x c + v, x d + v} : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ⊆ C := by
      intro p hp
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hp
      rcases hp with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
      · exact (hu a).2 ha
      · exact (hu b).2 hb
      · exact (hv c).2 hc
      · exact (hv d).2 hd
    have hQ : convexHull ℝ ({x a + u, x b + u, x c + v, x d + v} : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ⊆ C :=
      convexHull_min hgens hC
    rcases crossing_segments_translate_vertex_mem_convexHull_r2
        (a := x a) (b := x b) (c := x c) (d := x d) (u := u) (v := v) hcross with h | h | h | h
    · exact ((hv a).1 (hQ h)) ha
    · exact ((hv b).1 (hQ h)) hb
    · exact hc ((hu c).1 (hQ h))
    · exact hd ((hu d).1 (hQ h))
  rcases fin4_set_empty_singleton_pair_or_cosingleton I with hI | hIc | hI | hIc | hpair
  · exact empty_I hI
  · exact empty_Ic hIc
  · rcases hI with ⟨i, hi⟩
    exact singleton_I i hi
  · rcases hIc with ⟨i, hi⟩
    exact singleton_Ic i hi
  · rcases hpair with ⟨a, b, c, d, hab, hcd⟩
    exact pair_case a b c d hab hcd

theorem sorrydb_0c38044f81f019f0{C : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)} (hC : Convex ℝ C) {x : Fin 4 → Fin 2 → ℝ} {y : Set (Fin 4) → Fin 2 → ℝ}
  (hxy : ∀ (i : Fin 4) (s : Set (Fin 4)), x i + y s ∈ C ↔ i ∈ s) : False := by

theorem komlos_birational_gap(x y : ℝ≥0∞) :
  ((ENNReal.orderIsoUnitIntervalBirational x : ℝ) -
      (ENNReal.orderIsoUnitIntervalBirational y : ℝ)) ^ 2 ≤
    4 * ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹ * (1 - (ENNReal.orderIsoUnitIntervalBirational x : ℝ)) +
      (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ * (1 - (ENNReal.orderIsoUnitIntervalBirational y : ℝ)) -
      (1 - (ENNReal.orderIsoUnitIntervalBirational
        ((2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • (x + y)) : ℝ))) := by
  by_cases hx : x = ⊤
  · have hy1 : (ENNReal.orderIsoUnitIntervalBirational y : ℝ) ≤ 1 :=
      (ENNReal.orderIsoUnitIntervalBirational y).property.2
    subst x
    simp [ENNReal.orderIsoUnitIntervalBirational_apply_coe] at hy1 ⊢
    have hy0 : 0 ≤ (y⁻¹ + 1).toReal⁻¹ := by positivity
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (1 - (y⁻¹ + 1).toReal⁻¹)]
  · by_cases hy : y = ⊤
    · have hx1 : (ENNReal.orderIsoUnitIntervalBirational x : ℝ) ≤ 1 :=
        (ENNReal.orderIsoUnitIntervalBirational x).property.2
      subst y
      simp [ENNReal.orderIsoUnitIntervalBirational_apply_coe] at hx1 ⊢
      have hx0 : 0 ≤ (x⁻¹ + 1).toReal⁻¹ := by positivity
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (1 - (x⁻¹ + 1).toReal⁻¹)]
    · have hq (z : ℝ≥0∞) (hz : z ≠ ⊤) :
          (ENNReal.orderIsoUnitIntervalBirational z : ℝ) =
            z.toReal / (1 + z.toReal) := by
        by_cases hz0 : z = 0
        · subst z
          simp [ENNReal.orderIsoUnitIntervalBirational_apply_coe]
        · rw [ENNReal.orderIsoUnitIntervalBirational_apply_coe,
              ENNReal.toReal_inv,
              ENNReal.toReal_add ((ENNReal.inv_ne_top).2 hz0) ENNReal.one_ne_top,
              ENNReal.toReal_inv, ENNReal.toReal_one]
          have hzr0 : z.toReal ≠ 0 := ENNReal.toReal_ne_zero.mpr ⟨hz0, hz⟩
          field_simp
      have hxy : x + y ≠ ⊤ := (ENNReal.add_ne_top).2 ⟨hx, hy⟩
      have hz : (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • (x + y) ≠ ⊤ := by
        change (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * (x + y) ≠ ⊤
        exact ENNReal.mul_ne_top ((ENNReal.inv_ne_top).2 (by norm_num)) hxy
      have hzreal : ((2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • (x + y)).toReal =
          (x.toReal + y.toReal) / 2 := by
        change ((2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * (x + y)).toReal =
          (x.toReal + y.toReal) / 2
        rw [ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_inv, ENNReal.toReal_add hx hy]
        norm_num
        ring
      rw [hq x hx, hq y hy, hq _ hz, hzreal]
      have hx0 : 0 ≤ x.toReal := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
      have hy0 : 0 ≤ y.toReal := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
      have hA : 0 < 1 + x.toReal := by positivity
      have hB : 0 < 1 + y.toReal := by positivity
      have hC : 0 < 2 + x.toReal + y.toReal := by positivity
      have hAB : 0 < (1 + x.toReal) * (1 + y.toReal) := mul_pos hA hB
      have hcomp : 2 + x.toReal + y.toReal ≤
          2 * ((1 + x.toReal) * (1 + y.toReal)) := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg hx0 hy0]
      have hinvcomp :
          1 / ((1 + x.toReal) * (1 + y.toReal)) ≤
            2 / (2 + x.toReal + y.toReal) := by
        rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hAB hC]
        simpa only [one_mul] using hcomp
      have hleft :
          (x.toReal / (1 + x.toReal) - y.toReal / (1 + y.toReal)) ^ 2 =
            ((x.toReal - y.toReal) ^ 2 /
                ((1 + x.toReal) * (1 + y.toReal))) *
              (1 / ((1 + x.toReal) * (1 + y.toReal))) := by
        field_simp
        ring

          4 * ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹ * (1 - x.toReal / (1 + x.toReal)) +
              (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ * (1 - y.toReal / (1 + y.toReal)) -
              (1 - ((x.toReal + y.toReal) / 2) /

theorem komlos_integral_gap_sequence{Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ≥0∞)
  {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] :
  ∃ g : ℕ → Ω → ℝ≥0∞,
    (∀ n, g n ∈ convexHull ℝ≥0∞ (Set.range fun m ↦ X (n + m))) ∧
    ∀ δ > 0, ∃ N, ∀ n m, N ≤ n → N ≤ m →
      (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ * (∫ ω, 1 - (ENNReal.orderIsoUnitIntervalBirational (g n ω) : ℝ) ∂P) +
        (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ * (∫ ω, 1 - (ENNReal.orderIsoUnitIntervalBirational (g m ω) : ℝ) ∂P) -
        (∫ ω, 1 - (ENNReal.orderIsoUnitIntervalBirational
          (((2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • (g n + g m)) ω) : ℝ) ∂P) < δ := by
  let φ : (Ω → ℝ≥0∞) → ℝ := fun f ↦
    ∫ ω, 1 - (ENNReal.orderIsoUnitIntervalBirational (f ω) : ℝ) ∂P
  have hφ_nonneg : 0 ≤ φ := by
    intro f
    apply integral_nonneg
    intro ω
    exact sub_nonneg.mpr (ENNReal.orderIsoUnitIntervalBirational (f ω)).property.2
  have hφ_bdd : ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ n, φ (X n) ≤ M := by
    refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    intro n
    by_cases hInt : Integrable (fun ω ↦
      1 - (ENNReal.orderIsoUnitIntervalBirational (X n ω) : ℝ)) P
    · calc
        φ (X n) ≤ ∫ _ω, (1 : ℝ) ∂P := by
          apply integral_mono_ae hInt (integrable_const 1)
          filter_upwards [] with ω
          exact sub_le_self 1
            (ENNReal.orderIsoUnitIntervalBirational (X n ω)).property.1
        _ = 1 := by simp
    · simp only [φ, integral_undef hInt]
      norm_num
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgap⟩ := komlos_convex (f := X) (φ := φ) hφ_nonneg hφ_bdd
  have hg' : ∀ n, g n ∈ convexHull ℝ≥0∞ (Set.range fun m ↦ X (n + m)) := by
    intro n
    apply convexHull_min (subset_convexHull ℝ≥0∞ _)
      (Convex.lift ℝ≥0 (convex_convexHull ℝ≥0∞ _))
    exact hg n
  refine ⟨g, hg', ?_⟩
  intro δ hδ
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hgap δ hδ
  refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
  intro n m hn hm
  have hmid : ((2 : ℝ≥0)⁻¹ • (g n + g m)) =
      ((2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • (g n + g m)) := by
    ext ω
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, Pi.add_apply, ENNReal.smul_def,
      ENNReal.coe_inv_two, smul_eq_mul]
  simpa only [φ, hmid] using hN n m hn hm

theorem komlos_eLpNorm_two_lt_of_integral_sq_lt{Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] (f : Ω → ℝ)
  (hf : Measurable f) (hbound : ∀ ω, |f ω| ≤ 1) (N : ℕ)
  (hsq : (∫ ω, f ω ^ 2 ∂P) < (((2 : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ N) ^ 2) :
  MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f 2 P < (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ N := by
  have hf_memLp : MeasureTheory.MemLp f 2 P := by
    apply MeasureTheory.MemLp.of_bound hf.aestronglyMeasurable 1
    filter_upwards with ω
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hbound ω
  have hnorm_sq : MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f 2 P ^ 2 = ∫⁻ ω, ‖f ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P := by
    have h := MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_nnreal_pow_eq_lintegral (μ := P) (f := f) (p := (2 : ℝ≥0)) (by norm_num)
    norm_num [ENNReal.rpow_two] at h ⊢
    exact h
  have hlintegral : (∫⁻ ω, ‖f ω‖ₑ ^ 2 ∂P) = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ ω, f ω ^ 2 ∂P) := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hf_memLp.integrable_sq
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => sq_nonneg (f ω)))]
    apply MeasureTheory.lintegral_congr
    intro ω
    rw [Real.enorm_eq_ofReal_abs]
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_pow (abs_nonneg _) 2, sq_abs]
  have hnorm_int : MeasureTheory.eLpNorm f 2 P ^ 2 = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ ω, f ω ^ 2 ∂P) :=
    hnorm_sq.trans hlintegral
  have hint_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∫ ω, f ω ^ 2 ∂P :=
    MeasureTheory.integral_nonneg (fun ω => sq_nonneg (f ω))
  have hsq_ofReal : ENNReal.ofReal (∫ ω, f ω ^ 2 ∂P) < ENNReal.ofReal ((((2 : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ N) ^ 2) :=
    (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff_of_nonneg hint_nonneg).2 hsq
  have hright : ENNReal.ofReal ((((2 : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ N) ^ 2) = (((2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹) ^ N) ^ 2 := by
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_pow (by positivity) 2]
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_pow (by positivity) N]
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_inv_of_pos (by norm_num)]
    norm_num
  rw [hright, ← hnorm_int] at hsq_ofReal
  exact (ENNReal.pow_lt_pow_left_iff (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)).mp hsq_ofReal

theorem komlos_lp_controlled_forward_convex{Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ≥0∞)
  (hX : ∀ n, Measurable (X n)) {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] :
  ∃ Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ≥0∞,
    (∀ n, Y n ∈ convexHull ℝ≥0∞ (Set.range fun m ↦ X (n + m))) ∧
    (∀ n, Measurable (Y n)) ∧
    ∀ N n m, N ≤ n → N ≤ m →
      MeasureTheory.eLpNorm
        (fun ω ↦ (ENNReal.orderIsoUnitIntervalBirational (Y n ω) : ℝ) -
          (ENNReal.orderIsoUnitIntervalBirational (Y m ω) : ℝ)) 2 P <
        (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ N := by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgap⟩ := komlos_integral_gap_sequence X (P := P)
  choose K hK using fun N ↦ hgap (((2 : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ (2 * N + 4)) (by positivity)
  let r : ℕ → ℕ := fun n ↦ n + Finset.sum (Finset.range (n + 1)) K
  let Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ≥0∞ := fun n ↦ g (r n)
  refine ⟨Y, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro n
    dsimp [Y]
    apply (convexHull_mono (𝕜 := ℝ≥0∞)
      (s := Set.range fun j ↦ X (r n + j))
      (t := Set.range fun j ↦ X (n + j)))
    · intro z hz
      rcases hz with ⟨j, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨Finset.sum (Finset.range (n + 1)) K + j, ?_⟩
      simp only [r]
      congr 1
      omega
    · exact hg (r n)
  · intro n
    exact komlos_tail_convexHull_measurable X hX (r n) (hg (r n))
  · intro N n m hn hm
    have hKr (a : ℕ) (hNa : N ≤ a) : K N ≤ r a := by
      have hle : K N ≤ Finset.sum (Finset.range (a + 1)) K := by
        apply Finset.single_le_sum (s := Finset.range (a + 1)) (f := K)
        · intro i hi
          exact Nat.zero_le _
        · exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
      dsimp [r]
      omega
    have hdef := hK N (r n) (r m) (hKr n hn) (hKr m hm)
    let q : ℕ → Ω → ℝ := fun k ω ↦
      (ENNReal.orderIsoUnitIntervalBirational (Y k ω) : ℝ)
    let qa : Ω → ℝ := fun ω ↦
      (ENNReal.orderIsoUnitIntervalBirational
        (((2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • (Y n + Y m)) ω) : ℝ)
    let f : Ω → ℝ := fun ω ↦ q n ω - q m ω
    let d : Ω → ℝ := fun ω ↦
      (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ * (1 - q n ω) + (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ * (1 - q m ω) - (1 - qa ω)
    have hY (k : ℕ) : Measurable (Y k) :=
      komlos_tail_convexHull_measurable X hX (r k) (hg (r k))
    have hq (k : ℕ) : Measurable (q k) := by
      dsimp [q]
      fun_prop
    have hqa : Measurable qa := by
      dsimp [qa]
      fun_prop
    have hqmem (k : ℕ) (ω : Ω) : q k ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
      exact (ENNReal.orderIsoUnitIntervalBirational (Y k ω)).property
    have hqamem (ω : Ω) : qa ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
      exact (ENNReal.orderIsoUnitIntervalBirational
        (((2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • (Y n + Y m)) ω)).property
    have hqint (k : ℕ) : Integrable (q k) P := by
      apply Integrable.of_mem_Icc 0 1 (hq k).aemeasurable
      exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (hqmem k)
    have hqaint : Integrable qa P := by
      apply Integrable.of_mem_Icc 0 1 hqa.aemeasurable
      exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall hqamem
    have h1qn : Integrable (fun ω ↦ 1 - q n ω) P :=
      (integrable_const (μ := P) (1 : ℝ)).sub (hqint n)
    have h1qm : Integrable (fun ω ↦ 1 - q m ω) P :=
      (integrable_const (μ := P) (1 : ℝ)).sub (hqint m)
    have h1qa : Integrable (fun ω ↦ 1 - qa ω) P :=
      (integrable_const (μ := P) (1 : ℝ)).sub hqaint
    have hsq (ω : Ω) : f ω ^ 2 ≤ 4 * d ω := by
      simpa only [f, d, q, qa, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply] using
        komlos_birational_gap (Y n ω) (Y m ω)
    have hd_nonneg (ω : Ω) : 0 ≤ d ω := by
      nlinarith [hsq ω, sq_nonneg (f ω)]
    have hd_le_one (ω : Ω) : d ω ≤ 1 := by
      rcases hqmem n ω with ⟨hn0, hn1⟩
      rcases hqmem m ω with ⟨hm0, hm1⟩
      rcases hqamem ω with ⟨ha0, ha1⟩
      dsimp [d]
      norm_num at *
      linarith
    have hdmeas : Measurable d := by
      dsimp [d]
      fun_prop
    have hdint : Integrable d P := by
      apply Integrable.of_mem_Icc 0 1 hdmeas.aemeasurable
      exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω ↦ ⟨hd_nonneg ω, hd_le_one ω⟩
    have hfsqmeas : Measurable (fun ω ↦ f ω ^ 2) := by
      dsimp [f]
      fun_prop
    have hfsq_le_one (ω : Ω) : f ω ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
      rcases hqmem n ω with ⟨hn0, hn1⟩
      rcases hqmem m ω with ⟨hm0, hm1⟩
      dsimp [f]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (q n ω - q m ω)]
    have hfsqint : Integrable (fun ω ↦ f ω ^ 2) P := by
      apply Integrable.of_mem_Icc 0 1 hfsqmeas.aemeasurable
      exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω ↦ ⟨sq_nonneg (f ω), hfsq_le_one ω⟩

    have hhalf_n : Integrable (fun ω ↦ (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ * (1 - q n ω)) P :=
      h1qn.const_mul (2 : ℝ)⁻¹
    have hhalf_m : Integrable (fun ω ↦ (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ * (1 - q m ω)) P :=
      h1qm.const_mul (2 : ℝ)⁻¹
    have hint_d :
        (∫ ω, d ω ∂P) =
          (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ * (∫ ω, 1 - q n ω ∂P) +
            (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ * (∫ ω, 1 - q m ω ∂P) -
            (∫ ω, 1 - qa ω ∂P) := by
      dsimp [d]
      calc
        (∫ ω, (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ * (1 - q n ω) + (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ * (1 - q m ω) -
            (1 - qa ω) ∂P) =
            (∫ ω, ((fun ω ↦ (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ * (1 - q n ω)) +
              (fun ω ↦ (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ * (1 - q m ω)) -
              (fun ω ↦ 1 - qa ω)) ω ∂P) := by rfl
        _ = (∫ ω, ((fun ω ↦ (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ * (1 - q n ω)) +
              (fun ω ↦ (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ * (1 - q m ω))) ω ∂P) -
              (∫ ω, 1 - qa ω ∂P) :=
          integral_sub (hhalf_n.add hhalf_m) h1qa
        _ = ((∫ ω, (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ * (1 - q n ω) ∂P) +
              (∫ ω, (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ * (1 - q m ω) ∂P)) -
              (∫ ω, 1 - qa ω ∂P) := by
          congr 1
          exact integral_add hhalf_n hhalf_m
        _ = (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ * (∫ ω, 1 - q n ω ∂P) +
              (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ * (∫ ω, 1 - q m ω ∂P) -
              (∫ ω, 1 - qa ω ∂P) := by
          rw [integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
    have hdef' :
        (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ * (∫ ω, 1 - q n ω ∂P) +
          (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ * (∫ ω, 1 - q m ω ∂P) -
          (∫ ω, 1 - qa ω ∂P) <
          ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ (2 * N + 4) := by
      exact hdef
    have hint_sq_lt :
        (∫ ω, f ω ^ 2 ∂P) < 4 * ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ (2 * N + 4) := by
      rw [hint_d] at hint_sq_le
      nlinarith
    have hpowpos : 0 < (((2 : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ N) ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hnum :
        4 * ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ (2 * N + 4) < (((2 : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ N) ^ 2 := by
      rw [show 2 * N + 4 = N * 2 + 4 by omega, pow_add, pow_mul]
      norm_num
      nlinarith
    have hint_sq_target :
        (∫ ω, f ω ^ 2 ∂P) < (((2 : ℝ)⁻¹) ^ N) ^ 2 :=
      lt_trans hint_sq_lt hnum
    have hfmeas : Measurable f := by
      dsimp [f]
      fun_prop
    have hfbound (ω : Ω) : |f ω| ≤ 1 := by
      rcases hqmem n ω with ⟨hn0, hn1⟩
      rcases hqmem m ω with ⟨hm0, hm1⟩

      dsimp [f]
      constructor <;> linarith

  have h_ae : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, ∃ l : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun n ↦ f n ω) Filter.atTop (𝓝 l) := by

        (p := 2) (B := fun N ↦ (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ^ N)

       | Symbol.terminal t =>
           KurodaRule.one_one (KurodaSimNt.base a) t :: kurodaOutputRules r rest
       | Symbol.nonterminal _ => kurodaOutputRules r rest)

def kurodaRulesOfGrule {T : Type} {g : Grammar T} (r : Grule T g.nt) :
    List (KurodaRule T (KurodaSimNt T g)) :=
  match kurodaGruleInput r with
  | [] => []
  | a :: rest =>
      KurodaRule.one_two (KurodaSimNt.base a) KurodaSimNt.trash
        (KurodaSimNt.scan r [a]) ::
      (kurodaScanTailRules r [a] rest ++ kurodaOutputRules r r.output)

def kurodaDecodeNt {T : Type} {g : Grammar T} :
    KurodaSimNt T g → List (Symbol T g.nt)
  | KurodaSimNt.base s => [s]
  | KurodaSimNt.scan _ pref => pref
  | KurodaSimNt.out _ w => w
  | KurodaSimNt.trash => []

def kurodaDecodeSymbol {T : Type} {g : Grammar T} :
    Symbol T (KurodaSimNt T g) → List (Symbol T g.nt)
  | Symbol.terminal t => [Symbol.terminal t]
  | Symbol.nonterminal n => kurodaDecodeNt n

theorem kuroda_transforms_iff_context{T : Type} (k : KurodaGrammar T) (w₁ w₂ : List (Symbol T k.nt)) : k.Transforms w₁ w₂ ↔ ∃ r ∈ k.rules, ∃ u v, w₁ = u ++ kurodaRuleInput r ++ v ∧ w₂ = u ++ kurodaRuleOutput r ++ v := by
  unfold KurodaGrammar.Transforms
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨r, hr, u, v, h⟩
    refine ⟨r, hr, u, v, ?_⟩
    cases r <;> simpa only [kurodaRuleInput, kurodaRuleOutput, List.append_nil] using h
  · rintro ⟨r, hr, u, v, h⟩
    refine ⟨r, hr, u, v, ?_⟩
    cases r <;> simpa only [kurodaRuleInput, kurodaRuleOutput, List.append_nil] using h

theorem kuroda_decode_encode{T : Type} {g : Grammar T} (w : List (Symbol T g.nt)) : kurodaDecodeString (kurodaEncodeString w) = w := by
  induction w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a w ih =>
      change a :: kurodaDecodeString (kurodaEncodeString w) = a :: w
      exact congrArg (List.cons a) ih

theorem kuroda_decode_append{T : Type} {g : Grammar T} (u v : List (Symbol T (KurodaSimNt T g))) : kurodaDecodeString (u ++ v) = kurodaDecodeString u ++ kurodaDecodeString v := by
  unfold kurodaDecodeString
  exact List.flatMap_append _ _ _

theorem kuroda_decode_terminal_word{T : Type} {g : Grammar T} (w : List T) : kurodaDecodeString (g := g) (w.map Symbol.terminal) = w.map Symbol.terminal := by
  induction w with
  | nil =>
      rfl
  | cons t w ih =>
      simp only [kurodaDecodeString] at ih
      simp only [List.map_cons, kurodaDecodeString, List.flatMap_cons,
        kurodaDecodeSymbol, ih, List.singleton_append]

theorem kuroda_derives_append_left{T : Type} {k : KurodaGrammar T} {w₁ w₂ : List (Symbol T k.nt)} (p : List (Symbol T k.nt)) : k.Derives w₁ w₂ → k.Derives (p ++ w₁) (p ++ w₂) := by
  intro h
  induction h with
  | refl =>
      exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  | tail hder htrans ih =>
      apply Relation.ReflTransGen.tail ih
      rw [kuroda_transforms_iff_context] at htrans ⊢
      rcases htrans with ⟨r, hr, u, v, h₁, h₂⟩
      refine ⟨r, hr, p ++ u, v, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [h₁]
        simp only [List.append_assoc]
      · rw [h₂]
        simp only [List.append_assoc]

theorem kuroda_derives_append_right{T : Type} {k : KurodaGrammar T} {w₁ w₂ : List (Symbol T k.nt)} (p : List (Symbol T k.nt)) : k.Derives w₁ w₂ → k.Derives (w₁ ++ p) (w₂ ++ p) := by
  intro h
  induction h with
  | refl =>
      exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  | tail hsteps hstep ih =>
      apply Relation.ReflTransGen.tail ih
      rw [kuroda_transforms_iff_context] at hstep ⊢
      rcases hstep with ⟨r, hr, u, v, hw₁, hw₂⟩
      refine ⟨r, hr, u, v ++ p, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hw₁]
        simp only [List.append_assoc]
      · rw [hw₂]
        simp only [List.append_assoc]

theorem kuroda_outputRules_sound{T : Type} {g : Grammar T} (r : Grule T g.nt) (xs : List (Symbol T g.nt)) (kr : KurodaRule T (KurodaSimNt T g)) : kr ∈ kurodaOutputRules r xs → g.Derives (kurodaDecodeString (kurodaRuleInput kr)) (kurodaDecodeString (kurodaRuleOutput kr)) := by
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
      intro h
      simp only [kurodaOutputRules, List.mem_singleton] at h
      subst kr
      exact gr_deri_self
  | cons a rest ih =>
      intro h
      simp only [kurodaOutputRules, List.mem_cons] at h
      rcases h with h | h
      · subst kr
        exact gr_deri_self
      · cases a with
        | terminal t =>
            simp only [List.mem_cons] at h
            rcases h with h | h
            · subst kr
              exact gr_deri_self
            · exact ih h
        | nonterminal n =>
            exact ih h

theorem kuroda_scanTailRules_sound{T : Type} {g : Grammar T} (r : Grule T g.nt) (rin : r ∈ g.rules) (pref rest : List (Symbol T g.nt)) (hsplit : pref ++ rest = kurodaGruleInput r) (kr : KurodaRule T (KurodaSimNt T g)) : kr ∈ kurodaScanTailRules r pref rest → g.Derives (kurodaDecodeString (kurodaRuleInput kr)) (kurodaDecodeString (kurodaRuleOutput kr)) := by
  induction rest generalizing pref kr with
  | nil =>
      intro hkr
      simp only [kurodaScanTailRules, List.mem_singleton] at hkr
      subst kr
      apply gr_deri_of_tran
      refine ⟨r, rin, [], [], ?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa only [kurodaRuleInput, kurodaDecodeString, kurodaDecodeSymbol,
          kurodaDecodeNt, List.flatMap_cons, List.flatMap_nil, List.nil_append,
          List.append_nil, kurodaGruleInput] using hsplit
      · simp only [kurodaRuleOutput, kurodaDecodeString, kurodaDecodeSymbol,
          kurodaDecodeNt, List.flatMap_cons, List.flatMap_nil, List.nil_append,
          List.append_nil]
  | cons a tail ih =>
      intro hkr
      simp only [kurodaScanTailRules, List.mem_cons] at hkr
      rcases hkr with rfl | hkr
      · simp only [kurodaRuleInput, kurodaRuleOutput, kurodaDecodeString,
          kurodaDecodeSymbol, kurodaDecodeNt, List.flatMap_cons, List.flatMap_nil,
          List.nil_append, List.append_nil]
        exact gr_deri_self
      · apply ih (pref := pref ++ [a])
        · simpa only [List.append_assoc] using hsplit
        · exact hkr

theorem kuroda_rulesOfGrule_sound{T : Type} {g : Grammar T} (r : Grule T g.nt) (rin : r ∈ g.rules) (kr : KurodaRule T (KurodaSimNt T g)) : kr ∈ kurodaRulesOfGrule r → g.Derives (kurodaDecodeString (kurodaRuleInput kr)) (kurodaDecodeString (kurodaRuleOutput kr)) := by
  intro hkr
  unfold kurodaRulesOfGrule at hkr
  cases hinput : kurodaGruleInput r with
  | nil =>
      rw [hinput] at hkr
      exact (List.not_mem_nil kr hkr).elim
  | cons a rest =>
      rw [hinput] at hkr
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hkr with hhead | htail
      · subst kr
        simp only [kurodaRuleInput, kurodaRuleOutput, kurodaDecodeString,
          List.flatMap_cons, List.flatMap_nil, kurodaDecodeSymbol, kurodaDecodeNt,
          List.nil_append]
        exact gr_deri_self
      · rcases List.mem_append.mp htail with hscan | hout
        · apply kuroda_scanTailRules_sound r rin [a] rest
          · simpa only [List.singleton_append] using hinput.symm
          · exact hscan
        · exact kuroda_outputRules_sound r r.output kr hout

theorem kuroda_generated_rule_sound{T : Type} (g : Grammar T) (kr : KurodaRule T (KurodaSimNt T g)) : kr ∈ (kurodaOfGrammar g).rules → g.Derives (kurodaDecodeString (kurodaRuleInput kr)) (kurodaDecodeString (kurodaRuleOutput kr)) := by
  intro h
  unfold kurodaOfGrammar at h
  rcases List.mem_cons.mp h with h | h
  · subst kr
    exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  · rw [List.mem_flatMap] at h
    rcases h with ⟨r, rin, hkr⟩
    exact kuroda_rulesOfGrule_sound r rin kr hkr

theorem kuroda_transform_sound{T : Type} (g : Grammar T) {w₁ w₂ : List (Symbol T (KurodaSimNt T g))} : (kurodaOfGrammar g).Transforms w₁ w₂ → g.Derives (kurodaDecodeString w₁) (kurodaDecodeString w₂) := by
  intro h
  rw [kuroda_transforms_iff_context] at h
  rcases h with ⟨kr, hkr, u, v, hw₁, hw₂⟩
  have hcore := kuroda_generated_rule_sound g kr hkr
  have hleft := gr_append_deri (kurodaDecodeString u) hcore
  have hctx := gr_deri_append (kurodaDecodeString v) hleft
  rw [hw₁, hw₂]
  rw [kuroda_decode_append, kuroda_decode_append,
    kuroda_decode_append, kuroda_decode_append]
  exact hctx

theorem kuroda_derivation_sound{T : Type} (g : Grammar T) {w₁ w₂ : List (Symbol T (KurodaSimNt T g))} : (kurodaOfGrammar g).Derives w₁ w₂ → g.Derives (kurodaDecodeString w₁) (kurodaDecodeString w₂) := by
  intro h
  induction' h with u v _ orig ih
  · exact gr_deri_self
  · exact gr_deri_of_deri_deri ih (kuroda_transform_sound g orig)

theorem kuroda_encode_append{T : Type} {g : Grammar T} (u v : List (Symbol T g.nt)) : kurodaEncodeString (u ++ v) = kurodaEncodeString u ++ kurodaEncodeString v := by
  unfold kurodaEncodeString
  rw [List.map_append]

theorem kuroda_trash_erase{T : Type} (g : Grammar T) (n : Nat) (w : List (Symbol T (KurodaSimNt T g))) : (kurodaOfGrammar g).Derives (List.replicate n (Symbol.nonterminal KurodaSimNt.trash) ++ w) w := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simp only [List.replicate_zero, List.nil_append]
      exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  | succ n ih =>
      have hstep : (kurodaOfGrammar g).Transforms
          (List.replicate (Nat.succ n) (Symbol.nonterminal KurodaSimNt.trash) ++ w)
          (List.replicate n (Symbol.nonterminal KurodaSimNt.trash) ++ w) := by
        rw [kuroda_transforms_iff_context]
        refine ⟨KurodaRule.one_nil KurodaSimNt.trash, ?_, [],
          List.replicate n (Symbol.nonterminal KurodaSimNt.trash) ++ w, ?_, ?_⟩
        · change KurodaRule.one_nil KurodaSimNt.trash ∈
            KurodaRule.one_nil KurodaSimNt.trash :: _
          exact List.mem_cons_self _ _
        · simp only [kurodaRuleInput, List.replicate_succ, List.nil_append,
            List.singleton_append, List.cons_append]
        · simp only [kurodaRuleOutput, List.nil_append]
      exact Relation.ReflTransGen.trans (Relation.ReflTransGen.single hstep) ih

theorem kuroda_scanTail_complete_aux{T : Type} {g : Grammar T} (r : Grule T g.nt) (pref rest : List (Symbol T g.nt)) (hrules : ∀ kr, kr ∈ kurodaScanTailRules r pref rest → kr ∈ (kurodaOfGrammar g).rules) : (kurodaOfGrammar g).Derives (Symbol.nonterminal (KurodaSimNt.scan r pref) :: kurodaEncodeString rest) (List.replicate rest.length (Symbol.nonterminal KurodaSimNt.trash) ++ [Symbol.nonterminal (KurodaSimNt.scan r (pref ++ rest))]) := by
  induction rest generalizing pref with
  | nil =>
      simp only [kurodaEncodeString, List.map_nil, List.length_nil,
        List.replicate_zero, List.nil_append, List.append_nil]
      exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  | cons a tail ih =>
      let kr : KurodaRule T (KurodaSimNt T g) :=
        KurodaRule.two_two (KurodaSimNt.scan r pref) (KurodaSimNt.base a)
          KurodaSimNt.trash (KurodaSimNt.scan r (pref ++ [a]))
      have hmem : kr ∈ (kurodaOfGrammar g).rules := by
        apply hrules kr
        simp only [kurodaScanTailRules]
        simpa only [kr] using (List.mem_cons_self
          (KurodaRule.two_two (KurodaSimNt.scan r pref) (KurodaSimNt.base a)
            KurodaSimNt.trash (KurodaSimNt.scan r (pref ++ [a])))
          (kurodaScanTailRules r (pref ++ [a]) tail))
      have htrans : (kurodaOfGrammar g).Transforms
          (Symbol.nonterminal (KurodaSimNt.scan r pref) :: kurodaEncodeString (a :: tail))
          (Symbol.nonterminal KurodaSimNt.trash ::
            Symbol.nonterminal (KurodaSimNt.scan r (pref ++ [a])) :: kurodaEncodeString tail) := by
        rw [kuroda_transforms_iff_context]
        refine ⟨kr, hmem, [], kurodaEncodeString tail, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simp only [kr, kurodaRuleInput, kurodaEncodeString, kurodaEncodeSymbol,
            List.map_cons, List.nil_append, List.cons_append]
        · simp only [kr, kurodaRuleOutput, List.nil_append, List.cons_append]
      have hfirst : (kurodaOfGrammar g).Derives
          (Symbol.nonterminal (KurodaSimNt.scan r pref) :: kurodaEncodeString (a :: tail))
          (Symbol.nonterminal KurodaSimNt.trash ::
            Symbol.nonterminal (KurodaSimNt.scan r (pref ++ [a])) :: kurodaEncodeString tail) :=
        Relation.ReflTransGen.single htrans
      have htail := ih (pref ++ [a]) (by
        intro kr' hkr'
        apply hrules kr'
        simp only [kurodaScanTailRules]
        exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hkr')
      have hlift := kuroda_derives_append_left
        ([Symbol.nonterminal KurodaSimNt.trash]) htail
      have hcomp := hfirst.trans hlift
      simpa only [List.length_cons, List.replicate_succ, List.singleton_append,
        List.append_assoc] using hcomp

theorem kuroda_output_complete_aux{T : Type} {g : Grammar T} (r : Grule T g.nt) (xs : List (Symbol T g.nt)) (hrules : ∀ kr, kr ∈ kurodaOutputRules r xs → kr ∈ (kurodaOfGrammar g).rules) : (kurodaOfGrammar g).Derives [Symbol.nonterminal (KurodaSimNt.out r xs)] (kurodaEncodeString xs) := by
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
      apply Relation.ReflTransGen.tail Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
      rw [kuroda_transforms_iff_context]
      refine ⟨KurodaRule.one_nil (KurodaSimNt.out r []), hrules _ ?_, [], [], ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [kurodaOutputRules, List.mem_singleton]
      · rfl
      · rfl
  | cons a rest ih =>
      apply Relation.ReflTransGen.trans
        (b := [Symbol.nonterminal (KurodaSimNt.base a), Symbol.nonterminal (KurodaSimNt.out r rest)])
      · apply Relation.ReflTransGen.tail Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
        rw [kuroda_transforms_iff_context]
        refine ⟨KurodaRule.one_two (KurodaSimNt.out r (a :: rest))
          (KurodaSimNt.base a) (KurodaSimNt.out r rest), hrules _ ?_, [], [], ?_, ?_⟩
        · simp only [kurodaOutputRules, List.mem_cons, true_or]
        · rfl
        · rfl
      · have htail : (kurodaOfGrammar g).Derives
          [Symbol.nonterminal (KurodaSimNt.out r rest)] (kurodaEncodeString rest) := by
          apply ih
          intro kr hkr
          apply hrules kr
          cases a with
          | terminal t =>
              simp only [kurodaOutputRules, List.mem_cons]
              exact Or.inr (Or.inr hkr)
          | nonterminal n =>
              simp only [kurodaOutputRules, List.mem_cons]
              exact Or.inr hkr
        have hlift := kuroda_derives_append_left
          (k := kurodaOfGrammar g)
          [Symbol.nonterminal (KurodaSimNt.base a)] htail
        simpa only [kurodaEncodeString, List.map_cons, kurodaEncodeSymbol,
          List.singleton_append] using hlift

theorem kuroda_scan_commit_mem{T : Type} {g : Grammar T} (r : Grule T g.nt) (pref rest : List (Symbol T g.nt)) : KurodaRule.one_two (KurodaSimNt.scan r (pref ++ rest)) (KurodaSimNt.out r r.output) KurodaSimNt.trash ∈ kurodaScanTailRules r pref rest := by
  induction rest generalizing pref with
  | nil =>
      simp only [List.append_nil, kurodaScanTailRules, List.mem_singleton]
  | cons a rest ih =>
      simp only [kurodaScanTailRules, List.mem_cons]
      right
      simpa only [List.append_assoc] using ih (pref := pref ++ [a])

theorem kuroda_simulates_grule{T : Type} (g : Grammar T) (r : Grule T g.nt) (rin : r ∈ g.rules) : (kurodaOfGrammar g).Derives (kurodaEncodeString (kurodaGruleInput r)) (kurodaEncodeString r.output) := by
  let full := kurodaGruleInput r
  have hfull_ne : full ≠ [] := by
    unfold full kurodaGruleInput
    simp
  cases hfull_eq : full with
  | nil => exact False.elim (hfull_ne hfull_eq)
  | cons a rest =>
      have hinput : kurodaGruleInput r = a :: rest := by
        simpa only [full] using hfull_eq
      have hinit_mem :
          KurodaRule.one_two (KurodaSimNt.base a) KurodaSimNt.trash
              (KurodaSimNt.scan r [a]) ∈ (kurodaOfGrammar g).rules := by
        simp only [kurodaOfGrammar, List.mem_cons, List.mem_flatMap]
        right
        refine ⟨r, rin, ?_⟩
        unfold kurodaRulesOfGrule
        rw [hinput]
        simp only [List.mem_cons, true_or]
      have hscan_mem : ∀ kr, kr ∈ kurodaScanTailRules r [a] rest →
          kr ∈ (kurodaOfGrammar g).rules := by
        intro kr hkr
        simp only [kurodaOfGrammar, List.mem_cons, List.mem_flatMap]
        right
        refine ⟨r, rin, ?_⟩
        unfold kurodaRulesOfGrule
        rw [hinput]
        simp only [List.mem_cons, List.mem_append]
        exact Or.inr (Or.inl hkr)
      have hout_mem : ∀ kr, kr ∈ kurodaOutputRules r r.output →
          kr ∈ (kurodaOfGrammar g).rules := by
        intro kr hkr
        simp only [kurodaOfGrammar, List.mem_cons, List.mem_flatMap]
        right
        refine ⟨r, rin, ?_⟩
        unfold kurodaRulesOfGrule
        rw [hinput]
        simp only [List.mem_cons, List.mem_append]
        exact Or.inr (Or.inr hkr)
      have h₁ : (kurodaOfGrammar g).Derives
          (kurodaEncodeString (a :: rest))
          (Symbol.nonterminal KurodaSimNt.trash ::
            Symbol.nonterminal (KurodaSimNt.scan r [a]) :: kurodaEncodeString rest) := by
        apply Relation.ReflTransGen.single
        apply (kuroda_transforms_iff_context (kurodaOfGrammar g) _ _).2
        refine ⟨KurodaRule.one_two (KurodaSimNt.base a) KurodaSimNt.trash
          (KurodaSimNt.scan r [a]), hinit_mem, [], kurodaEncodeString rest, ?_⟩
        constructor <;> rfl
      have h₂ := kuroda_derives_append_left
        [Symbol.nonterminal (KurodaSimNt.trash : KurodaSimNt T g)]
        (kuroda_scanTail_complete_aux r [a] rest hscan_mem)
      have h₁₂ : (kurodaOfGrammar g).Derives
          (kurodaEncodeString (a :: rest))
          ([Symbol.nonterminal (KurodaSimNt.trash : KurodaSimNt T g)] ++
            (List.replicate rest.length (Symbol.nonterminal KurodaSimNt.trash) ++
              [Symbol.nonterminal (KurodaSimNt.scan r ([a] ++ rest))])) := by
        exact h₁.trans h₂
      have hcommit_mem :
          KurodaRule.one_two (KurodaSimNt.scan r ([a] ++ rest))
            (KurodaSimNt.out r r.output) KurodaSimNt.trash ∈
              (kurodaOfGrammar g).rules := by
        apply hscan_mem
        simpa only using kuroda_scan_commit_mem r [a] rest
      have h₃ : (kurodaOfGrammar g).Derives
          ([Symbol.nonterminal (KurodaSimNt.trash : KurodaSimNt T g)] ++
            (List.replicate rest.length (Symbol.nonterminal KurodaSimNt.trash) ++
              [Symbol.nonterminal (KurodaSimNt.scan r ([a] ++ rest))]))
          ([Symbol.nonterminal (KurodaSimNt.trash : KurodaSimNt T g)] ++
            (List.replicate rest.length (Symbol.nonterminal KurodaSimNt.trash) ++
              [Symbol.nonterminal (KurodaSimNt.out r r.output),
                Symbol.nonterminal KurodaSimNt.trash])) := by
        apply Relation.ReflTransGen.single
        apply (kuroda_transforms_iff_context (kurodaOfGrammar g) _ _).2
        refine ⟨KurodaRule.one_two (KurodaSimNt.scan r ([a] ++ rest))
          (KurodaSimNt.out r r.output) KurodaSimNt.trash, hcommit_mem,
          [Symbol.nonterminal (KurodaSimNt.trash : KurodaSimNt T g)] ++
            List.replicate rest.length (Symbol.nonterminal KurodaSimNt.trash), [], ?_⟩
        constructor <;>
          simp only [kurodaRuleInput, kurodaRuleOutput, List.append_nil, List.append_assoc]
      have h₄ : (kurodaOfGrammar g).Derives
          ([Symbol.nonterminal (KurodaSimNt.trash : KurodaSimNt T g)] ++
            (List.replicate rest.length (Symbol.nonterminal KurodaSimNt.trash) ++
              [Symbol.nonterminal (KurodaSimNt.out r r.output),
                Symbol.nonterminal KurodaSimNt.trash]))
          ([Symbol.nonterminal (KurodaSimNt.trash : KurodaSimNt T g)] ++
            (List.replicate rest.length (Symbol.nonterminal KurodaSimNt.trash) ++
              (kurodaEncodeString r.output ++ [Symbol.nonterminal KurodaSimNt.trash]))) := by
        simpa only [List.append_assoc] using
          (kuroda_derives_append_left
            ([Symbol.nonterminal (KurodaSimNt.trash : KurodaSimNt T g)] ++
              List.replicate rest.length (Symbol.nonterminal KurodaSimNt.trash))
            (kuroda_derives_append_right [Symbol.nonterminal KurodaSimNt.trash]
              (kuroda_output_complete_aux r r.output hout_mem)))
      have h₅ : (kurodaOfGrammar g).Derives
          ([Symbol.nonterminal (KurodaSimNt.trash : KurodaSimNt T g)] ++
            (List.replicate rest.length (Symbol.nonterminal KurodaSimNt.trash) ++
              (kurodaEncodeString r.output ++ [Symbol.nonterminal KurodaSimNt.trash])))
          (kurodaEncodeString r.output ++ [Symbol.nonterminal KurodaSimNt.trash]) := by
        exact (kuroda_derives_append_left
          [Symbol.nonterminal (KurodaSimNt.trash : KurodaSimNt T g)]
          (kuroda_trash_erase g rest.length
            (kurodaEncodeString r.output ++ [Symbol.nonterminal KurodaSimNt.trash]))).trans
          (kuroda_trash_erase g 1
            (kurodaEncodeString r.output ++ [Symbol.nonterminal KurodaSimNt.trash]))
      have h₆ : (kurodaOfGrammar g).Derives
          (kurodaEncodeString r.output ++ [Symbol.nonterminal KurodaSimNt.trash])
          (kurodaEncodeString r.output) := by
        simpa only [List.replicate_succ, List.replicate_zero, List.append_nil] using
          (kuroda_derives_append_left (kurodaEncodeString r.output)
            (kuroda_trash_erase g 1 []))
      rw [hinput]

theorem imo1991_p5_sine_product_eq(A B C P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))

  have h₂ :

  have hCP : dist C P ≠ 0 := dist_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hPC)

theorem cyclotomicFactor_identity(n : ℕ) : (2 ^ n + 1) * cyclotomicFactor n = 2 ^ (3 * n) + 1 := by

  simp only [pow_add]
  have hxpos : 0 < 2 ^ n := by positivity
  have hle : 2 ^ n ≤ 2 ^ n * 2 ^ n := by nlinarith
  have hsub : 2 ^ n * 2 ^ n - 2 ^ n + 2 ^ n = 2 ^ n * 2 ^ n := Nat.sub_add_cancel hle

theorem cyclotomicFactor_padicVal_three(n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hodd : Odd n) : padicValNat 3 (cyclotomicFactor n) = 1 := by

    (by norm_num) hdiv hnthree (n := 3) (by norm_num)
  have hleft : 2 ^ n + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity

    unfold cyclotomicFactor
    omega
  have hmul := padicValNat.mul (p := 3) hleft hfactor
  rw [cyclotomicFactor_identity] at hmul
  rw [← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm n 3] at hpow
  norm_num only [one_pow, padicValNat_self] at hpow
  omega

theorem cyclotomicFactor_odd(n : ℕ) : Odd (cyclotomicFactor n) := by

theorem cyclotomicFactor_three_relation(n : ℕ) (hn : 1 < n) : cyclotomicFactor n = (2 ^ n + 1) * (2 ^ n - 2) + 3 := by
  unfold cyclotomicFactor
  have hn2 : 2 ≤ n := by omega
  have hpow : 4 ≤ 2 ^ n := by
    calc
      4 = 2 ^ 2 := by norm_num

  have hx : 2 ^ n = (2 ^ n - 2) + 2 := by omega
  have hxmul : 2 ^ n ≤ 2 ^ n * 2 ^ n := by
    calc
      2 ^ n = 2 ^ n * 1 := by omega
      _ ≤ 2 ^ n * 2 ^ n := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 ^ n) (by omega)
  have hleft : (2 ^ n * 2 ^ n - 2 ^ n + 1) + 2 ^ n = 2 ^ n * 2 ^ n + 1 := by
    omega

    simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]

theorem primeFactors_card_adjoin(n p : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (h3 : 3 ∣ n) (hp : p.Prime) (hp3 : p ≠ 3) (hpn : ¬p ∣ n) : ((3 * n) * p).primeFactors.card = n.primeFactors.card + 1 := by

  have hζznot : ζ * z ∉ t := by
    intro hz
    exact hzbad (Or.inr hz)
  have hznorm : ‖z‖ = 1 := by
    simpa only [Metric.mem_sphere, dist_zero_right] using hz_sphere

    intro h
    apply hζ1
    apply mul_right_cancel₀ hz0
    simpa only [one_mul] using h

    rw [norm_mul, hζnorm, hznorm, one_mul]

    rw [dist_eq_norm_sub]

    rw [halg, norm_mul, norm_neg, hζsubnorm, hznorm, one_mul]

    rw [dist_zero_left, hζznorm, hright]

    rw [dist_zero_left, hznorm, dist_comm, hright]

    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, not_or]

  refine ⟨insert z (insert (ζ * z) t), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hznot_insert,
      Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hζznot]
  · simp only [Finset.mem_insert, not_or]
    exact ⟨hz0.symm, hζz0.symm, h0⟩
  · intro x hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert] at hx
    rcases hx with hx | hx | hx
    · rw [hx]
      exact hznorm
    · rw [hx]
      exact hζznorm
    · exact hnorm x hx
  · intro x hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert] at hx
    rcases hx with hx | hx | hx
    · rw [hx]
      refine ⟨ζ * z, ?_, hpair1⟩
      exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
    · rw [hx]
      refine ⟨z, Finset.mem_insert_self _ _, hpair2⟩
    · obtain ⟨w, hw, hd⟩ := hneighbor x hx
      refine ⟨w, ?_, hd⟩

theorem imo2015p1_complex_circle_neighbor_finset(m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) :

theorem imo2015p1_plane_circle_neighbor_finset(m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) :

theorem imo2015p1_insert_center_balanced(t : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))

theorem imo2015p1_rootsOfUnity_square_surjective(n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (hodd : Odd n) (z : rootsOfUnity n ℂ) :
  ∃ c : rootsOfUnity n ℂ, c ^ 2 = z := by
  have hcard : Nat.card (rootsOfUnity n ℂ) = n := by
    rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Complex.card_rootsOfUnity]
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime (Nat.card (rootsOfUnity n ℂ)) 2 := by

theorem imo2015p1_complex_dist_eq_of_sq_eq_mul(a b c : ℂ) (ha : ‖a‖ = 1) (hb : ‖b‖ = 1) (hc : ‖c‖ = 1)
  (h : c ^ 2 = a * b) :
  dist a c = dist b c := by
  rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
  have hdiff : (a - c) * c = a * (c - b) := by
    calc
      (a - c) * c = a * c - c ^ 2 := by ring
      _ = a * c - a * b := by rw [h]
      _ = a * (c - b) := by ring
  calc
    ‖a - c‖ = ‖(a - c) * c‖ := by rw [norm_mul, hc, mul_one]
    _ = ‖a * (c - b)‖ := congrArg norm hdiff
    _ = ‖c - b‖ := by rw [norm_mul, ha, one_mul]
    _ = ‖b - c‖ := norm_sub_rev c b

theorem imo2015p1_odd_balanced_spherical_set(n : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n) (hodd : Odd n) :

  · rw [show s = Finset.univ.image f by rfl,

  · rw [show s = Finset.univ.image f by rfl]
    simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, not_exists]
    intro z hz

      apply imo2015p1_complexPlaneEquiv.injective
      simpa only [map_zero] using hz
    exact Units.ne_zero (z : ℂˣ) hz0
  · intro A hA
    rw [show s = Finset.univ.image f by rfl] at hA
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hA with ⟨z, -, rfl⟩
    rw [show (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) = imo2015p1_complexPlaneEquiv 0 by
      exact (map_zero imo2015p1_complexPlaneEquiv).symm]
    rw [imo2015p1_complexPlaneEquiv.dist_map]
    simpa only [dist_zero_right] using
      (Complex.norm_eq_one_of_mem_rootsOfUnity z.property)
  · intro A hA B hB hAB
    rw [show s = Finset.univ.image f by rfl] at hA hB
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hA with ⟨a, -, rfl⟩
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hB with ⟨b, -, rfl⟩
    rcases imo2015p1_rootsOfUnity_square_surjective n hodd (a * b) with ⟨c, hc⟩
    refine ⟨f c, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨c, Finset.mem_univ c, rfl⟩, ?_⟩

    rw [imo2015p1_complexPlaneEquiv.dist_map, imo2015p1_complexPlaneEquiv.dist_map]
    apply imo2015p1_complex_dist_eq_of_sq_eq_mul
    · exact Complex.norm_eq_one_of_mem_rootsOfUnity a.property
    · exact Complex.norm_eq_one_of_mem_rootsOfUnity b.property
    · exact Complex.norm_eq_one_of_mem_rootsOfUnity c.property
    · exact congrArg (fun z : rootsOfUnity n ℂ => (((z : ℂˣ) : ℂ))) hc

theorem imo2015p1_spherical_set_center_free(s : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))
  (O : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (r : ℝ)
  (hO : O ∉ s)
  (hsphere : ∀ A ∈ s, dist A O = r) :
  ∀ A ∈ s, ∀ B ∈ s, ∀ C ∈ s,
    A ≠ B ∧ B ≠ C ∧ A ≠ C →
      ¬∃ P ∈ s, dist P A = dist P B ∧ dist P B = dist P C := by
  intro A hA B hB C hC hABC
  rcases hABC with ⟨hAB, hBC, hAC⟩
  rintro ⟨P, hP, hPAB, hPBC⟩
  have hcos : EuclideanGeometry.Cospherical ({A, B, C} : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) := by
    rw [EuclideanGeometry.cospherical_def]
    refine ⟨O, r, ?_⟩
    intro X hX
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hX
    rcases hX with hX | hX | hX
    · subst X
      exact hsphere A hA
    · subst X
      exact hsphere B hB
    · subst X
      exact hsphere C hC
  have h_ind : AffineIndependent ℝ ![A, B, C] :=
    EuclideanGeometry.Cospherical.affineIndependent_of_ne hcos hAB hAC hBC
  let T : Affine.Simplex ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) 2 := ⟨![A, B, C], h_ind⟩
  have hspan : affineSpan ℝ (Set.range T.points) = ⊤ :=
    T.span_eq_top finrank_euclideanSpace_fin
  have hdistO : ∀ i, dist (T.points i) O = r := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact hsphere A hA
    · exact hsphere B hB
    · exact hsphere C hC
  have hdistP : ∀ i, dist (T.points i) P = dist A P := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · rfl
    · change dist B P = dist A P
      rw [dist_comm B P, dist_comm A P]
      exact hPAB.symm
    · change dist C P = dist A P
      rw [dist_comm C P, dist_comm A P]
      exact hPBC.symm.trans hPAB.symm
  have hcO : (↑(T.orthogonalProjectionSpan O) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) = T.circumcenter :=
    T.orthogonalProjection_eq_circumcenter_of_dist_eq hdistO
  have hcP : (↑(T.orthogonalProjectionSpan P) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) = T.circumcenter :=
    T.orthogonalProjection_eq_circumcenter_of_dist_eq hdistP
  have hproj : (↑(T.orthogonalProjectionSpan O) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) =
      ↑(T.orthogonalProjectionSpan P) := hcO.trans hcP.symm
  have hOmem : O ∈ affineSpan ℝ (Set.range T.points) := by
    rw [hspan]
    trivial
  have hPmem : P ∈ affineSpan ℝ (Set.range T.points) := by
    rw [hspan]
    trivial
  have hselfO : (↑(T.orthogonalProjectionSpan O) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) = O := by
    change (↑(EuclideanGeometry.orthogonalProjection (affineSpan ℝ (Set.range T.points)) O) :
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) = O
    exact congrArg Subtype.val
      (EuclideanGeometry.orthogonalProjection_mem_subspace_eq_self
        (s := affineSpan ℝ (Set.range T.points)) ⟨O, hOmem⟩)
  have hselfP : (↑(T.orthogonalProjectionSpan P) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) = P := by
    change (↑(EuclideanGeometry.orthogonalProjection (affineSpan ℝ (Set.range T.points)) P) :
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) = P
    exact congrArg Subtype.val
      (EuclideanGeometry.orthogonalProjection_mem_subspace_eq_self
        (s := affineSpan ℝ (Set.range T.points)) ⟨P, hPmem⟩)
  have hOP : O = P := hselfO.symm.trans (hproj.trans hselfP)
  apply hO
  rwa [hOP]

noncomputable def imo2015p1_centerPairs
    (s : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) (P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :
    Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :=
  (s.product s).filter (fun q => q.1 ≠ q.2 ∧ dist P q.1 = dist P q.2)

theorem imo2015p1_centerPairs_card_le_of_even(s : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))
  (P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (hP : P ∈ s) (heven : Even s.card)
  (hfree : ∀ A ∈ s, ∀ B ∈ s, ∀ C ∈ s,
    A ≠ B ∧ B ≠ C ∧ A ≠ C →
      ¬∃ Q ∈ s, dist Q A = dist Q B ∧ dist Q B = dist Q C) :
  (imo2015p1_centerPairs s P).card ≤ s.card - 2 := by
  classical
  let t := (s.product s).filter (fun q => q.1 ≠ q.2 ∧ dist P q.1 = dist P q.2)
  have hcardle : t.card ≤ (s.erase P).card := by
    apply Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn Prod.fst
    · intro q hq
      change q ∈ (s.product s).filter (fun q => q.1 ≠ q.2 ∧ dist P q.1 = dist P q.2) at hq
      have hprod := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).1
      have hprops := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).2
      rw [Finset.product_eq_sprod] at hprod
      have hq1 := (Finset.mem_product.mp hprod).1
      change q.1 ∈ s.erase P
      apply Finset.mem_erase.mpr
      refine ⟨?_, hq1⟩
      intro heq
      have hz : dist P q.2 = 0 := by
        rw [← hprops.2, heq, dist_self]
      exact hprops.1 (heq.trans (eq_of_dist_eq_zero hz))
    · intro q hq r hr hfst
      change q ∈ (s.product s).filter (fun q => q.1 ≠ q.2 ∧ dist P q.1 = dist P q.2) at hq
      change r ∈ (s.product s).filter (fun q => q.1 ≠ q.2 ∧ dist P q.1 = dist P q.2) at hr
      have hqprod := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).1
      have hqprops := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).2
      have hrprod := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hr).1
      have hrprops := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hr).2
      rw [Finset.product_eq_sprod] at hqprod hrprod
      have hq1 := (Finset.mem_product.mp hqprod).1
      have hq2 := (Finset.mem_product.mp hqprod).2
      have hr2 := (Finset.mem_product.mp hrprod).2
      have hqrsnd : q.2 = r.2 := by
        by_contra hne
        have hAC : q.1 ≠ r.2 := by
          intro hac
          exact hrprops.1 (hfst.symm.trans hac)
        have hbad := hfree q.1 hq1 q.2 hq2 r.2 hr2
          ⟨hqprops.1, hne, hAC⟩
        apply hbad
        refine ⟨P, hP, hqprops.2, ?_⟩
        calc
          dist P q.2 = dist P q.1 := hqprops.2.symm
          _ = dist P r.1 := congrArg (dist P) hfst
          _ = dist P r.2 := hrprops.2
      exact Prod.ext hfst hqrsnd
  have hcardt : t.card ≤ s.card - 1 := by
    rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hP] at hcardle
    exact hcardle
  have hswap_mem : ∀ q ∈ t, (q.2, q.1) ∈ t := by
    intro q hq
    change q ∈ (s.product s).filter (fun q => q.1 ≠ q.2 ∧ dist P q.1 = dist P q.2) at hq
    change (q.2, q.1) ∈ (s.product s).filter (fun q => q.1 ≠ q.2 ∧ dist P q.1 = dist P q.2)
    have hprod := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).1
    have hprops := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).2
    rw [Finset.product_eq_sprod] at hprod ⊢
    have hq1 := (Finset.mem_product.mp hprod).1
    have hq2 := (Finset.mem_product.mp hprod).2
    apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
    exact ⟨Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hq2, hq1⟩, hprops.1.symm, hprops.2.symm⟩
  have htEven : Even t.card := by
    let f : ↥t → ↥t := fun q => ⟨(q.1.2, q.1.1), hswap_mem q.1 q.2⟩
    have hf : Function.Involutive f := by
      intro q
      apply Subtype.ext
      rfl
    let σ : Equiv.Perm ↥t := Function.Involutive.toPerm f hf
    have hσ2 : σ ^ 2 = 1 := by
      apply Equiv.ext
      intro q
      change f (f q) = q
      exact hf q
    have hsupp : σ.support = Finset.univ := by
      ext q
      simp only [Equiv.Perm.mem_support, Finset.mem_univ, iff_true]
      intro heq
      have hv := congrArg (fun z : ↥t => z.1) heq
      change (q.1.2, q.1.1) = q.1 at hv
      have hcomponents : q.1.1 = q.1.2 := congrArg Prod.fst hv.symm
      have hqt : q.1 ∈ t := q.2
      change q.1 ∈ (s.product s).filter (fun q => q.1 ≠ q.2 ∧ dist P q.1 = dist P q.2) at hqt
      exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hqt).2.1 hcomponents
    apply even_iff_two_dvd.mpr
    have hd := Equiv.Perm.two_dvd_card_support hσ2
    rw [hsupp, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_coe] at hd
    exact hd
  change t.card ≤ s.card - 2
  rcases heven with ⟨k, hk⟩
  rcases htEven with ⟨m, hm⟩
  omega

theorem imo2015p1_offdiag_card_le_sum_centerPairs(s : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))
  (hbal : ∀ A ∈ s, ∀ B ∈ s, A ≠ B → ∃ P ∈ s, dist A P = dist B P) :

    rw [show E.card = ∑ A ∈ s, (s.erase A).card by

    exact Finset.sum_const_nat (fun A hA => Finset.card_erase_of_mem hA)
  have hcover : ∀ z ∈ E, ∃ P ∈ s,
      (z.1, z.2) ∈ imo2015p1_centerPairs s P := by
    intro z hz
    have hzmem := Finset.mem_sigma.mp hz
    have hz2 := Finset.mem_erase.mp hzmem.2
    rcases hbal z.1 hzmem.1 z.2 hz2.2 hz2.1.symm with ⟨P, hPs, hdist⟩
    refine ⟨P, hPs, ?_⟩
    apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hzmem.1, hz2.2⟩, hz2.1.symm, ?_⟩
    simpa only [dist_comm] using hdist
  let f : {z // z ∈ E} → {w // w ∈ T} := fun z =>
    ⟨⟨Classical.choose (hcover z.1 z.2), (z.1.1, z.1.2)⟩,
      Finset.mem_sigma.mpr ⟨(Classical.choose_spec (hcover z.1 z.2)).1,
        (Classical.choose_spec (hcover z.1 z.2)).2⟩⟩
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply Subtype.ext
    have hpair := congrArg (fun w => w.1.2) hxy
    exact congrArg (fun p => (⟨p.1, p.2⟩ : Σ _ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) hpair
  calc
    s.card * (s.card - 1) = E.card := hEcard.symm
    _ ≤ T.card := Finset.card_le_card_of_injective hf
    _ = ∑ P ∈ s, (imo2015p1_centerPairs s P).card := by
      simp only [T, Finset.card_sigma]
