    induction l with
    | nil => exact List.Pairwise.nil
    | cons x xs ih =>
        simp only [List.map_cons] at hl
        cases hl with
        | cons hhead htail =>
            constructor
            · intro y hy
              exact hhead (a[y]) (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩)
            · exact ih htail
  have hval_strict : is.Pairwise (fun x y => a[x] < a[y]) :=
    hmap is hval
  have hval_le : is.Pairwise (fun x y => a[x] ≤ a[y]) :=
    hval_strict.imp le_of_lt
  have hkval : a[k] ≤ a[is.getLast (List.ne_nil_of_mem hk)] :=
    hval_le.rel_getLast_of_rel_getLast_getLast hk (le_refl _)
  rw [hlast] at hkidx hkval
  exact ⟨hkidx, hkval⟩

theorem lis_idx_extend_endsAt(a : Array Int) (i j : Fin a.size) (is : List (Fin a.size))
  (h : LISIdxEndsAt a j is) (hji : j < i) (hav : a[j] < a[i]) :
  LISIdxEndsAt a i (is ++ [i]) := by
  have append_pairwise_singleton :
      ∀ {α : Type} (r : α → α → Prop) (xs : List α) (z : α),
        xs.Pairwise r → (∀ x ∈ xs, r x z) → (xs ++ [z]).Pairwise r := by
    intro α r xs
    induction xs with
    | nil =>
        intro z hp hall
        apply List.Pairwise.cons
        · intro x hx
          simp only [List.not_mem_nil] at hx
        · exact List.Pairwise.nil
    | cons x xs ih =>
        intro z hp hall
        cases hp with
        | cons hhead htail =>
            rw [List.cons_append]
            apply List.Pairwise.cons
            · intro y hy
              rcases List.mem_append.mp hy with hy | hy
              · exact hhead y hy
              · have hyz : y = z := by
                  simpa only [List.mem_singleton] using hy
                subst y
                exact hall x (by simp only [List.mem_cons, true_or])
            · apply ih z htail
              intro y hy
              exact hall y (by simp only [List.mem_cons, hy, or_true])
  simp only [LISIdxEndsAt, LISIdxSubseq] at h ⊢
  rcases h with ⟨⟨hidx, hval⟩, hlast⟩
  have hb := lis_idx_endsAt_bounds a j is ⟨⟨hidx, hval⟩, hlast⟩
  constructor
  · constructor
    · apply append_pairwise_singleton (fun x y : Fin a.size => x < y) is i hidx
      intro k hk
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (hb k hk).1 hji
    · rw [List.map_append]
      change (List.map (fun i => a[i]) is ++ [a[i]]).Pairwise (fun x y => x < y)
      apply append_pairwise_singleton (fun x y : Int => x < y)
        (List.map (fun i => a[i]) is) a[i] hval
      intro x hx
      simp only [List.mem_map] at hx
      rcases hx with ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (hb k hk).2 hav
  · rw [List.getLast?_append_cons]
    rfl

theorem lis_idx_endsAt_decompose(a : Array Int) (i : Fin a.size) (is : List (Fin a.size))
  (h : LISIdxEndsAt a i is) (hlen : 1 < is.length) :
  ∃ (j : Fin a.size) (pre : List (Fin a.size)),
    LISIdxEndsAt a j pre ∧ j < i ∧ a[j] < a[i] ∧ is = pre ++ [i] := by
  rcases h with ⟨⟨hidx, hval⟩, hlast⟩
  have his_ne : is ≠ [] := by
    intro his
    subst is
    simp only [List.length_nil] at hlen
    omega
  have hi : is.getLast his_ne = i := by
    have hsome : some (is.getLast his_ne) = some i := by
      rw [← hlast]
      exact (List.getLast?_eq_getLast_of_ne_nil his_ne).symm
    exact Option.some.inj hsome
  let pre := is.dropLast
  have hpre_ne : pre ≠ [] := by
    intro hpre
    have hlen_drop : pre.length = is.length - 1 := by
      simp only [pre, List.length_dropLast]
    rw [hpre] at hlen_drop
    simp only [List.length_nil] at hlen_drop
    omega
  let j : Fin a.size := pre.getLast hpre_ne
  have his_append : is = pre ++ [i] := by
    rw [← hi]
    simpa only [pre] using (List.dropLast_append_getLast his_ne).symm
  have hidx_app : (pre ++ [i]).Pairwise (· < ·) := by
    simpa only [← his_append] using hidx
  have hval_app := hval
  rw [his_append, List.map_append, List.map_singleton] at hval_app
  have hpre_idx : pre.Pairwise (· < ·) :=
    List.chain'_iff_pairwise.mp hidx_app.chain'.left_of_append
  have hpre_val : (pre.map (fun k => a[k])).Pairwise (· < ·) :=
    List.chain'_iff_pairwise.mp hval_app.chain'.left_of_append
  have hpre_last : pre.getLast? = some j := by
    simpa only [j] using List.getLast?_eq_getLast_of_ne_nil hpre_ne
  have hjlast : j ∈ pre.getLast? := by
    rw [hpre_last]
    simp
  have hilast : i ∈ ([i] : List (Fin a.size)).head? := by
    simp
  have hajlast : a[j] ∈ (pre.map (fun k => a[k])).getLast? := by
    simp [j, hpre_ne, hpre_last]
  have hailast : a[i] ∈ ([a[i]] : List Int).head? := by
    simp
  refine ⟨j, pre, ?_, ?_, ?_, his_append⟩
  · exact ⟨⟨hpre_idx, hpre_val⟩, hpre_last⟩
  · exact (List.chain'_append.mp hidx_app.chain').2.2 j hjlast i hilast
  · exact (List.chain'_append.mp hval_app.chain').2.2 a[j] hajlast a[i] hailast

theorem lis_innerValue_base_le(a dp : Array Int) (i : Nat) :
  dp[i]! ≤ LISInnerValue a dp i := by
  unfold LISInnerValue
  have hfold : ∀ (l : List Nat) (d : Int),
      d ≤ l.foldl (fun d j => if a[j]! < a[i]! then intMax d (dp[j]! + 1) else d) d := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil =>
        intro d
        exact le_rfl
    | cons j js ih =>
        intro d
        simp only [List.foldl_cons]
        by_cases h : a[j]! < a[i]!
        · rw [if_pos h, lis_intMax_eq_max]
          exact le_trans (le_max_left d (dp[j]! + 1)) (ih (max d (dp[j]! + 1)))
        · rw [if_neg h]
          exact ih d
  exact hfold (List.range' 0 i 1) dp[i]!

theorem lis_innerValue_pred_le(a dp : Array Int) (i j : Nat) (hji : j < i) (hav : a[j]! < a[i]!) :
  dp[j]! + 1 ≤ LISInnerValue a dp i := by
  have hmono : ∀ (l : List Nat) (d v : Int), v ≤ d →
      v ≤ l.foldl (fun d k => if a[k]! < a[i]! then intMax d (dp[k]! + 1) else d) d := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil =>
        intro d v hv
        exact hv
    | cons k l ih =>
        intro d v hv
        apply ih
        change v ≤ (if a[k]! < a[i]! then intMax d (dp[k]! + 1) else d)
        split_ifs with hk
        · rw [lis_intMax_eq_max]
          exact le_trans hv (le_max_left _ _)
        · exact hv
  have hscan : ∀ (l : List Nat) (d : Int), j ∈ l →
      dp[j]! + 1 ≤ l.foldl (fun d k => if a[k]! < a[i]! then intMax d (dp[k]! + 1) else d) d := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil =>
        intro d hj
        simp only [List.not_mem_nil] at hj
    | cons k l ih =>
        intro d hj
        simp only [List.mem_cons] at hj
        rcases hj with rfl | hj
        · apply hmono l
          change dp[j]! + 1 ≤ (if a[j]! < a[i]! then intMax d (dp[j]! + 1) else d)
          rw [if_pos hav, lis_intMax_eq_max]
          exact le_max_right _ _
        · exact ih _ hj
  apply hscan
  rw [List.mem_range']
  exact ⟨j, hji, by omega⟩

theorem lis_innerValue_le(a dp : Array Int) (i : Nat) (r : Int)
  (hbase : dp[i]! ≤ r)
  (hpred : ∀ j : Nat, j < i → a[j]! < a[i]! → dp[j]! + 1 ≤ r) :
  LISInnerValue a dp i ≤ r := by
  unfold LISInnerValue
  have aux : ∀ (xs : List Nat) (d : Int),
      (∀ j ∈ xs, j < i) → d ≤ r →
        xs.foldl (fun d j => if a[j]! < a[i]! then intMax d (dp[j]! + 1) else d) d ≤ r := by
    intro xs
    induction xs with
    | nil =>
        intro d hxs hd
        exact hd
    | cons j xs ih =>
        intro d hxs hd
        simp only [List.foldl_cons]
        apply ih
        · intro k hk
          exact hxs k (List.mem_cons_of_mem j hk)
        · split_ifs with h
          · rw [lis_intMax_eq_max]
            apply max_le hd
            apply hpred j
            · exact hxs j (by simp only [List.mem_cons, true_or])
            · exact h
          · exact hd
  apply aux (List.range' 0 i 1) dp[i]!
  · intro j hj
    simp only [List.mem_range'] at hj
    omega
  · exact hbase

theorem lis_innerValue_eq_base_or_pred(a dp : Array Int) (i : Nat) :
  LISInnerValue a dp i = dp[i]! ∨
  ∃ j : Nat, j < i ∧ a[j]! < a[i]! ∧ LISInnerValue a dp i = dp[j]! + 1 := by
  unfold LISInnerValue
  have hfold : ∀ (xs : List Nat) (d : Int),
      xs.foldl (fun d j => if a[j]! < a[i]! then intMax d (dp[j]! + 1) else d) d = d ∨
        ∃ j : Nat, j ∈ xs ∧ a[j]! < a[i]! ∧
          xs.foldl (fun d j => if a[j]! < a[i]! then intMax d (dp[j]! + 1) else d) d = dp[j]! + 1 := by
    intro xs
    induction xs with
    | nil =>
        intro d
        left
        rfl
    | cons j js ih =>
        intro d
        simp only [List.foldl_cons]
        by_cases hj : a[j]! < a[i]!
        · simp only [hj, if_true]
          rcases ih (intMax d (dp[j]! + 1)) with h | ⟨k, hk, hak, heq⟩
          · rcases le_total d (dp[j]! + 1) with hle | hle
            · right
              refine ⟨j, List.mem_cons_self j js, hj, ?_⟩
              exact h.trans (by rw [lis_intMax_eq_max, max_eq_right hle])
            · left
              exact h.trans (by rw [lis_intMax_eq_max, max_eq_left hle])
          · right
            exact ⟨k, List.mem_cons_of_mem j hk, hak, heq⟩
        · simp only [hj, if_false]
          rcases ih d with h | ⟨k, hk, hak, heq⟩
          · left
            exact h
          · right
            exact ⟨k, List.mem_cons_of_mem j hk, hak, heq⟩
  rcases hfold (List.range' 0 i 1) dp[i]! with h | ⟨j, hj, haj, heq⟩
  · left
    exact h
  · right
    refine ⟨j, ?_, haj, heq⟩
    rw [List.mem_range'] at hj
    omega

def LISDPInv (a dp : Array Int) (k : Nat) : Prop :=
  k ≤ a.size ∧ dp.size = a.size ∧
  (∀ i : Fin a.size, i.val < k → LISOptimalAt a i dp[i.val]!) ∧
  (∀ i : Fin a.size, k ≤ i.val → dp[i.val]! = 1)

theorem lis_updateAt_get_self(a dp : Array Int) (i : Nat) (hsize : dp.size = a.size) (hi : i < a.size) :
  (LISUpdateAt a dp i)[i]! = LISInnerValue a dp i := by
  rw [lis_updateAt_eq_set_inner a dp i hsize hi]
  simp [Array.set!_eq_setIfInBounds, Array.getElem!_eq_getD, hi, hsize]

theorem lis_updateAt_get_ne(a dp : Array Int) (i j : Nat) (hsize : dp.size = a.size) (hi : i < a.size)
  (hj : j < dp.size) (hne : j ≠ i) :
  (LISUpdateAt a dp i)[j]! = dp[j]! := by
  rw [lis_updateAt_eq_set_inner a dp i hsize hi]
  simp only [Array.set!_eq_setIfInBounds, Array.getElem!_eq_getD]
  have hne' : i ≠ j := Ne.symm hne
  simpa only [Array.getD_eq_getD_getElem?, Array.getElem?_setIfInBounds_ne hne']

theorem lis_optimalAt_zero(a : Array Int) (hzero : 0 < a.size) :
  LISOptimalAt a ⟨0, hzero⟩ 1 := by
  constructor
  · refine ⟨[⟨0, hzero⟩], lis_idx_singleton_endsAt a ⟨0, hzero⟩, ?_⟩
    norm_num
  · intro is his
    have hnot : ¬ 1 < is.length := by
      intro hlen
      obtain ⟨j, pre, hpre, hji, haj, his_eq⟩ :=
        lis_idx_endsAt_decompose a ⟨0, hzero⟩ is his hlen
      have hjzero : j.val < 0 := hji
      exact (Nat.not_lt_zero j.val) hjzero
    have hle : is.length ≤ 1 := by omega
    exact_mod_cast hle

theorem lis_innerValue_optimal(a dp : Array Int) (i : Nat) (hsize : dp.size = a.size) (hi : i < a.size)
  (hbase : dp[i]! = 1)
  (hprev : ∀ (j : Nat) (hj : j < i),
    LISOptimalAt a ⟨j, lt_trans hj hi⟩ dp[j]!) :
  LISOptimalAt a ⟨i, hi⟩ (LISInnerValue a dp i) := by
  unfold LISOptimalAt
  constructor
  · rcases lis_innerValue_eq_base_or_pred a dp i with hEq | ⟨j, hj, hav, hEq⟩
    · refine ⟨[⟨i, hi⟩], lis_idx_singleton_endsAt a ⟨i, hi⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [hEq, hbase]
      norm_num
    · have hjsize : j < a.size := lt_trans hj hi
      rcases (hprev j hj).1 with ⟨pre, hpre, hprelen⟩
      let jf : Fin a.size := ⟨j, hjsize⟩
      have hav' : a[j]'hjsize < a[i]'hi := by
        simpa only [Array.getElem!_eq_getD, Array.getD_eq_getD_getElem?,
          Array.getD_getElem?, hjsize, hi, dite_true] using hav
      refine ⟨pre ++ [⟨i, hi⟩], lis_idx_extend_endsAt a ⟨i, hi⟩ jf pre ?_ ?_ ?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa only [jf] using hpre
      · exact hj
      · exact hav'
      · rw [List.length_append, List.length_singleton, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, hprelen, hEq]
  · intro is his
    by_cases hlen : is.length ≤ 1
    · have hnonempty : 0 < is.length := by
        rcases his.2 with hlast
        cases is with
        | nil => cases hlast
        | cons x xs => simp only [List.length_cons]; omega
      have hlen1 : is.length = 1 := by omega
      rw [hlen1, Nat.cast_one, ← hbase]
      exact lis_innerValue_base_le a dp i
    · have hlong : 1 < is.length := by omega
      rcases lis_idx_endsAt_decompose a ⟨i, hi⟩ is his hlong with ⟨j, pre, hpre, hji, hav, hisEq⟩
      have hjnat : j.val < i := hji
      have hopt := hprev j.val hjnat
      have hprele : (pre.length : Int) ≤ dp[j.val]! := hopt.2 pre hpre
      have hav' : a[j.val]! < a[i]! := by
        simpa only [Array.getElem!_eq_getD, Array.getD_eq_getD_getElem?,
          Array.getD_getElem?, j.isLt, hi, dite_true] using hav
      have hpred := lis_innerValue_pred_le a dp i j.val hjnat hav'
      rw [hisEq, List.length_append, List.length_singleton, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
      omega

theorem lis_dpInv_init(a : Array Int) (hne : 0 < a.size) :
  LISDPInv a (Array.mkArray a.size 1) 1 := by
  unfold LISDPInv
  refine ⟨by omega, Array.size_mkArray _ _, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i hi
    have hival : i.val = 0 := by omega
    have hieq : i = ⟨0, hne⟩ := by
      apply Fin.ext
      exact hival
    subst i
    simpa only [Array.getElem!_eq_getD, Array.getD_eq_getD_getElem?,
      Array.getElem?_mkArray_of_lt hne, Option.getD_some] using
      lis_optimalAt_zero a hne
  · intro i hi
    simp only [Array.getElem!_eq_getD, Array.getD_eq_getD_getElem?,
      Array.getElem?_mkArray_of_lt i.isLt, Option.getD_some]

theorem lis_dpInv_step(a dp : Array Int) (i : Nat) (hinv : LISDPInv a dp i) (hi : i < a.size) :
  LISDPInv a (LISUpdateAt a dp i) (i + 1) := by
  unfold LISDPInv at hinv ⊢
  rcases hinv with ⟨hibound, hsize, hopt, hfuture⟩
  refine ⟨Nat.succ_le_of_lt hi, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [lis_updateAt_size, hsize]
  · intro k hk
    have hki : k.val ≤ i := by omega
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hki with hlt | heq
    · have hjsize : k.val < dp.size := by
        rw [hsize]
        exact k.isLt
      have hne : k.val ≠ i := by omega
      rw [lis_updateAt_get_ne a dp i k.val hsize hi hjsize hne]
      exact hopt k hlt
    · have hkfin : k = ⟨i, hi⟩ := Fin.ext heq
      subst k
      have hbase : dp[i]! = 1 := hfuture ⟨i, hi⟩ (Nat.le_refl i)
      have hprev : ∀ (j : Nat) (hj : j < i),
          LISOptimalAt a ⟨j, lt_trans hj hi⟩ dp[j]! := by
        intro j hj
        exact hopt ⟨j, lt_trans hj hi⟩ hj
      rw [lis_updateAt_get_self a dp i hsize hi]
      exact lis_innerValue_optimal a dp i hsize hi hbase hprev
  · intro k hk
    have hjsize : k.val < dp.size := by
      rw [hsize]
      exact k.isLt
    have hne : k.val ≠ i := by omega
    rw [lis_updateAt_get_ne a dp i k.val hsize hi hjsize hne]
    exact hfuture k (by omega)

theorem lis_dpInv_range(a dp : Array Int) (k n : Nat) (hkn : k + n ≤ a.size)
  (hinv : LISDPInv a dp k) :
  LISDPInv a ((List.range' k n 1).foldl (LISUpdateAt a) dp) (k + n) := by
  induction n generalizing k dp with
  | zero =>
      simpa only [List.range'_zero, List.foldl_nil, Nat.add_zero] using hinv
  | succ n ih =>
      have hk : k < a.size := by omega
      have hstep : LISDPInv a (LISUpdateAt a dp k) (k + 1) :=
        lis_dpInv_step a dp k hinv hk
      have hbound : (k + 1) + n ≤ a.size := by omega
      have htail := ih (k := k + 1) (dp := LISUpdateAt a dp k) hbound hstep
      simpa only [List.range'_succ, List.foldl_cons, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm,
        Nat.add_left_comm] using htail

theorem lis_pureDP_all_optimal(a : Array Int) (i : Fin a.size) :
  LISOptimalAt a i (LISPureDP a)[i.val]! := by
  by_cases hzero : a.size = 0
  · have hi := i.isLt
    omega
  · have hne : 0 < a.size := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hzero
    have hinv0 := lis_dpInv_init a hne
    have hbound : 1 + (a.size - 1) ≤ a.size := by omega
    have hinv := lis_dpInv_range a (Array.mkArray a.size 1) 1 (a.size - 1) hbound hinv0
    have hsum : 1 + (a.size - 1) = a.size := by omega
    rw [hsum] at hinv
    unfold LISDPInv at hinv
    unfold LISPureDP
    exact hinv.2.2.1 i i.isLt

theorem lis_dpMax_eq_list_fold(dp : Array Int) :
  LISDPMax dp = dp.toList.foldl intMax 0 := by
  unfold LISDPMax
  cases dp with
  | mk xs =>
      cases xs with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons x xs =>
          exact (Array.foldl_toList intMax 0 { toList := x :: xs }).symm

theorem lis_zero_le_fold_intMax(xs : List Int) :
  0 ≤ xs.foldl intMax 0 := by
  suffices h : ∀ (ys : List Int) (z : Int), 0 ≤ z → 0 ≤ ys.foldl intMax z by
    exact h xs 0 (le_refl 0)
  intro ys
  induction ys with
  | nil =>
      intro z hz
      exact hz
  | cons a ys ih =>
      intro z hz
      simp only [List.foldl_cons]
      apply ih
      rw [lis_intMax_eq_max]
      exact le_trans hz (le_max_left z a)

theorem lis_optimalAt_one_le(a : Array Int) (i : Fin a.size) (d : Int)
  (h : LISOptimalAt a i d) : 1 ≤ d := by
  rcases h.1 with ⟨is, his, hlen⟩
  rcases his with ⟨_, hlast⟩
  cases is with
  | nil => cases hlast
  | cons x xs =>
      simp only [List.length_cons, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at hlen
      omega

theorem lis_idxSubseq_endsAt_getLast(a : Array Int) (is : List (Fin a.size)) (hne : is ≠ [])
  (hsub : LISIdxSubseq a is) :
  LISIdxEndsAt a (is.getLast hne) is := by
  unfold LISIdxEndsAt
  exact ⟨hsub, List.getLast?_eq_getLast_of_ne_nil hne⟩

theorem lis_pureDP_size(a : Array Int) :
  (LISPureDP a).size = a.size := by
  unfold LISPureDP
  have hfold : ∀ (xs : List Nat) (dp : Array Int),
      (xs.foldl (LISUpdateAt a) dp).size = dp.size := by
    intro xs
    induction xs with
    | nil =>
        intro dp
        rfl
    | cons j xs ih =>
        intro dp
        rw [List.foldl_cons, ih]
        exact lis_updateAt_size a dp j
  rw [hfold]
  simp

theorem lis_mem_toList_iff_getElem_bang(dp : Array Int) (x : Int) :
  x ∈ dp.toList ↔ ∃ (i : Nat) (hi : i < dp.size), dp[i]! = x := by
  cases dp with
  | mk xs =>
      simp only [Array.toList, Array.size]
      constructor
      · intro hx
        have hex : ∃ y ∈ xs, y = x := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
        rw [List.exists_mem_iff_getElem] at hex
        rcases hex with ⟨i, hi, hix⟩
        refine ⟨i, hi, ?_⟩
        simp only [Array.getElem!_eq_getD, Array.getD_eq_getD_getElem?,
          Array.getD_getElem?, hi, dite_true]
        exact hix
      · rintro ⟨i, hi, hix⟩
        have hix' : xs[i] = x := by
          simp only [Array.getElem!_eq_getD, Array.getD_eq_getD_getElem?,
            Array.getD_getElem?, hi, dite_true] at hix
          exact hix
        have hex : ∃ y ∈ xs, y = x := by
          rw [List.exists_mem_iff_getElem]
          exact ⟨i, hi, hix'⟩
        rcases hex with ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩
        rw [← hyx]
        exact hy

theorem lis_getElem_bang_le_dpMax(dp : Array Int) (i : Nat) (hi : i < dp.size) :

theorem initial_final_filter_lower_bounds{m : ℕ} (S : List (Call m)) (hparticipates : ∀ k : Fin m, 0 < v S k) :
  m ≤ 2 * (S.filter (fun c => isInitialCall S c)).length ∧
  m ≤ 2 * (S.filter (fun c => isFinalCall S c)).length := by
  classical
  have hex : ∀ k : Fin m, ∃ c ∈ S, c.fst = k ∨ c.snd = k := by
    intro k
    exact (positive_participation_iff_incident_call S k).mp (hparticipates k)
  constructor
  · have h := (pair_edge_cover_bound_and_tightness S
        (fun k c => isAgentInitialCall S k c = true)
        (fun k c => inferInstance) ?_ ?_).1
    · simpa [isInitialCall] using h
    · intro a
      have hs : (initial S a).isSome = true := by
        unfold initial
        rw [List.find?_isSome]
        rcases hex a with ⟨c, hc, hi⟩
        exact ⟨c, hc, by simpa using hi⟩
      cases hia : initial S a with
      | none => simp [hia] at hs
      | some e =>
          refine ⟨e, ?_, ?_⟩
          · unfold initial at hia
            exact List.mem_of_find?_eq_some hia
          · simp [isAgentInitialCall, hia]
    · intro a e hae
      have hia : initial S a = some e := by
        simpa [isAgentInitialCall] using hae
      have hp : e.fst = a ∨ e.snd = a := by
        unfold initial at hia
        have hp' := List.find?_some hia
        simpa only [decide_eq_true_eq] using hp'
      simpa [eq_comm] using hp
  · have h := (pair_edge_cover_bound_and_tightness S
        (fun k c => isAgentFinalCall S k c = true)
        (fun k c => inferInstance) ?_ ?_).1
    · simpa [isFinalCall] using h
    · intro a
      have hs : (final S a).isSome = true := by
        unfold final
        rw [List.find?_isSome]
        rcases hex a with ⟨c, hc, hi⟩
        exact ⟨c, (List.mem_reverse).2 hc, by simpa using hi⟩
      cases hfa : final S a with
      | none => simp [hfa] at hs
      | some e =>
          refine ⟨e, ?_, ?_⟩
          · unfold final at hfa
            exact (List.mem_reverse).1 (List.mem_of_find?_eq_some hfa)
          · simp [isAgentFinalCall, hfa]
    · intro a e hae
      have hfa : final S a = some e := by
        simpa [isAgentFinalCall] using hae
      have hp : e.fst = a ∨ e.snd = a := by
        unfold final at hfa
        have hp' := List.find?_some hfa
        simpa only [decide_eq_true_eq] using hp'
      simpa [eq_comm] using hp

theorem tight_initial_filter_forces_both_endpoints{m : ℕ} (S : List (Call m)) (hparticipates : ∀ k : Fin m, 0 < v S k)
  (htight : m = 2 * (S.filter (fun c => isInitialCall S c)).length) :
  ∀ c ∈ S, isInitialCall S c = true →
    isAgentInitialCall S c.fst c = true ∧ isAgentInitialCall S c.snd c = true := by
  classical
  let R : Fin m → Call m → Prop := fun k c => isAgentInitialCall S k c = true
  have hcover : ∀ k, ∃ c ∈ S, R k c := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨d, hdS, hd⟩ := (positive_participation_iff_incident_call S k).mp (hparticipates k)
    have hsome : (initial S k).isSome = true := by
      rw [initial, List.find?_isSome]
      exact ⟨d, hdS, by simpa using hd⟩
    cases hi : initial S k with
    | none => simp [hi] at hsome
    | some c =>
      refine ⟨c, ?_, ?_⟩
      · apply List.mem_of_find?_eq_some
        simpa [initial] using hi
      · simp [R, isAgentInitialCall, hi]
  have hendpoint : ∀ k c, R k c → k = c.fst ∨ k = c.snd := by
    intro k c hkc
    have hi : initial S k = some c := by
      simpa [R, isAgentInitialCall] using hkc
    have hp := List.find?_some (show S.find? (fun d => d.fst = k ∨ d.snd = k) = some c by simpa [initial] using hi)
    have hp' : c.fst = k ∨ c.snd = k := of_decide_eq_true hp
    rcases hp' with hp | hp
    · exact Or.inl hp.symm
    · exact Or.inr hp.symm
  have hbound := pair_edge_cover_bound_and_tightness S R (fun k c => inferInstance) hcover hendpoint
  have htightR : Fintype.card (Fin m) =
      2 * (S.filter (fun c => decide (R c.fst c ∨ R c.snd c))).length := by
    simpa [R, isInitialCall, Bool.or_eq_true] using htight
  intro c hc hinit
  have hRor : R c.fst c ∨ R c.snd c := by
    simpa [R, isInitialCall, Bool.or_eq_true] using hinit
  exact hbound.2 htightR c hc hRor

theorem tight_final_filter_forces_both_endpoints{m : ℕ} (S : List (Call m)) (hparticipates : ∀ k : Fin m, 0 < v S k)
  (htight : m = 2 * (S.filter (fun c => isFinalCall S c)).length) :
  ∀ c ∈ S, isFinalCall S c = true →
    isAgentFinalCall S c.fst c = true ∧ isAgentFinalCall S c.snd c = true := by
  classical
  have hex (k : Fin m) : ∃ c ∈ S, c.fst = k ∨ c.snd = k :=
    (positive_participation_iff_incident_call S k).mp (hparticipates k)
  let R : Fin m → Call m → Prop := fun k c => isAgentFinalCall S k c = true
  have hcover : ∀ k : Fin m, ∃ c ∈ S, R k c := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨d, hdS, hd⟩ := hex k
    have hdrev : d ∈ S.reverse := by simpa using hdS
    have hisSome : (S.reverse.find? (fun c => decide (c.fst = k ∨ c.snd = k))).isSome = true :=
      List.find?_isSome.mpr ⟨d, hdrev, by simpa using hd⟩
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp hisSome
    refine ⟨e, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have herev : e ∈ S.reverse := List.mem_of_find?_eq_some he
      simpa using herev
    · simp only [R, isAgentFinalCall, final, decide_eq_true_eq]
      exact he
  have hendpoint : ∀ k c, R k c → k = c.fst ∨ k = c.snd := by
    intro k c hk
    simp only [R, isAgentFinalCall, decide_eq_true_eq] at hk
    have hp := List.find?_some hk
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at hp
    exact hp.elim (fun h => Or.inl h.symm) (fun h => Or.inr h.symm)
  have hpair := pair_edge_cover_bound_and_tightness S R (fun k c => inferInstance) hcover hendpoint
  have htight' : Fintype.card (Fin m) =
      2 * (S.filter (fun c => decide (R c.fst c ∨ R c.snd c))).length := by
    simpa [R, isFinalCall] using htight
  intro c hc hfinal
  exact hpair.2 htight' c hc (by simpa [R, isFinalCall] using hfinal)

theorem call_mem_implies_mutual_knowledge_after{m : ℕ} (T : List (Call m)) (c : Call m) (hc : c ∈ T) :
  (after T) c.fst c.snd ∧ (after T) c.snd c.fst := by
  rcases c with ⟨a, b⟩
  obtain ⟨xs, ys, rfl⟩ := List.append_of_mem hc
  have haa : makeCalls (initialState m) xs a a := by
    apply callsIncreaseGossip (initialState m) xs a a
    rfl
  have hbb : makeCalls (initialState m) xs b b := by
    apply callsIncreaseGossip (initialState m) xs b b
    rfl
  have hab : makeCall (makeCalls (initialState m) xs) (a, b) a b := by
    simp [makeCall, hbb]
  have hba : makeCall (makeCalls (initialState m) xs) (a, b) b a := by
    by_cases h : b = a <;> simp [makeCall, h, haa]
  constructor
  · have h := callsIncreaseGossip (makeCall (makeCalls (initialState m) xs) (a, b)) ys a b hab
    simpa [after, makeCalls] using h
  · have h := callsIncreaseGossip (makeCall (makeCalls (initialState m) xs) (a, b)) ys b a hba
    simpa [after, makeCalls] using h

theorem noHo_repeated_call_indices_are_adjacent{m : ℕ} (S : List (Call m)) (noHo_S : noHo S)
  (i j : Fin S.length) (hij : i < j) (hsame : S.get i = S.get j) :
  (j : ℕ) = (i : ℕ) + 1 := by
  have hle : (i : ℕ) + 1 ≤ (j : ℕ) := by omega
  apply Nat.le_antisymm
  · by_contra hnot
    have hgap : (i : ℕ) + 1 < (j : ℕ) := by omega
    have htake : (i : ℕ) < (S.take ((j : ℕ) - 1)).length := by
      simp only [List.length_take]
      omega
    let i' : Fin (S.take ((j : ℕ) - 1)).length := ⟨i, htake⟩
    have hmem' := List.get_mem (S.take ((j : ℕ) - 1)) i'
    have hget : (S.take ((j : ℕ) - 1)).get i' = S.get i := by
      simp [i']
    have hmem : S.get i ∈ S.take ((j : ℕ) - 1) := by
      rw [← hget]
      exact hmem'
    have hk := call_mem_implies_mutual_knowledge_after
      (S.take ((j : ℕ) - 1)) (S.get i) hmem
    have hno := noHo_S j
    rw [hsame] at hk
    exact (hno.1 hk.1).elim
  · exact hle

theorem list_countP_eq_card_satisfying_indices{α : Type*} (l : List α) (p : α → Bool) :
  l.countP p = ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin l.length)).filter (fun i => p (l.get i) = true)).card := by

        (n := l.length)

theorem agent_initial_and_final_participation_le_two{m : ℕ} (S : List (Call m)) (noHo_S : noHo S) (k : Fin m) (c : Call m)
  (hinit : isAgentInitialCall S k c = true)
  (hfinal : isAgentFinalCall S k c = true) :
  v S k ≤ 2 := by
  unfold isAgentInitialCall at hinit
  unfold isAgentFinalCall at hfinal
  unfold initial at hinit
  unfold final at hfinal
  unfold v
  simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at hinit hfinal
  rw [← List.ofFn_get S] at hinit
  rw [List.find?_ofFn_eq_some] at hinit
  rcases hinit with ⟨hc, i, hi, hbefore⟩
  rw [← List.ofFn_get S.reverse] at hfinal
  rw [List.find?_ofFn_eq_some] at hfinal
  rcases hfinal with ⟨hc', r, hr, hrevbefore⟩
  have hrlen : (r : ℕ) < S.length := by simpa using r.isLt
  have hjbound : S.length - 1 - (r : ℕ) < S.length := by omega
  let j : Fin S.length := ⟨S.length - 1 - (r : ℕ), hjbound⟩
  have hj : S.get j = c := by
    rw [← hr]
    exact (List.get_reverse' S r hjbound).symm
  have hleft : ∀ q : Fin S.length,
      decide ((S.get q).1 = k ∨ (S.get q).2 = k) = true → i ≤ q := by
    intro q hq
    by_contra hn
    exact hbefore q (lt_of_not_ge hn) hq
  have hright : ∀ q : Fin S.length,
      decide ((S.get q).1 = k ∨ (S.get q).2 = k) = true → q ≤ j := by
    intro q hq
    by_contra hn
    have hjq : j < q := lt_of_not_ge hn
    change S.length - 1 - (r : ℕ) < (q : ℕ) at hjq
    let rq : Fin S.reverse.length :=
      ⟨S.length - 1 - (q : ℕ), by
        simp only [List.length_reverse]
        omega⟩
    have hrqlt : rq < r := by
      change S.length - 1 - (q : ℕ) < (r : ℕ)
      omega
    have hbackbound : S.length - 1 - (rq : ℕ) < S.length := by
      dsimp [rq]
      omega
    have hgetrq : S.reverse.get rq = S.get q := by
      rw [List.get_reverse' S rq hbackbound]
      congr 1
      apply Fin.ext
      change S.length - 1 - (S.length - 1 - (q : ℕ)) = (q : ℕ)
      omega
    apply hrevbefore rq hrqlt
    rw [hgetrq]
    exact hq
  have hiSat : decide ((S.get i).1 = k ∨ (S.get i).2 = k) = true := by
    rw [hi]
    exact hc
  have hilej : i ≤ j := hright i hiSat
  have hj_le : (j : ℕ) ≤ (i : ℕ) + 1 := by
    by_cases heq : i = j
    · subst j
      omega
    · have hlt : i < j := lt_of_le_of_ne hilej heq
      exact (noHo_repeated_call_indices_are_adjacent S noHo_S i j hlt (hi.trans hj.symm)).le
  rw [list_countP_eq_card_satisfying_indices]
  refine le_trans (Finset.card_le_card ?_) (Finset.card_le_two (a := i) (b := j))
  intro q hq
  rw [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
  have hsat := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).2
  have hiq := hleft q hsat
  have hqj := hright q hsat
  omega

    omega

    omega

  have hle := agent_initial_and_final_participation_le_two S noHo_S c.fst c hini.1 hfin.1
  have hge := hdeg c.fst
  omega

theorem errFree_switch_resultSet_eq_of_missing{n} {S : @Dist n} {σ : @Sequence n} (hσ : errFree σ) (oσ : maxOne σ)
    {i b : @Agent n}
    (hmiss : (b, S b) ∉ resultSet i S ⟨σ, oσ⟩) :
    resultSet i (S.switch b) ⟨σ, oσ⟩ = resultSet i S ⟨σ, oσ⟩ := by
  induction σ generalizing i with
  | nil =>

      simp only [Dist.switch]
      split_ifs with hib
      · subst i
        simp at hmiss
      · rfl
    · intro hx

      simp only [Dist.switch]
      split_ifs with hib
      · subst i
        simp at hmiss
      · rfl
  | cons c σ ih =>
    cases c with
    | normal p q =>
      have htail : errFree σ := hσ
      rw [errFree_normal_resultSet_step htail oσ,
        errFree_normal_resultSet_step htail oσ]
      rw [errFree_normal_resultSet_step htail oσ] at hmiss
      by_cases hrole : roleOfIn i (Call.normal p q) = Role.Other
      · simp only [hrole, ↓reduceIte] at hmiss ⊢
        exact ih htail (⁻oσ) hmiss
      · simp only [hrole, ↓reduceIte] at hmiss ⊢
        simp only [Set.mem_union, not_or] at hmiss
        rw [ih htail (⁻oσ) hmiss.1, ih htail (⁻oσ) hmiss.2]
    | fstE p e q =>
      simp [errFree] at hσ
    | sndE p q e =>
      simp [errFree] at hσ

theorem errFree_switch_equiv_of_missing{n} {S : @Dist n} {σ : @Sequence n} (hσ : errFree σ) (oσ : maxOne σ)

  | nil =>
      simp only [equiv_nil]
      simp only [resultSet_nil, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Prod.mk.injEq] at hmiss
      simp only [Dist.switch]
      split_ifs with hab
      · subst b
        simp at hmiss
      · rfl
  | cons C σ IH =>
      cases C with
      | normal p q =>
          have hσ' : errFree σ := by simpa [errFree] using hσ
          rw [errFree_normal_resultSet_step hσ' (p := p) (q := q) (i := a) oσ] at hmiss
          cases hrole : roleOfIn a (Call.normal p q) with

              have hp := IH hσ' (⁻oσ) hmissp
              have hq := errFree_switch_resultSet_eq_of_missing hσ' (⁻oσ) hmissq
              unfold equiv
              constructor
              · exact hp
              · constructor
                · rfl

                  exact ⟨hq.symm, trivial⟩
          | Callee =>

              rcases hrole with ⟨hqp, ha⟩
              subst a
              have hcallee : roleOfIn q (Call.normal p q) = Role.Callee := by
                simp [roleOfIn, hqp]
              simp only [hcallee, reduceCtorEq, ↓reduceIte, Set.mem_union, not_or] at hmiss
              rcases hmiss with ⟨hmissp, hmissq⟩
              have hq := IH hσ' (⁻oσ) hmissq
              have hp := errFree_switch_resultSet_eq_of_missing hσ' (⁻oσ) hmissp
              unfold equiv
              constructor
              · exact hq
              · constructor
                · rfl
                · simp only [hcallee, contribSet, Call.pair]
                  exact ⟨hp.symm, trivial⟩
          | Other =>
              simp only [hrole, if_pos] at hmiss
              unfold equiv
              constructor
              · exact IH hσ' (⁻oσ) hmiss
              · exact ⟨rfl, by simp [hrole]⟩
      | fstE p e q => simp [errFree] at hσ
      | sndE p q e => simp [errFree] at hσ

  simp [Dist.switch, hSb] at hsw

      cases C <;> simp [errFree, eraseErrorsAt, eraseErrorAt] at *
      exact ih hfree

def collapseValueAt {n} (b : @Agent n) : @Value n → @Value n
  | (j, d) => if j = b then (j, false) else (j, d)

theorem errFree_has_no_wrong_values{n} {S : @Dist n} {i b : @Agent n} {σ : @Sequence n}
    (o : maxOne σ) (hfree : errFree σ) :
    (b, ! S b) ∉ resultSet i S ⟨σ, o⟩ := by
  induction σ generalizing i with
  | nil =>
      simp [resultSet]
      intro h
      subst i
      rfl
  | cons C σ ih =>
      cases C with
      | normal a c =>
          have htail : errFree σ := hfree
          cases hrole : roleOfIn i ⌜a c⌝ with
          | Caller =>
              unfold resultSet
              simp only [hrole]
              intro h
              rcases h.1.1 with h | h
              · exact ih (⁻o) htail h
              · exact ih (⁻o) htail h
          | Callee =>
              unfold resultSet
              simp only [hrole]
              intro h
              rcases h.1.1 with h | h
              · exact ih (⁻o) htail h
              · exact ih (⁻o) htail h
          | Other =>
              rw [not_in_call_then_invariant_resultSet hrole]
              exact ih (⁻o) htail
      | fstE a e c =>
          simp [errFree] at hfree
      | sndE a c e =>
          simp [errFree] at hfree

theorem errFree_resultSet_values_are_actual{n} {S : @Dist n} {i j : @Agent n} {d : Bool} {σ : @Sequence n}
    (o : maxOne σ) (hfree : errFree σ)
    (hmem : (j, d) ∈ resultSet i S ⟨σ, o⟩) : d = S j := by
  cases hd : d <;> cases hs : S j
  · rfl
  · exfalso
    apply errFree_has_no_wrong_values (S := S) (i := i) (b := j) o hfree
    simpa only [hd, hs, Bool.not_true] using hmem
  · exfalso
    apply errFree_has_no_wrong_values (S := S) (i := i) (b := j) o hfree
    simpa only [hd, hs, Bool.not_false] using hmem
  · rfl

theorem errFree_normal_call_is_pure_union{n} {S : @Dist n} {i a c : @Agent n} {σ : @Sequence n}
    (o : maxOne (Call.normal a c :: σ))
    (hfree : errFree (Call.normal a c :: σ))
    (hrole : roleOfIn i (Call.normal a c) ≠ Role.Other) :
    resultSet i S ⟨Call.normal a c :: σ, o⟩ =
      resultSet a S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ ∪ resultSet c S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
  apply Set.ext
  intro x
  rcases x with ⟨j, d⟩
  constructor
  · intro hmem
    cases hr : roleOfIn i (Call.normal a c) with
    | Caller =>
        simp [resultSet, hr] at hmem
        exact hmem.1.1
    | Callee =>
        simp [resultSet, hr] at hmem
        exact hmem.1.1
    | Other =>
        exact False.elim (hrole hr)
  · intro hmem
    have hfree_tail : errFree σ := by
      simpa [errFree] using hfree
    rcases hmem with ha | hc
    · have hd : d = S j :=
        errFree_resultSet_values_are_actual (⁻o) hfree_tail ha
      subst d
      apply actual_value_survives_one_call o
      cases hr : roleOfIn i (Call.normal a c) with
      | Caller => simpa [receivedSet, hr] using Or.inl ha
      | Callee => simpa [receivedSet, hr] using Or.inl ha
      | Other => exact False.elim (hrole hr)
    · have hd : d = S j :=
        errFree_resultSet_values_are_actual (⁻o) hfree_tail hc
      subst d
      apply actual_value_survives_one_call o
      cases hr : roleOfIn i (Call.normal a c) with
      | Caller => simpa [receivedSet, hr] using Or.inr hc
      | Callee => simpa [receivedSet, hr] using Or.inr hc
      | Other => exact False.elim (hrole hr)

theorem errFree_forceFalse_resultSet_normalization{n} {S : @Dist n} {b i : @Agent n} {σ : @Sequence n}
    (o : maxOne σ) (hfree : errFree σ) :
    resultSet i (forceFalseAt b S) ⟨σ, o⟩ =
      collapseValueAt b '' resultSet i S ⟨σ, o⟩ := by
  induction σ generalizing S i with
  | nil =>
      ext x
      rcases x with ⟨j, d⟩
      by_cases h : i = b <;> simp [forceFalseAt, collapseValueAt, h]
  | cons C σ ih =>
      cases C with
      | normal a c =>
          have hfree' : errFree σ := by
            simpa [errFree] using hfree
          cases hr : roleOfIn i (Call.normal a c) with
          | Other =>
              unfold resultSet
              rw [hr]
              exact ih (⁻o) hfree'
          | Caller =>
              have hrole : roleOfIn i (Call.normal a c) ≠ Role.Other := by
                simp [hr]
              rw [errFree_normal_call_is_pure_union o hfree hrole]
              rw [errFree_normal_call_is_pure_union o hfree hrole]
              rw [ih (⁻o) hfree', ih (⁻o) hfree', Set.image_union]
          | Callee =>
              have hrole : roleOfIn i (Call.normal a c) ≠ Role.Other := by
                simp [hr]
              rw [errFree_normal_call_is_pure_union o hfree hrole]
              rw [errFree_normal_call_is_pure_union o hfree hrole]
              rw [ih (⁻o) hfree', ih (⁻o) hfree', Set.image_union]
      | fstE a e c =>
          simp [errFree] at hfree
      | sndE a c e =>
          simp [errFree] at hfree

theorem invert_at_eq_collapse_image_of_false_absent{n} {b : @Agent n} {A : Set (@Value n)}
    (h : (b, false) ∉ A) :
    invert b A = collapseValueAt b '' A := by
  unfold invert
  apply Set.image_congr
  intro x hx
  rcases x with ⟨j, d⟩
  by_cases hj : j = b
  · subst j
    cases d
    · exact (h hx).elim
    · rfl
  · simp only [collapseValueAt, hj, ↓reduceIte]

theorem errFree_invert_eq_forceFalse_erased_resultSet{n} {S : @Dist n} {b i : @Agent n} {σ : @Sequence n}
    (o : maxOne σ) (hfree : errFree σ) (hSb : S b = true) :
    invert b (resultSet i S ⟨σ, o⟩) =
      resultSet i (forceFalseAt b S) (eraseErrorsOSequence b ⟨σ, o⟩) := by
  have herase : eraseErrorsAt b σ = σ :=
    eraseErrorsAt_eq_self_of_errFree (b := b) hfree
  have hwrong : (b, false) ∉ resultSet i S ⟨σ, o⟩ := by
    simpa only [hSb, Bool.not_true] using
      (errFree_has_no_wrong_values (S := S) (i := i) (b := b) o hfree)
  have hinv := invert_at_eq_collapse_image_of_false_absent hwrong
  have hnorm :=
    errFree_forceFalse_resultSet_normalization (S := S) (b := b) (i := i) o hfree
  have heraseO : eraseErrorsOSequence b ⟨σ, o⟩ = ⟨σ, o⟩ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact herase
  rw [heraseO]
  exact hinv.trans hnorm.symm

theorem forceFalse_fstE_step_equi{n} {S : @Dist n} {b i a e c : @Agent n} {σ : @Sequence n}
    (o : maxOne (Call.fstE a e c :: σ))
    (hSb : S b = true)
    (hIH : ∀ j : @Agent n,
      (b, true) ∉ resultSet j S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ →
      equi j (S, ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩)
        (forceFalseAt b S, eraseErrorsOSequence b ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩))
    (habs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet i S ⟨Call.fstE a e c :: σ, o⟩) :
    equi i (S, ⟨Call.fstE a e c :: σ, o⟩)
      (forceFalseAt b S, eraseErrorsOSequence b ⟨Call.fstE a e c :: σ, o⟩) := by
  by_cases he : e = b
  · subst e
    cases hr : roleOfIn i (Call.fstE a b c)
    · have hi : i = a := by simpa using hr
      subst i
      have ha_abs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet a S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
        intro hmem
        apply habs
        have hsurv := actual_value_survives_one_call (S := S) (i := a) o
          (show (b, S b) ∈ receivedSet a S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ (Call.fstE a b c) by
            simp [receivedSet, roleOfIn, hSb, hmem])
        simpa [hSb] using hsurv
      have hc_abs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet c S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
        intro hmem
        apply habs
        have hsurv := actual_value_survives_one_call (S := S) (i := a) o
          (show (b, S b) ∈ receivedSet a S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ (Call.fstE a b c) by
            simp [receivedSet, roleOfIn, hSb, hmem])
        simpa [hSb] using hsurv
      have hrec := hIH a ha_abs
      have hceq := indistinguishable_then_same_values (hIH c hc_abs)
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · simp [eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt, eraseErrorAt, OSequence.length]
      · simp only [eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt, eraseErrorAt, List.map, equiv]
        refine ⟨equiv_of_equi hrec, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simp [roleOfIn]
        · simpa [roleOfIn, contribSet, Call.pair] using hceq
    · have hrole : i ≠ a ∧ i = c := by simpa using hr
      rcases hrole with ⟨hia, hic⟩
      subst i
      have hfree : errFree σ := by simpa [maxOne] using o
      have hcontrib := errFree_invert_eq_forceFalse_erased_resultSet
        (S := S) (b := b) (i := a) (⁻o) hfree hSb
      have hc_abs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet c S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
        intro hmem
        apply habs
        have hsurv := actual_value_survives_one_call (S := S) (i := c) o
          (show (b, S b) ∈ receivedSet c S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ (Call.fstE a b c) by
            simp [receivedSet, roleOfIn, hia, hSb, hmem])
        simpa [hSb] using hsurv
      have hrec := hIH c hc_abs
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · simp [eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt, eraseErrorAt, OSequence.length]
      · simp only [eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt, eraseErrorAt, List.map, equiv]
        refine ⟨equiv_of_equi hrec, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simp [roleOfIn, hia]
        · simpa [roleOfIn, hia, contribSet, Call.pair] using hcontrib
    · have hi_abs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet i S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
        simpa [resultSet, hr] using habs
      have hrec := hIH i hi_abs
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · simp [eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt, eraseErrorAt, OSequence.length]
      · simp only [eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt, eraseErrorAt, List.map, equiv]
        refine ⟨equiv_of_equi hrec, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simpa [roleOfIn] using hr.symm
        · simp [hr]
  · cases hr : roleOfIn i (Call.fstE a e c)
    · have hi : i = a := by simpa using hr
      subst i
      have ha_abs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet a S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
        intro hmem
        apply habs
        have hsurv := actual_value_survives_one_call (S := S) (i := a) o
          (show (b, S b) ∈ receivedSet a S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ (Call.fstE a e c) by
            simp [receivedSet, roleOfIn, hSb, hmem])
        simpa [hSb] using hsurv
      have hc_abs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet c S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
        intro hmem
        apply habs
        have hsurv := actual_value_survives_one_call (S := S) (i := a) o
          (show (b, S b) ∈ receivedSet a S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ (Call.fstE a e c) by
            simp [receivedSet, roleOfIn, hSb, hmem])
        simpa [hSb] using hsurv
      have hrec := hIH a ha_abs
      have hceq := indistinguishable_then_same_values (hIH c hc_abs)
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · simp [eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt, eraseErrorAt, OSequence.length, he]
      · simp only [eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt, eraseErrorAt, he, List.map, equiv]
        refine ⟨equiv_of_equi hrec, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simp [roleOfIn]
        · simpa [roleOfIn, contribSet, Call.pair] using hceq
    · have hrole : i ≠ a ∧ i = c := by simpa using hr
      rcases hrole with ⟨hia, hic⟩
      subst i
      have htail : (b, true) ∉ resultSet c S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
        intro hmem
        apply habs
        have hsurv := actual_value_survives_one_call (S := S) (i := c) o
          (show (b, S b) ∈ receivedSet c S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ (Call.fstE a e c) by
            simp [receivedSet, roleOfIn, hia, hSb, hmem])
        simpa [hSb] using hsurv
      have hrec := hIH c htail
      have htaila : (b, true) ∉ resultSet a S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
        intro hmem
        apply habs
        have hinv : (b, true) ∈ invert e (resultSet a S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩) :=
          (invert_preserves_other_agent_membership (d := true)
            (A := resultSet a S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩) he).2 hmem
        have hsurv := actual_value_survives_one_call (S := S) (i := c) o
          (show (b, S b) ∈ receivedSet c S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ (Call.fstE a e c) by
            simp [receivedSet, roleOfIn, hia, hSb, hinv])
        simpa [hSb] using hsurv
      have haeq := indistinguishable_then_same_values (hIH a htaila)
      have hinveq := congrArg (invert e) haeq
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · simp [eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt, eraseErrorAt, OSequence.length, he]
      · simp only [eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt, eraseErrorAt, he, List.map, equiv]
        refine ⟨equiv_of_equi hrec, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simp [roleOfIn, hia]
        · simpa [roleOfIn, hia, contribSet, Call.pair] using hinveq
    · have hi_abs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet i S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
        simpa [resultSet, hr] using habs
      have hrec := hIH i hi_abs
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · simp [eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt, eraseErrorAt, OSequence.length, he]
      · simp only [eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt, eraseErrorAt, he, List.map, equiv]
        refine ⟨equiv_of_equi hrec, ?_, ?_⟩
        · exact rfl
        · simp [hr]

theorem forceFalse_sndE_step_equi{n} {S : @Dist n} {b i a c e : @Agent n} {σ : @Sequence n}
    (o : maxOne (Call.sndE a c e :: σ))
    (hSb : S b = true)
    (hIH : ∀ j : @Agent n,
      (b, true) ∉ resultSet j S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ →
      equi j (S, ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩)
        (forceFalseAt b S, eraseErrorsOSequence b ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩))
    (habs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet i S ⟨Call.sndE a c e :: σ, o⟩) :
    equi i (S, ⟨Call.sndE a c e :: σ, o⟩)
      (forceFalseAt b S, eraseErrorsOSequence b ⟨Call.sndE a c e :: σ, o⟩) := by
  have hrecv_abs : (b, true) ∉ receivedSet i S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ (Call.sndE a c e) := by
    intro hmem
    apply habs
    have hs := @actual_value_survives_one_call n S i b σ (Call.sndE a c e) o
      (by simpa only [hSb] using hmem)
    simpa only [hSb] using hs
  unfold equi
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt]
  · by_cases heb : e = b
    · subst e
      have hfree : errFree σ := by simpa [maxOne] using o
      unfold equiv
      simp only [eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt, List.map_cons, eraseErrorAt,
        ↓reduceIte]
      cases hr : roleOfIn i (Call.sndE a c b) with
      | Caller =>
          have hi : i = a := roleOfIn_sndE_eq_Caller_iff.mp hr
          subst i
          have hrecv : (b, true) ∉
              resultSet a S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ ∪ invert b (resultSet c S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩) := by
            simpa only [receivedSet, hr] using hrecv_abs
          have ha_abs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet a S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
            intro hm
            exact hrecv (Or.inl hm)
          have hcontrib :=
            errFree_invert_eq_forceFalse_erased_resultSet (S := S) (b := b) (i := c)
              (⁻o) hfree hSb
          refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · exact equiv_of_equi (hIH a ha_abs)
          · simp [roleOfIn]
          · simpa [contribSet, Call.pair, eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt] using hcontrib
      | Callee =>
          rcases roleOfIn_sndE_eq_Callee_iff.mp hr with ⟨hia, hic⟩
          subst i
          have hrecv : (b, true) ∉
              resultSet a S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ ∪ resultSet c S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
            simpa only [receivedSet, hr] using hrecv_abs
          have ha_abs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet a S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
            intro hm
            exact hrecv (Or.inl hm)
          have hc_abs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet c S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
            intro hm
            exact hrecv (Or.inr hm)
          have hsame_a := indistinguishable_then_same_values (hIH a ha_abs)
          refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · exact equiv_of_equi (hIH c hc_abs)
          · simp [roleOfIn, hia]
          · simpa [contribSet, Call.pair, eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt] using hsame_a
      | Other =>
          have hi_abs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet i S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
            simpa only [receivedSet, hr] using hrecv_abs
          refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · exact equiv_of_equi (hIH i hi_abs)
          · simpa [roleOfIn] using hr.symm
          · simp only
    · unfold equiv
      simp only [eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt, List.map_cons, heb, ↓reduceIte]
      cases hr : roleOfIn i (Call.sndE a c e) with
      | Caller =>
          have hi : i = a := roleOfIn_sndE_eq_Caller_iff.mp hr
          subst i
          have hrecv : (b, true) ∉
              resultSet a S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ ∪ invert e (resultSet c S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩) := by
            simpa only [receivedSet, hr] using hrecv_abs
          have ha_abs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet a S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
            intro hm
            exact hrecv (Or.inl hm)
          have hcinv_abs : (b, true) ∉ invert e (resultSet c S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩) := by
            intro hm
            exact hrecv (Or.inr hm)
          have hc_abs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet c S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
            intro hm
            apply hcinv_abs
            exact (invert_preserves_other_agent_membership (d := true) heb).mpr hm
          have hsame_c := indistinguishable_then_same_values (hIH c hc_abs)
          refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · exact equiv_of_equi (hIH a ha_abs)
          · simp [eraseErrorAt, heb, roleOfIn]
          · simpa [contribSet, eraseErrorAt, heb, Call.pair,
              eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt] using congrArg (invert e) hsame_c
      | Callee =>
          rcases roleOfIn_sndE_eq_Callee_iff.mp hr with ⟨hia, hic⟩
          subst i
          have hrecv : (b, true) ∉
              resultSet a S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ ∪ resultSet c S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
            simpa only [receivedSet, hr] using hrecv_abs
          have ha_abs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet a S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
            intro hm
            exact hrecv (Or.inl hm)
          have hc_abs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet c S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
            intro hm
            exact hrecv (Or.inr hm)
          have hsame_a := indistinguishable_then_same_values (hIH a ha_abs)
          refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · exact equiv_of_equi (hIH c hc_abs)
          · simp [eraseErrorAt, heb, roleOfIn, hia]
          · simpa [contribSet, eraseErrorAt, heb, Call.pair,
              eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt] using hsame_a
      | Other =>
          have hi_abs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet i S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
            simpa only [receivedSet, hr] using hrecv_abs
          refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
          · exact equiv_of_equi (hIH i hi_abs)
          · simpa [eraseErrorAt, heb, roleOfIn] using hr.symm
          · simp only

theorem forceFalse_eraseErrors_equi_of_true_absent{n} {S : @Dist n} {b i : @Agent n} {σ : @OSequence n}
    (hSb : S b = true)
    (habs : (b, true) ∉ resultSet i S σ) :
    equi i (S, σ) (forceFalseAt b S, eraseErrorsOSequence b σ) := by
  rcases σ with ⟨σ, o⟩
  induction σ generalizing S i with
  | nil =>
      have hib : i ≠ b := by
        intro h
        subst i
        simp [resultSet, hSb] at habs
      unfold equi
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · simp [OSequence.length, eraseErrorsOSequence, eraseErrorsAt]
      · simp only [Prod.fst, Prod.snd]
        unfold eraseErrorsOSequence eraseErrorsAt
        simp only [List.map_nil]
        rw [equiv_nil]
        simp [forceFalseAt, hib]
  | cons C σ ih =>
      have htail : (b, true) ∉ resultSet i S ⟨σ, ⁻o⟩ := by
        intro hb
        apply habs
        rw [← hSb]
        apply actual_value_survives_one_call o
        unfold receivedSet
        cases C <;> cases hr : roleOfIn i _ <;> simp_all
      cases C with
      | normal a c =>
          exact forceFalse_normal_step_equi (S := S) (b := b) o hSb
            (fun j hj => ih hSb (⁻o) hj) habs
      | fstE a e c =>
          exact forceFalse_fstE_step_equi (S := S) (b := b) o hSb
            (fun j hj => ih hSb (⁻o) hj) habs
      | sndE a c e =>
          exact forceFalse_sndE_step_equi (S := S) (b := b) o hSb
            (fun j hj => ih hSb (⁻o) hj) habs

theorem normal_source_amalgamation{n} {S : @Dist n} {a b c : @Agent n} {σ : @Sequence n} (o : maxOne σ)
    (hSb : S b = true)
    (a_not_know_t : ¬ eval S ⟨σ, o⟩ (Form.K a (Form.Has b (b, true))))
    (ha : (b, true) ∉ resultSet a S ⟨σ, o⟩)
    (hc : (b, true) ∉ resultSet c S ⟨σ, o⟩) :
    ∃ (T : @Dist n) (τ : @OSequence n) (hτ : OSequence.length τ = σ.length),
      equiv a (S, ⟨⟨σ, o⟩, rfl⟩) (T, ⟨τ, hτ⟩) ∧
      T b = false ∧ resultSet c T τ = resultSet c S ⟨σ, o⟩ := by
  classical
  let τ : @OSequence n := eraseErrorsOSequence b ⟨σ, o⟩

def gossipRelComp {n : ℕ} (r s : GossipState n) : GossipState n :=
  fun i k => ∃ j, r i j ∧ s j k

def gossipTranspose {n : ℕ} (s : GossipState n) : GossipState n :=
  fun i j => s j i

def singleCallRel {n : ℕ} (c : Call n) : GossipState n :=
  fun i j => i = j ∨ (i = c.fst ∧ j = c.snd) ∨ (i = c.snd ∧ j = c.fst)

theorem makeCall_eq_relComp{n : ℕ} (s : GossipState n) (c : Call n) : makeCall s c = gossipRelComp (singleCallRel c) s := by
  funext i k
  unfold makeCall gossipRelComp singleCallRel
  by_cases hif : i = c.fst
  · simp [hif]
    aesop
  · by_cases his : i = c.snd
    · simp [his]
      aesop
    · simp [hif, his]

theorem gossipRelComp_assoc{n : ℕ} (r s t : GossipState n) : gossipRelComp (gossipRelComp r s) t = gossipRelComp r (gossipRelComp s t) := by
  funext i k
  apply propext
  unfold gossipRelComp
  aesop

theorem gossipTranspose_relComp{n : ℕ} (r s : GossipState n) : gossipTranspose (gossipRelComp r s) = gossipRelComp (gossipTranspose s) (gossipTranspose r) := by
  funext i k

  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j, hr, hs⟩
    exact ⟨j, hs, hr⟩
  · rintro ⟨j, hs, hr⟩
    exact ⟨j, hr, hs⟩

theorem singleCallRel_transpose{n : ℕ} (c : Call n) : gossipTranspose (singleCallRel c) = singleCallRel c := by

  aesop

theorem after_append_relComp{n : ℕ} (S T : List (Call n)) : after (S ++ T) = gossipRelComp (after T) (after S) := by
  induction T using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil =>
      ext i k
      simp [after, makeCalls, gossipRelComp, initialState]
  | append_singleton T c ih =>
      rw [← List.append_assoc]
      change makeCalls (initialState n) ((S ++ T) ++ [c]) =
        gossipRelComp (makeCalls (initialState n) (T ++ [c]))
          (makeCalls (initialState n) S)
      change makeCalls (initialState n) (S ++ T) =
        gossipRelComp (makeCalls (initialState n) T)
          (makeCalls (initialState n) S) at ih
      rw [makeCalls_snoc, makeCalls_snoc]
      rw [makeCall_eq_relComp, makeCall_eq_relComp, ih]
      rw [gossipRelComp_assoc]

theorem after_reverse_transpose{n : ℕ} (S : List (Call n)) : after S.reverse = gossipTranspose (after S) := by
  induction S using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil =>
      funext i j
      simp [after, makeCalls, initialState, gossipTranspose, eq_comm]
  | append_singleton S c ih =>
      rw [List.reverse_append, after_append_relComp, after_append_relComp,
        gossipTranspose_relComp, ih]
      have hc : after [c].reverse = gossipTranspose (after [c]) := by
        rcases c with ⟨a, b⟩
        rw [List.reverse_singleton]
        funext i j
        change makeCall (initialState n) (a, b) i j =
          makeCall (initialState n) (a, b) j i
        simp only [makeCall, initialState]
        split_ifs <;> simp_all [eq_comm]
      rw [hc]

theorem makeCalls_nonparticipant_row{n : ℕ} (s : GossipState n) (S : List (Call n)) (k j : Fin n)

  | cons c S ih =>

theorem every_agent_occurs_of_allExpert{n : ℕ} (hn : 1 < n) (S : List (Call n)) (hExp : allExpert (after S)) (k : Fin n) :
  ∃ c ∈ S, c.fst = k ∨ c.snd = k := by

  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Fintype.exists_ne_of_one_lt_card (α := Fin n) (by

def callEndpoints {n : ℕ} (L : List (Call n)) : List (Fin n) :=
  L.flatMap (fun c => [c.fst, c.snd])

theorem callEndpoints_length{n : ℕ} (L : List (Call n)) : (callEndpoints L).length = 2 * L.length := by
  induction L with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons c L ih =>
      simp [callEndpoints, ih]
      omega

theorem length_lower_bound_of_endpoints_cover{n : ℕ} (L : List (Call n)) (hcover : ∀ k : Fin n, k ∈ callEndpoints L) : n ≤ 2 * L.length := by
  have hfinset : (callEndpoints L).toFinset = Finset.univ := by
    ext k
    simp only [List.mem_toFinset, Finset.mem_univ, iff_true]
    exact hcover k
  calc
    n = Fintype.card (Fin n) := by simp
    _ = (callEndpoints L).toFinset.card := by rw [hfinset]; simp
    _ ≤ (callEndpoints L).length := List.toFinset_card_le (callEndpoints L)
    _ = 2 * L.length := callEndpoints_length L

theorem initial_call_exists_of_occurs{n : ℕ} (S : List (Call n)) (k : Fin n)
  (hocc : ∃ c ∈ S, c.fst = k ∨ c.snd = k) :
  ∃ c ∈ S, initial S k = some c ∧ (c.fst = k ∨ c.snd = k) := by
  induction S with
  | nil =>
      simp at hocc
  | cons a S ih =>
      by_cases ha : a.fst = k ∨ a.snd = k
      · exact ⟨a, by simp, by simp [initial, ha], ha⟩
      · have htail : ∃ c ∈ S, c.fst = k ∨ c.snd = k := by
          rcases hocc with ⟨c, hc, hck⟩
          simp at hc
          rcases hc with rfl | hc
          · exact False.elim (ha hck)
          · exact ⟨c, hc, hck⟩
        rcases ih htail with ⟨c, hc, hcS, hck⟩
        exact ⟨c, by simp [hc], by simpa [initial, ha] using hcS, hck⟩

theorem initial_filtered_endpoints_cover{n : ℕ} (S : List (Call n))
  (hocc : ∀ k : Fin n, ∃ c ∈ S, c.fst = k ∨ c.snd = k) :
  ∀ k : Fin n, k ∈ callEndpoints (List.filter (fun c : Call n => isInitialCall S c) S) := by
  intro k
  obtain ⟨⟨a, b⟩, habS, hc, hk⟩ := initial_call_exists_of_occurs S k (hocc k)
  rcases hk with rfl | rfl
  · unfold callEndpoints
    simp only [List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_filter]
    refine ⟨(a, b), ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact ⟨habS, by simp [isInitialCall, isAgentInitialCall, hc]⟩
    · simp
  · unfold callEndpoints
    simp only [List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_filter]
    refine ⟨(a, b), ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact ⟨habS, by simp [isInitialCall, isAgentInitialCall, hc]⟩
    · simp

theorem initial_filter_length_lower_bound{n : ℕ} (hn : 1 < n) (S : List (Call n)) (hExp : allExpert (after S)) :
  n ≤ 2 * (List.filter (fun c : Call n => isInitialCall S c) S).length := by
  apply length_lower_bound_of_endpoints_cover
  apply initial_filtered_endpoints_cover
  exact every_agent_occurs_of_allExpert hn S hExp

theorem final_filter_length_lower_bound{n : ℕ} (hn : 1 < n) (S : List (Call n)) (hExp : allExpert (after S)) :
  n ≤ 2 * (List.filter (fun c : Call n => isFinalCall S c) S).length := by
  rw [final_filter_length_eq_reverse_initial_filter_length S]

theorem noHo_call_endpoints_ne{m : ℕ} (T : List (Call m)) (hno : noHo T) (c : Call m) (hc : c ∈ T) : c.fst ≠ c.snd := by

theorem duplicate_final_endpoint_decomposition{m : ℕ} (S : List (Call m)) (noHo_S : noHo S)
  (hdup : ¬(callEndpoints (List.filter (fun c : Call m => isFinalCall S c) S)).Nodup) :
  ∃ (A Q B : List (Call m)) (c d : Call m),
    S = A ++ c :: Q ++ d :: B ∧
    isFinalCall S c = true ∧ isFinalCall S d = true ∧
    (c.fst = d.fst ∨ c.fst = d.snd ∨ c.snd = d.fst ∨ c.snd = d.snd) := by
  let p : Call m → Bool := fun c => isFinalCall S c
  have mem_aux : ∀ (R : List (Call m)) (x : Fin m),
      x ∈ callEndpoints (R.filter p) →
      ∃ (A B : List (Call m)) (d : Call m),
        R = A ++ d :: B ∧ p d = true ∧ (x = d.fst ∨ x = d.snd) := by
    intro R x hx
    induction R with
    | nil => simp [callEndpoints] at hx
    | cons a R ih =>
      by_cases ha : p a = true
      · have hx' : x ∈ [a.fst, a.snd] ++ callEndpoints (R.filter p) := by
          simpa only [List.filter_cons, ha, if_true, callEndpoints, List.flatMap_cons] using hx

          List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hx'
        rcases hx' with (hxa | hxa) | hxR
        · exact ⟨[], R, a, rfl, ha, Or.inl hxa⟩
        · exact ⟨[], R, a, rfl, ha, Or.inr hxa⟩
        · obtain ⟨A, B, d, hR, hd, hxd⟩ := ih hxR
          exact ⟨a :: A, B, d, by simp [hR], hd, hxd⟩

        have hx' : x ∈ callEndpoints (R.filter p) := by
          simpa only [List.filter_cons, ha', Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] using hx
        obtain ⟨A, B, d, hR, hd, hxd⟩ := ih hx'
        exact ⟨a :: A, B, d, by simp [hR], hd, hxd⟩
  have aux : ∀ R : List (Call m),
      (∀ c ∈ R, c.fst ≠ c.snd) →
      ¬ (callEndpoints (R.filter p)).Nodup →
      ∃ (A Q B : List (Call m)) (c d : Call m),
        R = A ++ c :: Q ++ d :: B ∧
        p c = true ∧ p d = true ∧
        (c.fst = d.fst ∨ c.fst = d.snd ∨ c.snd = d.fst ∨ c.snd = d.snd) := by
    intro R hne hbad
    induction R with
    | nil => simp [callEndpoints] at hbad
    | cons a R ih =>
      have hne_a : a.fst ≠ a.snd := hne a (by simp)
      have hne_R : ∀ c ∈ R, c.fst ≠ c.snd := by
        intro c hc
        exact hne c (by simp [hc])
      by_cases ha : p a = true
      · have hbad' : ¬ (a.fst :: a.snd :: callEndpoints (R.filter p)).Nodup := by
          simpa only [List.filter_cons, ha, if_true, callEndpoints, List.flatMap_cons] using hbad
        by_cases hfst : a.fst ∈ a.snd :: callEndpoints (R.filter p)
        · rcases List.mem_cons.mp hfst with heq | hmem
          · exact False.elim (hne_a heq)
          · obtain ⟨Q, B, d, hR, hd, hshare⟩ := mem_aux R a.fst hmem
            exact ⟨[], Q, B, a, d, by simp [hR], ha, hd,
              hshare.elim Or.inl (fun h => Or.inr (Or.inl h))⟩
        · by_cases hsnd : a.snd ∈ callEndpoints (R.filter p)
          · obtain ⟨Q, B, d, hR, hd, hshare⟩ := mem_aux R a.snd hsnd
            exact ⟨[], Q, B, a, d, by simp [hR], ha, hd,
              hshare.elim (fun h => Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl h)))
                (fun h => Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr h)))⟩
          · have hbadR : ¬ (callEndpoints (R.filter p)).Nodup := by
              intro hgood
              exact hbad' (List.Nodup.cons hfst (List.Nodup.cons hsnd hgood))

            exact ⟨a :: A, Q, B, c, d, by simp [hR], hc, hd, hshare⟩
      · have ha' : p a = false := Bool.eq_false_of_not_eq_true ha
        have hbadR : ¬ (callEndpoints (R.filter p)).Nodup := by
          simpa only [List.filter_cons, ha', Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] using hbad
        obtain ⟨A, Q, B, c, d, hR, hc, hd, hshare⟩ := ih hne_R hbadR
        exact ⟨a :: A, Q, B, c, d, by simp [hR], hc, hd, hshare⟩

  · intro c hc
    exact noHo_call_endpoints_ne S noHo_S c hc

theorem noHo_repeated_call_gap_empty{m : ℕ} (A Q B : List (Call m)) (c : Call m)

        simp [i]
