      have hopt : (A ++ c :: q :: R ++ c :: B)[i.val]? = some c := by
        rw [hi_val]
        simp
      have hget : (A ++ c :: q :: R ++ c :: B)[i] = c := by
        apply Option.some.inj
        rw [← hopt]
        simp
      let P : List (Call m) := A ++ c :: (q :: R).take R.length
      have hP_len : P.length = i.val - 1 := by
        simp [P, i]
        omega
      have hdecomp : A ++ c :: q :: R ++ c :: B =
          P ++ ((q :: R).drop R.length ++ c :: B) := by
        unfold P
        simp only [List.cons_append, List.append_assoc]
        apply congrArg (fun xs => A ++ c :: xs)
        rw [← List.append_assoc, List.take_append_drop]
        rfl
      have htake : (A ++ c :: q :: R ++ c :: B).take (i.val - 1) = P := by
        rw [← hP_len]
        calc
          (A ++ c :: q :: R ++ c :: B).take P.length =
              (P ++ ((q :: R).drop R.length ++ c :: B)).take P.length :=
            congrArg (List.take P.length) hdecomp
          _ = P := by simp
      rw [htake, hget] at hi
      rcases c with ⟨a, b⟩
      have hbbA : after A b b :=
        (callsIncreaseGossip (initialState m) A) b b rfl
      have hcall : makeCall (after A) (a, b) a b := by
        simp [makeCall, hbbA]
      have hpersist :
          makeCalls (makeCall (after A) (a, b)) ((q :: R).take R.length) a b :=
        (callsIncreaseGossip (makeCall (after A) (a, b)) ((q :: R).take R.length)) a b hcall
      have hknow : after P a b := by
        simpa [P, after, makeCalls] using hpersist
      exact hi.1 hknow

theorem final_endpoint_tail_structure{m : ℕ} (S A T : List (Call m)) (c : Call m) (k : Fin m)
  (hS : S = A ++ c :: T) (hck : c.fst = k ∨ c.snd = k)
  (hfinal : isAgentFinalCall S k c = true) (hno : noHo S) :
  (∀ d ∈ T, d.fst ≠ k ∧ d.snd ≠ k) ∨
  ∃ B, T = c :: B ∧ ∀ d ∈ B, d.fst ≠ k ∧ d.snd ≠ k := by
  subst S
  unfold isAgentFinalCall at hfinal
  simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at hfinal
  unfold final at hfinal
  let p : Call m → Bool := fun d => decide (d.fst = k ∨ d.snd = k)
  have hpc : p c = true := by
    simp only [p, decide_eq_true_eq]
    exact hck
  have hfind : List.find? p (T.reverse ++ c :: A.reverse) = some c := by
    simpa only [p, List.reverse_append, List.reverse_cons, List.reverse_nil,
      List.nil_append, List.append_assoc, List.cons_append] using hfinal
  have find_later : ∀ U R : List (Call m),
      List.find? p (U ++ R) = some c →
      (∀ d ∈ U, p d = false) ∨
        ∃ P Q, U = P ++ c :: Q ∧ ∀ d ∈ P, p d = false := by
    intro U
    induction U with
    | nil =>
        intro R h
        left
        simp
    | cons d U ih =>
        intro R h
        by_cases hd : p d = true
        · right
          have hdc : d = c := by
            apply Option.some.inj
            simpa only [List.cons_append, List.find?_cons, hd, Bool.true_eq] using h
          subst d
          exact ⟨[], U, by simp, by simp⟩
        · have hd0 : p d = false := by
            cases hpd : p d <;> simp_all
          have htail : List.find? p (U ++ R) = some c := by
            simpa only [List.cons_append, List.find?_cons, hd0, Bool.false_eq] using h
          rcases ih R htail with hall | ⟨P, Q, hU, hP⟩
          · left
            intro x hx
            simp only [List.mem_cons] at hx
            rcases hx with rfl | hx
            · exact hd0
            · exact hall x hx
          · right
            exact ⟨d :: P, Q, by simp only [List.cons_append, hU], by
              intro x hx
              simp only [List.mem_cons] at hx
              rcases hx with rfl | hx
              · exact hd0
              · exact hP x hx⟩
  rcases find_later T.reverse (c :: A.reverse) hfind with hall | ⟨P, Q, hrev, hP⟩
  · left
    intro d hd
    have hdrev : d ∈ T.reverse := by simpa using hd
    have hp0 := hall d hdrev
    simp only [p, decide_eq_false_iff_not] at hp0
    push_neg at hp0
    exact hp0
  · have hT : T = Q.reverse ++ c :: P.reverse := by
      rw [← List.reverse_reverse T, hrev]
      simp only [List.reverse_append, List.reverse_cons, List.reverse_reverse,
        List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
    have hgap : Q.reverse = [] := by
      apply noHo_repeated_call_gap_empty A Q.reverse P.reverse c
      rw [hT] at hno
      simpa only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append] using hno
    have hQ : Q = [] := by simpa using hgap
    subst Q
    right
    refine ⟨P.reverse, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [hT, List.reverse_nil, List.nil_append]
    · intro d hd
      have hdP : d ∈ P := by simpa using hd
      have hp0 := hP d hdP
      simp only [p, decide_eq_false_iff_not] at hp0
      push_neg at hp0
      exact hp0

theorem final_endpoint_expert_after_call{m : ℕ} (S A T : List (Call m)) (c : Call m) (k : Fin m)
  (hS : S = A ++ c :: T) (hck : c.fst = k ∨ c.snd = k)
  (hfinal : isAgentFinalCall S k c = true)
  (hExp : allExpert (after S)) (hno : noHo S) :
  isExpert (after (A ++ [c])) k := by
  rcases final_endpoint_tail_structure S A T c k hS hck hfinal hno with hT | ⟨B, hTB, hB⟩
  · intro j
    have hfull : after S k j := hExp k j
    rw [hS] at hfull
    have htail : makeCalls (after (A ++ [c])) T k j := by
      simpa only [after, makeCalls, List.foldl_append, List.foldl_cons,
        List.foldl_nil] using hfull
    exact (makeCalls_nonparticipant_row (after (A ++ [c])) T k j hT).mp htail
  · intro j
    have hfull : after S k j := hExp k j
    rw [hS, hTB] at hfull
    have htail : makeCalls (after (A ++ [c])) B k j := by
      simpa only [after, makeCalls, List.foldl_append, List.foldl_cons,
        List.foldl_nil, makeCall_idempotent] using hfull
    exact (makeCalls_nonparticipant_row (after (A ++ [c])) B k j hB).mp htail

theorem makeCall_participant_expertise_iff{m : ℕ} (s : GossipState m) (c : Call m) :
  isExpert (makeCall s c) c.fst ↔ isExpert (makeCall s c) c.snd := by
  by_cases h : c.snd = c.fst <;> simp [isExpert, makeCall, h, or_comm]

theorem final_selected_call_makes_both_expert{m : ℕ} (S A T : List (Call m)) (c : Call m)
  (hS : S = A ++ c :: T) (hc : isFinalCall S c = true)
  (hExp : allExpert (after S)) (hno : noHo S) :
  isExpert (after (A ++ [c])) c.fst ∧ isExpert (after (A ++ [c])) c.snd := by
  unfold isFinalCall at hc
  have hc' : isAgentFinalCall S c.fst c = true ∨ isAgentFinalCall S c.snd c = true :=
    of_decide_eq_true hc
  rcases hc' with hfst | hsnd
  · have he1 : isExpert (after (A ++ [c])) c.fst :=
      final_endpoint_expert_after_call S A T c c.fst hS (Or.inl rfl) hfst hExp hno
    constructor
    · exact he1
    · unfold after at he1 ⊢
      rw [makeCalls_snoc] at he1 ⊢
      exact (makeCall_participant_expertise_iff (makeCalls (initialState m) A) c).mp he1
  · have he2 : isExpert (after (A ++ [c])) c.snd :=
      final_endpoint_expert_after_call S A T c c.snd hS (Or.inr rfl) hsnd hExp hno
    constructor
    · unfold after at he2 ⊢
      rw [makeCalls_snoc] at he2 ⊢
      exact (makeCall_participant_expertise_iff (makeCalls (initialState m) A) c).mpr he2
    · exact he2

theorem noHo_nonadjacent_later_call_has_no_expert_endpoint{m : ℕ} (A Q B : List (Call m)) (c d : Call m)
  (hQ : Q ≠ []) (hno : noHo (A ++ c :: Q ++ d :: B)) :
  ¬ isExpert (after (A ++ [c])) d.fst ∧ ¬ isExpert (after (A ++ [c])) d.snd := by
  rcases Q with _ | ⟨q, R⟩
  · exact (hQ rfl).elim
  · have htake :
        List.take (A.length + 1 + R.length) (A ++ c :: q :: (R ++ d :: B)) =
          (A ++ [c]) ++ (q :: R).take R.length := by
      rw [List.take_append]
      rw [List.take_of_length_le (by omega)]
      have hsub : A.length + 1 + R.length - A.length = R.length + 1 := by omega
      rw [hsub]
      simp only [List.take_succ_cons]
      have ht : List.take R.length (q :: (R ++ d :: B)) = List.take R.length (q :: R) := by
        change List.take R.length ((q :: R) ++ d :: B) = List.take R.length (q :: R)
        exact List.take_append_of_le_length (by simp)
      simp only [List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append]
      rw [ht]
    have hget :
        (A ++ c :: q :: (R ++ d :: B))[A.length + 1 + (R.length + 1)] = d := by
      have hget' := List.getElem_append_right' (A ++ c :: q :: R) (l₂ := d :: B) (i := 0) (by simp)
      convert hget'.symm using 1
      · simp only [List.append_assoc, List.length_append, List.length_cons, zero_add]
        congr 1
        omega
    have hd := hno ⟨A.length + 1 + (q :: R).length, by simp; omega⟩
    simp [noHo] at hd
    rw [hget, htake] at hd
    constructor
    · intro hexp
      apply hd.1
      have hmore := callsIncreaseGossip (after (A ++ [c])) ((q :: R).take R.length)
      have hknow := hexp d.2
      have hpersist := hmore d.1 d.2 hknow
      simpa [after, makeCalls] using hpersist
    · intro hexp
      apply hd.2
      have hmore := callsIncreaseGossip (after (A ++ [c])) ((q :: R).take R.length)
      have hknow := hexp d.1
      have hpersist := hmore d.2 d.1 hknow
      simpa [after, makeCalls] using hpersist

theorem separated_final_chain_impossible{m : ℕ} (S : List (Call m)) (S_allExp : allExpert (after S)) (noHo_S : noHo S)
  (A Q B : List (Call m)) (c d : Call m)
  (hS : S = A ++ c :: Q ++ d :: B)
  (hc : isFinalCall S c = true) (hd : isFinalCall S d = true)
  (hshare : c.fst = d.fst ∨ c.fst = d.snd ∨ c.snd = d.fst ∨ c.snd = d.snd) : Q = [] := by
  cases Q with
  | nil =>
      rfl
  | cons q R =>
      exfalso
      have hnot :=
        noHo_nonadjacent_later_call_has_no_expert_endpoint A (q :: R) B c d
          (by simp) (by simpa [hS] using noHo_S)
      have hexp :=
        final_selected_call_makes_both_expert S A ((q :: R) ++ d :: B) c
          (by simpa using hS) hc S_allExp noHo_S
      rcases hshare with h | h | h | h
      · exact hnot.1 (h ▸ hexp.1)
      · exact hnot.2 (h ▸ hexp.1)
      · exact hnot.1 (h ▸ hexp.2)
      · exact hnot.2 (h ▸ hexp.2)

theorem repeated_final_endpoint_yields_adjacent_chain{m : ℕ} (S : List (Call m)) (S_allExp : allExpert (after S)) (noHo_S : noHo S)
  (hdup : ¬(callEndpoints (List.filter (fun c : Call m => isFinalCall S c) S)).Nodup) :
  ∃ (A B : List (Call m)) (c d : Call m),
    S = A ++ c :: d :: B ∧
    isFinalCall S c = true ∧ isFinalCall S d = true ∧
    (c.fst = d.fst ∨ c.fst = d.snd ∨ c.snd = d.fst ∨ c.snd = d.snd) := by
  rcases duplicate_final_endpoint_decomposition S noHo_S hdup with ⟨A, Q, B, c, d, hS, hc, hd, hshare⟩
  have hQ : Q = [] :=
    separated_final_chain_impossible S S_allExp noHo_S A Q B c d hS hc hd hshare
  subst Q
  exact ⟨A, B, c, d, by simpa only [List.append_nil, List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append] using hS, hc, hd, hshare⟩

def stateMappedBy {m r : ℕ} (μ : Fin m → Fin r) (s : GossipState m) (t : GossipState r) : Prop :=
  ∀ a b, s a b → t (μ a) (μ b)

def quotientCall {m r : ℕ} (μ : Fin m → Fin r) (c : Call m) : Option (Call r) :=
  if μ c.fst = μ c.snd then none else some (μ c.fst, μ c.snd)

def quotientCalls {m r : ℕ} (μ : Fin m → Fin r) (S : List (Call m)) : List (Call r) :=
  S.filterMap (quotientCall μ)

theorem initialState_stateMappedBy{m r : ℕ} (μ : Fin m → Fin r) : stateMappedBy μ (initialState m) (initialState r) := by
  intro a b hab
  change a = b at hab
  change μ a = μ b
  exact congrArg μ hab

theorem makeCall_quotient_simulates{m r : ℕ} (μ : Fin m → Fin r) (s : GossipState m) (t : GossipState r) (c : Call m)
  (hmap : stateMappedBy μ s t) :
  stateMappedBy μ (makeCall s c)
    (if μ c.fst = μ c.snd then t else makeCall t (μ c.fst, μ c.snd)) := by
  unfold stateMappedBy at *
  intro a b hab
  split_ifs with hc
  · simp [makeCall] at * <;> grind
  · simp [makeCall] at * <;> grind

theorem makeCalls_quotientCalls_simulates{m r : ℕ} (μ : Fin m → Fin r) (s : GossipState m) (t : GossipState r) (S : List (Call m))
  (hmap : stateMappedBy μ s t) :
  stateMappedBy μ (makeCalls s S) (makeCalls t (quotientCalls μ S)) := by
  induction S generalizing s t with
  | nil =>
      simpa [quotientCalls] using hmap
  | cons c S ih =>
      simp only [quotientCalls, List.filterMap_cons, quotientCall]
      split_ifs with h
      · simp only [makeCalls_cons]
        apply ih
        simpa only [h, if_pos] using makeCall_quotient_simulates μ s t c hmap
      · simp only [makeCalls_cons]
        apply ih
        simpa only [h, if_neg] using makeCall_quotient_simulates μ s t c hmap

theorem allExpert_after_quotientCalls{m r : ℕ} (μ : Fin m → Fin r) (hμ : Function.Surjective μ) (S : List (Call m))
  (hExp : allExpert (after S)) : allExpert (after (quotientCalls μ S)) := by
  have hmap := makeCalls_quotientCalls_simulates μ (initialState m) (initialState r) S
    (initialState_stateMappedBy μ)
  intro a b
  obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := hμ a
  obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ := hμ b
  rw [← ha', ← hb']
  exact hmap a' b' (hExp a' b')

theorem quotientCalls_length_le_of_two_collapses{m r : ℕ} (μ : Fin m → Fin r) (S A Q B : List (Call m)) (c d : Call m)
  (hS : S = A ++ c :: Q ++ d :: B)
  (hc : quotientCall μ c = none) (hd : quotientCall μ d = none) :
  (quotientCalls μ S).length ≤ S.length - 2 := by
  subst S
  unfold quotientCalls
  have hlen : ∀ L : List (Call m), (L.filterMap (quotientCall μ)).length ≤ L.length := by
    intro L
    induction L with
    | nil => simp
    | cons x xs ih =>
      simp only [List.filterMap_cons]
      split <;> simp_all <;> omega
  simp only [List.filterMap_append, List.filterMap_cons, hc, hd,
    List.length_append, List.length_cons]
  have hA := hlen A
  have hQ := hlen Q
  have hB := hlen B
  omega

theorem exists_surjective_pair_merge{m : ℕ} (hm : 1 < m) (a b : Fin m) (hab : a ≠ b) :
  ∃ μ : Fin m → Fin (m - 1), Function.Surjective μ ∧ μ a = μ b := by
  have hcard : m - 1 + 1 = m := by omega
  let e : Fin m ≃ Fin (m - 1 + 1) := Fin.castOrderIso hcard.symm
  let a' : Fin (m - 1 + 1) := e a
  let b' : Fin (m - 1 + 1) := e b
  have hab' : a' ≠ b' := by
    intro h
    apply hab
    exact e.injective h
  let q : Fin (m - 1) := (finSuccAboveEquiv b').symm ⟨a', hab'⟩
  let μ : Fin m → Fin (m - 1) := fun x =>
    if hx : e x = b' then q else (finSuccAboveEquiv b').symm ⟨e x, hx⟩
  refine ⟨μ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro y
    refine ⟨e.symm (b'.succAbove y), ?_⟩
    simp only [μ, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rw [dif_neg (b'.succAbove_ne y)]
    apply (finSuccAboveEquiv b').injective
    simp [finSuccAboveEquiv_apply]
  · simp [μ, q, a', b', hab']

theorem shorter_counterexample_of_adjacent_repeated_call{m : ℕ} (hm : 1 < m) (S : List (Call m)) (S_allExp : allExpert (after S))
  (noHo_S : noHo S) (A B : List (Call m)) (c : Call m)
  (hS : S = A ++ c :: c :: B) :
  ∃ U : List (Call (m - 1)), allExpert (after U) ∧ U.length ≤ S.length - 2 := by
  have hcS : c ∈ S := by
    rw [hS]
    simp
  have hc_ne : c.fst ≠ c.snd :=
    noHo_call_endpoints_ne S noHo_S c hcS
  obtain ⟨μ, hμsurj, hμeq⟩ :=
    exists_surjective_pair_merge hm c.fst c.snd hc_ne
  refine ⟨quotientCalls μ S, allExpert_after_quotientCalls μ hμsurj S S_allExp, ?_⟩
  have hc_none : quotientCall μ c = none := by
    simp [quotientCall, hμeq]
  exact quotientCalls_length_le_of_two_collapses μ S A [] B c c
    (by simpa [List.append_assoc] using hS) hc_none hc_none

theorem isExpert_preserved_by_makeCalls{m : ℕ} (s : GossipState m) (L : List (Call m)) (x : Fin m)
  (hx : isExpert s x) : isExpert (makeCalls s L) x := by
  intro j
  exact callsIncreaseGossip s L x j (hx j)

theorem exists_terminal_expert_call{m : ℕ} (S : List (Call m)) (noHo_S : noHo S)
  (P₀ T₀ : List (Call m)) (c₀ : Call m) (x₀ : Fin m)
  (hS₀ : S = P₀ ++ c₀ :: T₀)
  (hx₀c : c₀.fst = x₀ ∨ c₀.snd = x₀)
  (hx₀ : isExpert (after P₀) x₀) :
  ∃ (P T : List (Call m)) (c : Call m) (x y : Fin m),
    S = P ++ c :: T ∧
    ((c.fst = x ∧ c.snd = y) ∨ (c.fst = y ∧ c.snd = x)) ∧
    x ≠ y ∧ isExpert (after P) x ∧
    ∀ e ∈ T, e.fst ≠ y ∧ e.snd ≠ y := by
  classical
  have expertMakesExpert_rev {s : GossipState m} {i j : Fin m}
      (h : isExpert s j) : isExpert (makeCall s (i, j)) i := by
    unfold isExpert at *
    intro z
    simp [makeCall, h z]
  have split_mem : ∀ {a : Call m} {l : List (Call m)}, a ∈ l →
      ∃ u v, l = u ++ a :: v := by
    intro a l h
    induction l with
    | nil => simp at h
    | cons b l ih =>
        simp only [List.mem_cons] at h
        rcases h with rfl | h
        · exact ⟨[], l, rfl⟩
        · rcases ih h with ⟨u, v, huv⟩
          exact ⟨b :: u, v, by simp [huv]⟩
  have aux : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ (P T : List (Call m)) (c : Call m) (x : Fin m),
      T.length = k → S = P ++ c :: T →
      (c.fst = x ∨ c.snd = x) → isExpert (after P) x →
      ∃ (P' T' : List (Call m)) (c' : Call m) (x' y' : Fin m),
        S = P' ++ c' :: T' ∧
        ((c'.fst = x' ∧ c'.snd = y') ∨ (c'.fst = y' ∧ c'.snd = x')) ∧
        x' ≠ y' ∧ isExpert (after P') x' ∧
        ∀ e ∈ T', e.fst ≠ y' ∧ e.snd ≠ y' := by
    intro k
    induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h k ih =>
        intro P T c x hlen hdecomp hcx hx
        rcases c with ⟨a, b⟩
        simp only at hcx
        rcases hcx with hax | hbx
        · subst x
          have hcS : (a, b) ∈ S := by
            rw [hdecomp]
            simp
          have hab : a ≠ b := noHo_call_endpoints_ne S noHo_S (a, b) hcS
          by_cases hocc : ∃ d ∈ T, d.fst = b ∨ d.snd = b
          · rcases hocc with ⟨d, hdT, hdend⟩
            rcases split_mem hdT with ⟨A, B, hsplit⟩
            have hb_call : isExpert (makeCall (after P) (a, b)) b :=
              expertMakesExpert hx
            have hbpre : isExpert (after (P ++ (a, b) :: A)) b := by
              have hp := isExpert_preserved_by_makeCalls
                (makeCall (after P) (a, b)) A b hb_call
              simpa [after, makeCalls, List.foldl_append] using hp
            have hlt : B.length < k := by
              rw [← hlen, hsplit]
              simp
              omega
            have hdecomp' : S = (P ++ (a, b) :: A) ++ d :: B := by
              rw [hdecomp, hsplit]
              simp
            exact ih B.length hlt (P ++ (a, b) :: A) B d b rfl hdecomp' hdend hbpre
          · exact ⟨P, T, (a, b), a, b, hdecomp, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, hab, hx, by
              intro e he
              constructor
              · intro heb
                exact hocc ⟨e, he, Or.inl heb⟩
              · intro heb
                exact hocc ⟨e, he, Or.inr heb⟩⟩
        · subst x
          have hcS : (a, b) ∈ S := by
            rw [hdecomp]
            simp
          have hab : a ≠ b := noHo_call_endpoints_ne S noHo_S (a, b) hcS
          have hba : b ≠ a := Ne.symm hab
          by_cases hocc : ∃ d ∈ T, d.fst = a ∨ d.snd = a
          · rcases hocc with ⟨d, hdT, hdend⟩
            rcases split_mem hdT with ⟨A, B, hsplit⟩
            have ha_call : isExpert (makeCall (after P) (a, b)) a :=
              expertMakesExpert_rev hx
            have hapre : isExpert (after (P ++ (a, b) :: A)) a := by
              have hp := isExpert_preserved_by_makeCalls
                (makeCall (after P) (a, b)) A a ha_call
              simpa [after, makeCalls, List.foldl_append] using hp
            have hlt : B.length < k := by
              rw [← hlen, hsplit]
              simp
              omega
            have hdecomp' : S = (P ++ (a, b) :: A) ++ d :: B := by
              rw [hdecomp, hsplit]
              simp
            exact ih B.length hlt (P ++ (a, b) :: A) B d a rfl hdecomp' hdend hapre
          · exact ⟨P, T, (a, b), b, a, hdecomp, Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, hba, hx, by
              intro e he
              constructor
              · intro hea
                exact hocc ⟨e, he, Or.inl hea⟩
              · intro hea
                exact hocc ⟨e, he, Or.inr hea⟩⟩
  exact aux T₀.length P₀ T₀ c₀ x₀ rfl hS₀ hx₀c hx₀

theorem initial_endpoints_nodup_of_exact_count{m : ℕ} (hm : 1 < m) (T : List (Call m)) (T_allExp : allExpert (after T))
  (hcount : m / 2 = (List.filter (fun c : Call m => isInitialCall T c) T).length) :
  (callEndpoints (List.filter (fun c : Call m => isInitialCall T c) T)).Nodup := by
  let I : List (Call m) := List.filter (fun c : Call m => isInitialCall T c) T
  let E : List (Fin m) := callEndpoints I
  have hcover : ∀ k : Fin m, k ∈ E := by
    intro k
    exact initial_filtered_endpoints_cover T
      (every_agent_occurs_of_allExpert hm T T_allExp) k
  have hfin : E.toFinset = Finset.univ := by
    ext k
    simp only [List.mem_toFinset, Finset.mem_univ, iff_true]
    exact hcover k
  have hcard : E.toFinset.card = m := by
    rw [hfin]
    simpa using (Fintype.card_fin m)
  have hlen : E.length = 2 * (m / 2) := by
    calc
      E.length = 2 * I.length := callEndpoints_length I
      _ = 2 * (m / 2) := by rw [hcount]
  have hcard_le : E.toFinset.card ≤ E.length := List.toFinset_card_le E
  have hlen_le : E.length ≤ m := by omega
  have heq : E.toFinset.card = E.length := by omega
  simpa using
    (Multiset.toFinset_card_eq_card_iff_nodup.mp (show (E : Multiset (Fin m)).toFinset.card = (E : Multiset (Fin m)).card by simpa using heq))

theorem initial_matching_edge_for_agent{m : ℕ} (hm : 1 < m) (T : List (Call m)) (T_allExp : allExpert (after T))
  (hcount : m / 2 = (List.filter (fun c : Call m => isInitialCall T c) T).length)
  (k : Fin m) :
  ∃ (p : Fin m) (c : Call m), p ≠ k ∧ c ∈ T ∧
    ((c.fst = k ∧ c.snd = p) ∨ (c.fst = p ∧ c.snd = k)) ∧
    isAgentInitialCall T k c = true ∧ isAgentInitialCall T p c = true := by
  obtain ⟨c, hcT, hcinit, hck⟩ :=
    initial_call_exists_of_occurs T k (every_agent_occurs_of_allExpert hm T T_allExp k)
  have hnodup := initial_endpoints_nodup_of_exact_count hm T T_allExp hcount
  rw [callEndpoints, List.nodup_flatMap] at hnodup
  rcases hck with hfst | hsnd
  · let p := c.snd
    have hcInitK : isAgentInitialCall T k c = true := by
      simpa [isAgentInitialCall] using hcinit
    have hcInitial : isInitialCall T c = true := by
      simp [isInitialCall, hfst, hcInitK]
    have hcF : c ∈ List.filter (fun c : Call m => isInitialCall T c) T := by
      simp [hcT, hcInitial]
    have hcEnds := hnodup.1 c hcF
    refine ⟨p, c, ?_, hcT, Or.inl ⟨hfst, rfl⟩, hcInitK, ?_⟩
    · have hcne : c.fst ≠ c.snd := by simpa using hcEnds
      intro hpk
      exact hcne (hfst.trans hpk.symm)
    · obtain ⟨d, hdT, hdinit, hdp⟩ :=
        initial_call_exists_of_occurs T p
          (every_agent_occurs_of_allExpert hm T T_allExp p)
      have hdInitP : isAgentInitialCall T p d = true := by
        simpa [isAgentInitialCall] using hdinit
      rcases hdp with hdfst | hdsnd
      · have hdInitial : isInitialCall T d = true := by
          simp [isInitialCall, hdfst, hdInitP]
        have hdF : d ∈ List.filter (fun c : Call m => isInitialCall T c) T := by
          simp [hdT, hdInitial]
        have hdc : d = c := by
          by_contra hne
          have hdisj : List.Disjoint [d.fst, d.snd] [c.fst, c.snd] :=
            hnodup.2.forall (fun _ _ h => h.symm) hdF hcF hne
          exact hdisj (a := p) (by simp [hdfst]) (by simp [p])
        rw [hdc] at hdinit
        simpa [isAgentInitialCall] using hdinit
      · have hdInitial : isInitialCall T d = true := by
          simp [isInitialCall, hdsnd, hdInitP]
        have hdF : d ∈ List.filter (fun c : Call m => isInitialCall T c) T := by
          simp [hdT, hdInitial]
        have hdc : d = c := by
          by_contra hne
          have hdisj : List.Disjoint [d.fst, d.snd] [c.fst, c.snd] :=
            hnodup.2.forall (fun _ _ h => h.symm) hdF hcF hne
          exact hdisj (a := p) (by simp [hdsnd]) (by simp [p])
        rw [hdc] at hdinit
        simpa [isAgentInitialCall] using hdinit
  · let p := c.fst
    have hcInitK : isAgentInitialCall T k c = true := by
      simpa [isAgentInitialCall] using hcinit
    have hcInitial : isInitialCall T c = true := by
      simp [isInitialCall, hsnd, hcInitK]
    have hcF : c ∈ List.filter (fun c : Call m => isInitialCall T c) T := by
      simp [hcT, hcInitial]
    have hcEnds := hnodup.1 c hcF
    refine ⟨p, c, ?_, hcT, Or.inr ⟨rfl, hsnd⟩, hcInitK, ?_⟩
    · have hcne : c.fst ≠ c.snd := by simpa using hcEnds
      intro hpk
      exact hcne (hpk.trans hsnd.symm)
    · obtain ⟨d, hdT, hdinit, hdp⟩ :=
        initial_call_exists_of_occurs T p
          (every_agent_occurs_of_allExpert hm T T_allExp p)
      have hdInitP : isAgentInitialCall T p d = true := by
        simpa [isAgentInitialCall] using hdinit
      rcases hdp with hdfst | hdsnd
      · have hdInitial : isInitialCall T d = true := by
          simp [isInitialCall, hdfst, hdInitP]
        have hdF : d ∈ List.filter (fun c : Call m => isInitialCall T c) T := by
          simp [hdT, hdInitial]
        have hdc : d = c := by
          by_contra hne
          have hdisj : List.Disjoint [d.fst, d.snd] [c.fst, c.snd] :=
            hnodup.2.forall (fun _ _ h => h.symm) hdF hcF hne
          exact hdisj (a := p) (by simp [hdfst]) (by simp [p])
        rw [hdc] at hdinit
        simpa [isAgentInitialCall] using hdinit
      · have hdInitial : isInitialCall T d = true := by
          simp [isInitialCall, hdsnd, hdInitP]
        have hdF : d ∈ List.filter (fun c : Call m => isInitialCall T c) T := by
          simp [hdT, hdInitial]
        have hdc : d = c := by
          by_contra hne
          have hdisj : List.Disjoint [d.fst, d.snd] [c.fst, c.snd] :=
            hnodup.2.forall (fun _ _ h => h.symm) hdF hcF hne
          exact hdisj (a := p) (by simp [hdsnd]) (by simp [p])
        rw [hdc] at hdinit
        simpa [isAgentInitialCall] using hdinit

theorem expert_agent_occurs_in_prefix{m : ℕ} (hm : 1 < m) (P : List (Call m)) (x : Fin m)
  (hx : isExpert (after P) x) :
  ∃ c ∈ P, c.fst = x ∨ c.snd = x := by
  by_contra h
  push_neg at h
  have hnon : ∀ c ∈ P, c.fst ≠ x ∧ c.snd ≠ x := by
    intro c hc
    have hc' := h c hc
    constructor <;> tauto
  have hrow : ∀ j : Fin m, after P x j ↔ initialState m x j := by
    intro j
    exact makeCalls_nonparticipant_row (initialState m) P x j hnon
  have hcard : 1 < Fintype.card (Fin m) := by simpa using hm
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Fintype.exists_ne_of_one_lt_card hcard x
  have hxj : after P x j := hx j
  have hini : initialState m x j := (hrow j).mp hxj
  exact hj (by simpa [initialState] using hini.symm)

theorem initial_value_mem_prefix_of_occurrence{m : ℕ} (S P T : List (Call m)) (c e : Call m) (x : Fin m)
  (hS : S = P ++ c :: T)
  (hinit : initial S x = some e)
  (hocc : ∃ q ∈ P, q.fst = x ∨ q.snd = x) : e ∈ P := by
  subst S
  induction P with
  | nil => simp at hocc
  | cons a P ih =>
    simp only [List.cons_append] at hinit
    by_cases ha1 : a.fst = x
    · simp [initial, ha1] at hinit
      subst e
      simp
    · by_cases ha2 : a.snd = x
      · simp [initial, ha1, ha2] at hinit
        subst e
        simp
      · simp only [initial, List.find?_cons, ha1, ha2, Bool.false_or] at hinit
        simp only [List.mem_cons] at hocc ⊢
        rcases hocc with ⟨q, hq, hendpoint⟩
        rcases hq with rfl | hq
        · exact (hendpoint.elim ha1 ha2).elim
        · right
          apply ih
          · exact ⟨q, hq, hendpoint⟩
          · exact hinit

theorem makeCall_comm{m : ℕ} (s : GossipState m) (a b : Fin m) : makeCall s (a, b) = makeCall s (b, a) := by
  by_cases hab : a = b
  · subst b
    rfl
  · funext i j
    unfold makeCall
    by_cases hia : i = a
    · subst i
      simp only [if_pos, if_neg, if_false, hab, ne_eq, not_false_eq_true]
    · by_cases hib : i = b
      · subst i
        have hba : b ≠ a := Ne.symm hab
        simp only [if_pos, if_neg, if_false, hab, hba, ne_eq, not_false_eq_true]
      · have hai : a ≠ i := fun h => hia h.symm
        have hbi : b ≠ i := fun h => hib h.symm
        simp only [if_neg, if_false, hia, hib, hai, hbi]

theorem skip_expert_call_survivor_simulates{m r : ℕ} (μ : Fin m → Fin r) (s : GossipState m) (t : GossipState r)
  (x y : Fin m) (hxy : x ≠ y) (hx : isExpert s x)
  (hmap : stateMappedBy μ s t) :
  survivorMappedBy μ y (makeCall s (x, y)) t := by
  intro a ha b hb hab
  unfold makeCall at hab
  by_cases hax : a = x
  · subst a
    exact hmap x b (hx b)
  · by_cases hay : a = y
    · exact (ha hay).elim
    · apply hmap a b
      simpa only [hax, hay, ↓reduceIte] using hab

theorem makeCalls_survivor_simulates_of_avoids{m r : ℕ} (μ : Fin m → Fin r) (y : Fin m)
  (s : GossipState m) (t : GossipState r) (L : List (Call m))
  (havoid : ∀ c ∈ L, c.fst ≠ y ∧ c.snd ≠ y)
  (hmap : survivorMappedBy μ y s t) :
  survivorMappedBy μ y (makeCalls s L) (makeCalls t (quotientCalls μ L)) := by
  induction L generalizing s t with
  | nil =>
      simpa [quotientCalls, makeCalls] using hmap
  | cons c L ih =>
      rcases c with ⟨i, j⟩
      have hij : i ≠ y ∧ j ≠ y := havoid (i, j) (by simp)
      have htail : ∀ c ∈ L, c.fst ≠ y ∧ c.snd ≠ y := by
        intro c hc
        exact havoid c (by simp [hc])
      by_cases heq : μ i = μ j
      · have hstep : survivorMappedBy μ y (makeCall s (i, j)) t := by
          unfold survivorMappedBy at hmap ⊢
          intro a ha b hb hab
          by_cases hai : a = i
          · subst a
            simp [makeCall] at hab
            rcases hab with hi | hj
            · exact hmap i hij.1 b hb hi
            · rw [heq]
              exact hmap j hij.2 b hb hj
          · by_cases haj : a = j
            · subst a
              simp [makeCall, hai] at hab
              rcases hab with hj | hi
              · exact hmap j hij.2 b hb hj
              · rw [← heq]
                exact hmap i hij.1 b hb hi
            · simp [makeCall, hai, haj] at hab
              exact hmap a ha b hb hab
        simpa [makeCalls_cons, quotientCalls, quotientCall, heq] using
          ih (makeCall s (i, j)) t htail hstep
      · have hstep : survivorMappedBy μ y (makeCall s (i, j))
            (makeCall t (μ i, μ j)) := by
          unfold survivorMappedBy at hmap ⊢
          intro a ha b hb hab
          by_cases hai : a = i
          · subst a
            simp [makeCall] at hab ⊢
            rcases hab with hi | hj
            · exact Or.inl (hmap i hij.1 b hb hi)
            · exact Or.inr (hmap j hij.2 b hb hj)
          · by_cases haj : a = j
            · subst a
              have hji : μ j ≠ μ i := fun h => heq h.symm
              simp [makeCall, hai, hji] at hab ⊢
              rcases hab with hj | hi
              · exact Or.inl (hmap j hij.2 b hb hj)
              · exact Or.inr (hmap i hij.1 b hb hi)
            · simp [makeCall, hai, haj] at hab
              have ht : t (μ a) (μ b) := hmap a ha b hb hab
              simp [makeCall, ht]
        simpa [makeCalls_cons, quotientCalls, quotientCall, heq] using
          ih (makeCall s (i, j)) (makeCall t (μ i, μ j)) htail hstep

theorem allExpert_of_survivorMappedBy{m r : ℕ} (μ : Fin m → Fin r) (hμ : Function.Surjective μ)
  (y p : Fin m) (hyp : p ≠ y) (hpy : μ p = μ y)
  (s : GossipState m) (t : GossipState r)
  (hExp : allExpert s) (hmap : survivorMappedBy μ y s t) : allExpert t := by
  intro i j
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hμ i
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hμ j
  by_cases ha : a = y
  · subst a
    by_cases hb : b = y
    · subst b
      simpa only [hpy] using hmap p hyp p hyp (hExp p p)
    · simpa only [hpy] using hmap p hyp b hb (hExp p b)
  · by_cases hb : b = y
    · subst b
      simpa only [hpy] using hmap a ha p hyp (hExp a p)
    · exact hmap a ha b hb (hExp a b)

theorem quotientCalls_length_le_of_one_collapse{m r : ℕ} (μ : Fin m → Fin r) (P P₁ P₂ : List (Call m)) (e : Call m)
  (hP : P = P₁ ++ e :: P₂) (he : quotientCall μ e = none) :
  (quotientCalls μ P).length ≤ P.length - 1 := by
  subst P
  have hfilter : ∀ L : List (Call m), (L.filterMap (quotientCall μ)).length ≤ L.length := by
    intro L
    induction L with
    | nil => simp
    | cons a L ih =>
      cases h : quotientCall μ a <;> simp [List.filterMap_cons, h] <;> omega
  have h₁ := hfilter P₁
  have h₂ := hfilter P₂
  simp [quotientCalls, he, List.filterMap_append] at *
  omega

theorem terminal_expert_call_contraction{m : ℕ} (hm : 1 < m) (S : List (Call m)) (S_allExp : allExpert (after S))
  (P T : List (Call m)) (c : Call m) (x y p : Fin m)
  (hS : S = P ++ c :: T)
  (hc : (c.fst = x ∧ c.snd = y) ∨ (c.fst = y ∧ c.snd = x))
  (hxy : x ≠ y) (hx : isExpert (after P) x)
  (hT : ∀ e ∈ T, e.fst ≠ y ∧ e.snd ≠ y)
  (P₁ P₂ : List (Call m)) (e₀ : Call m)
  (hP : P = P₁ ++ e₀ :: P₂)
  (he₀ : (e₀.fst = y ∧ e₀.snd = p) ∨ (e₀.fst = p ∧ e₀.snd = y))
  (hpy : p ≠ y) :
  ∃ U : List (Call (m - 1)), allExpert (after U) ∧ U.length ≤ S.length - 2 := by
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ, hμpy⟩ := exists_surjective_pair_merge hm p y hpy
  refine ⟨quotientCalls μ P ++ quotientCalls μ T, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hmapP : stateMappedBy μ (after P) (after (quotientCalls μ P)) := by
      simpa [after] using
        (makeCalls_quotientCalls_simulates μ (initialState m) (initialState (m - 1)) P
          (initialState_stateMappedBy μ))
    have hsurvC :
        survivorMappedBy μ y (makeCall (after P) c) (after (quotientCalls μ P)) := by
      rcases hc with hc | hc
      · have hceq : c = (x, y) := by
          apply Prod.ext
          · exact hc.1
          · exact hc.2
        rw [hceq]
        exact skip_expert_call_survivor_simulates μ (after P)
          (after (quotientCalls μ P)) x y hxy hx hmapP
      · have hceq : c = (y, x) := by
          apply Prod.ext
          · exact hc.1
          · exact hc.2
        rw [hceq, makeCall_comm]
        exact skip_expert_call_survivor_simulates μ (after P)
          (after (quotientCalls μ P)) x y hxy hx hmapP
    have hsurvT := makeCalls_survivor_simulates_of_avoids μ y
      (makeCall (after P) c) (after (quotientCalls μ P)) T hT hsurvC
    apply allExpert_of_survivorMappedBy μ hμ y p hpy hμpy (after S)
      (after (quotientCalls μ P ++ quotientCalls μ T)) S_allExp
    simpa [after, hS, makeCalls, List.foldl_append] using hsurvT
  · have heq : μ e₀.fst = μ e₀.snd := by
      rcases he₀ with he₀ | he₀
      · rw [he₀.1, he₀.2]
        exact hμpy.symm
      · rw [he₀.1, he₀.2]
        exact hμpy
    have he₀none : quotientCall μ e₀ = none := by
      simp [quotientCall, heq]
    have hlenP := quotientCalls_length_le_of_one_collapse μ P P₁ P₂ e₀ hP he₀none
    have hlenT : (quotientCalls μ T).length ≤ T.length := by
      exact List.length_filterMap_le (quotientCall μ) T
    have hPpos : 0 < P.length := by
      rw [hP]
      simp
    simp only [List.length_append]
    rw [hS]
    simp only [List.length_append, List.length_cons]
    omega

theorem shorter_counterexample_of_distinct_adjacent_final_chain{m : ℕ} (le_m : 4 < m) (S : List (Call m))
  (S_allExp : allExpert (after S)) (noHo_S : noHo S)
  (hinit : m / 2 = (List.filter (fun c : Call m => isInitialCall S c) S).length)
  (A B : List (Call m)) (c d : Call m)
  (hS : S = A ++ c :: d :: B)
  (hc : isFinalCall S c = true) (hd : isFinalCall S d = true)
  (hshare : c.fst = d.fst ∨ c.fst = d.snd ∨ c.snd = d.fst ∨ c.snd = d.snd)
  (hcd : c ≠ d) :
  ∃ U : List (Call (m - 1)), allExpert (after U) ∧ U.length ≤ S.length - 2 := by
  have hm : 1 < m := by omega
  have hS_d : S = (A ++ [c]) ++ d :: B := by
    rw [hS]
    simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
  have hcExp :
      isExpert (after (A ++ [c])) c.fst ∧
        isExpert (after (A ++ [c])) c.snd := by
    exact final_selected_call_makes_both_expert S A (d :: B) c hS hc S_allExp noHo_S
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀c, hx₀⟩ :
      ∃ x₀ : Fin m, (d.fst = x₀ ∨ d.snd = x₀) ∧
        isExpert (after (A ++ [c])) x₀ := by
    rcases hshare with h | h | h | h
    · exact ⟨d.fst, Or.inl rfl, h ▸ hcExp.1⟩
    · exact ⟨d.snd, Or.inr rfl, h ▸ hcExp.1⟩
    · exact ⟨d.fst, Or.inl rfl, h ▸ hcExp.2⟩
    · exact ⟨d.snd, Or.inr rfl, h ▸ hcExp.2⟩
  obtain ⟨P, T, e, x, y, hSP, he, hxy, hx, hT⟩ :=
    exists_terminal_expert_call S noHo_S (A ++ [c]) B d x₀ hS_d hx₀c hx₀
  obtain ⟨p, e₀, hpy, he₀S, he₀, he₀y, he₀p⟩ :=
    initial_matching_edge_for_agent hm S S_allExp hinit y
  have he₀P : e₀ ∈ P := by
    rw [hSP] at he₀S
    simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_cons] at he₀S
    rcases he₀S with he₀P | rfl | he₀T
    · exact he₀P
    · have hpx : p = x := by grind
      have hinitx : initial S x = some e₀ := by
        simpa [isAgentInitialCall, hpx] using he₀p
      obtain ⟨q, hqP, hqx⟩ := expert_agent_occurs_in_prefix hm P x hx
      exact initial_value_mem_prefix_of_occurrence S P T e₀ e₀ x hSP hinitx ⟨q, hqP, hqx⟩
    · have hne := hT e₀ he₀T
      grind
  obtain ⟨P₁, P₂, hP⟩ := List.mem_iff_append.mp he₀P
  exact terminal_expert_call_contraction hm S S_allExp P T e x y p
    hSP he hxy hx hT P₁ P₂ e₀ hP he₀ hpy

theorem adjacent_final_chain_contradicts_minimality(m : ℕ)
  (m_is_minimal : ∀ n < m, ¬∃ (_ : 4 < n) (x : List (Call n)) (_ : allExpert (after x)), x.length < 2 * n - 4)
  (le_m : 4 < m) (S : List (Call m)) (S_allExp : allExpert (after S)) (noHo_S : noHo S)
  (S_len_lt : S.length ≤ 2 * m - 5)
  (hinit : m / 2 = (List.filter (fun c : Call m => isInitialCall S c) S).length)
  (A B : List (Call m)) (c d : Call m)
  (hS : S = A ++ c :: d :: B)
  (hc : isFinalCall S c = true) (hd : isFinalCall S d = true)
  (hshare : c.fst = d.fst ∨ c.fst = d.snd ∨ c.snd = d.fst ∨ c.snd = d.snd) : False := by
  by_cases hcd : c = d
  · subst d
    rcases shorter_counterexample_of_adjacent_repeated_call (by omega : 1 < m) S S_allExp noHo_S A B c hS with ⟨U, hUexp, hUlen⟩
    have hlower := initial_filter_length_lower_bound (by omega : 1 < m) S S_allExp
    have heven : m % 2 = 0 := by
      omega
    apply m_is_minimal (m - 1) (by omega)
    exact ⟨by omega, U, hUexp, by omega⟩
  · rcases shorter_counterexample_of_distinct_adjacent_final_chain le_m S S_allExp noHo_S hinit A B c d hS hc hd hshare hcd with ⟨U, hUexp, hUlen⟩
    have hlower := initial_filter_length_lower_bound (by omega : 1 < m) S S_allExp
    have heven : m % 2 = 0 := by
      omega
    apply m_is_minimal (m - 1) (by omega)
    exact ⟨by omega, U, hUexp, by omega⟩

theorem minimal_counterexample_final_endpoints_nodup(m : ℕ)

theorem Erdos757.diff_eleven_unique_nonsidon_triple{B : Finset ℝ} (hB : B.card = 4) (hdiff : (B - B).card = 11) : ∃! T : Finset ℝ, T ∈ B.powersetCard 3 ∧ ¬ IsSidon T := by
  let f := B.orderEmbOfFin hB
  let a : ℝ := f 0
  let b : ℝ := f 1
  let c : ℝ := f 2
  let d : ℝ := f 3
  have hab : a < b := f.strictMono (by decide)
  have hbc : b < c := f.strictMono (by decide)
  have hcd : c < d := f.strictMono (by decide)
  have hrange : Set.range f = (B : Set ℝ) := B.range_orderEmbOfFin hB
  have hB' : B = {a, b, c, d} := by
    apply Finset.ext
    intro x
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · intro hx
      have hx' : x ∈ Set.range f := by
        rw [hrange]
        exact hx
      rcases hx' with ⟨i, rfl⟩
      fin_cases i <;> simp [a, b, c, d]
    · intro hx
      have hx' : x ∈ Set.range f := by
        rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
        · exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
        · exact ⟨1, rfl⟩
        · exact ⟨2, rfl⟩
        · exact ⟨3, rfl⟩
      rw [hrange] at hx'
      exact hx'
  have hcard := Erdos757.ordered_four_diff_card hab hbc hcd
  rw [hB'] at hdiff
  have hfive : (Erdos757.fourPositiveDiffs a b c d).card = 5 := by
    omega
  rw [hB']
  exact Erdos757.ordered_four_positive_five_unique_nonsidon hab hbc hcd hfive

  · intro x hx

  · simpa using hScard

theorem imo1984p5_nonadjacent_card{n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : n > 3) (i : Fin n) :

    have hneg1 : (-1 : Fin (m + 1)) ≠ 1 := by
      intro h
      have hval := congrArg Fin.val h
      simp at hval
      rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)] at hval
      omega
    have him1_ne_i : i - 1 ≠ i := by
      intro h
      apply hz1
      apply add_left_cancel (a := i)
      simpa only [add_zero, sub_add_cancel] using congrArg (fun x : Fin (m + 1) => x + 1) h
    have hi_ne_ip1 : i ≠ i + 1 := by
      intro h
      apply hz1
      apply add_left_cancel (a := i)
      simpa only [add_zero] using h
    have him1_ne_ip1 : i - 1 ≠ i + 1 := by
      intro h
      apply hneg1
      apply add_left_cancel (a := i)
      simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg] using h

      simp [him1_ne_i, hi_ne_ip1, him1_ne_ip1]
    rw [Finset.card_sdiff]
    · simp [hcard]
    · exact Finset.subset_univ _

    apply Fin.ext
    simp [Fin.val_natCast]
  have hpath0 := dist_le_range_sum_dist (fun r => P (i + Fin.ofNat n r)) (k - 1)
  rw [hof0, add_zero] at hpath0
  have hpath :
      dist (P i) (P (i + Fin.ofNat n (k - 1))) ≤
        ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (k - 1),
          dist (P (i + Fin.ofNat n r)) (P (i + Fin.ofNat n (r + 1))) := hpath0
  rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega : 1 ≤ k), Finset.sum_range_succ]
  norm_num [Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega : 1 ≤ k)]
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le hstrict (add_le_add_right hpath _)

theorem imo1984p5_offset_chord_sum_lt{n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : n > 3) (P : Fin n → ℝ²)
  (hP : ∀ (i j : Fin n), j ≠ i - 1 → j ≠ i → (∡ (P (i - 1)) (P i) (P j)).sign = 1)
  {k : ℕ} (hk2 : 2 ≤ k) (hkle : k ≤ n - 2) :
  (∑ i : Fin n, dist (P i) (P (i + Fin.ofNat n k))) <
    (min k (n - k) : ℝ) * ∑ i : Fin n, dist (P i) (P (i + 1)) := by
  have hkn : k < n := by omega
  have hklen : k ≤ n := by omega
  have hkforward (i : Fin n) :
      dist (P i) (P (i + Fin.ofNat n k)) <
        ∑ r ∈ Finset.range k,
          dist (P (i + Fin.ofNat n r)) (P (i + Fin.ofNat n (r + 1))) :=
    imo1984p5_cyclic_chord_lt_path P hP i hk2 hkn
  have hofNat_succ (r : ℕ) :
      Fin.ofNat n (r + 1) = Fin.ofNat n r + 1 := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simpa only [Fin.coe_ofNat_eq_mod, Fin.val_add] using (Nat.add_mod r 1 n)
  have hshift (r : ℕ) :
      (∑ i : Fin n,
        dist (P (i + Fin.ofNat n r)) (P (i + Fin.ofNat n (r + 1)))) =
      ∑ i : Fin n, dist (P i) (P (i + 1)) := by
    rw [hofNat_succ]
    simpa only [Equiv.coe_addRight, add_assoc] using
      (Equiv.sum_comp (Equiv.addRight (Fin.ofNat n r))
        (fun i : Fin n => dist (P i) (P (i + 1))))
  have hshift_add (a : Fin n) (r : ℕ) :
      (∑ i : Fin n,
        dist (P ((i + a) + Fin.ofNat n r))
          (P ((i + a) + Fin.ofNat n (r + 1)))) =
      ∑ i : Fin n, dist (P i) (P (i + 1)) := by
    calc
      (∑ i : Fin n,
        dist (P ((i + a) + Fin.ofNat n r))
          (P ((i + a) + Fin.ofNat n (r + 1)))) =
          ∑ i : Fin n,
            dist (P (i + Fin.ofNat n r)) (P (i + Fin.ofNat n (r + 1))) := by
        simpa only [Equiv.coe_addRight] using
          (Equiv.sum_comp (Equiv.addRight a)
            (fun i : Fin n =>
              dist (P (i + Fin.ofNat n r)) (P (i + Fin.ofNat n (r + 1)))))
      _ = _ := hshift r
  have hq2 : 2 ≤ n - k := by omega
  have hqn : n - k < n := by omega
  have hend (i : Fin n) :
      (i + Fin.ofNat n k) + Fin.ofNat n (n - k) = i := by
    rw [add_assoc]
    have hz : Fin.ofNat n k + Fin.ofNat n (n - k) = 0 := by
      apply Fin.ext
      rw [Fin.val_add, Fin.val_zero]
      change (k % n + (n - k) % n) % n = 0 % n
      rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hkn, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hqn, Nat.add_sub_of_le hklen,
        Nat.mod_self, Nat.zero_mod]
    rw [hz, add_zero]
  have hkreverse (i : Fin n) :
      dist (P i) (P (i + Fin.ofNat n k)) <
        ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (n - k),
          dist (P ((i + Fin.ofNat n k) + Fin.ofNat n r))
            (P ((i + Fin.ofNat n k) + Fin.ofNat n (r + 1))) := by
    have h := imo1984p5_cyclic_chord_lt_path P hP
      (i + Fin.ofNat n k) hq2 hqn
    simpa only [hend, dist_comm] using h
  by_cases hcase : k ≤ n - k
  · have hcaseR : (k : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) - k := by
      rw [← Nat.cast_sub hklen]
      exact_mod_cast hcase
    calc
      (∑ i : Fin n, dist (P i) (P (i + Fin.ofNat n k))) <
          ∑ i : Fin n, ∑ r ∈ Finset.range k,
            dist (P (i + Fin.ofNat n r)) (P (i + Fin.ofNat n (r + 1))) := by
        exact Finset.sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty Finset.univ_nonempty (fun i _ => hkforward i)
      _ = ∑ r ∈ Finset.range k, ∑ i : Fin n,
            dist (P (i + Fin.ofNat n r)) (P (i + Fin.ofNat n (r + 1))) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      _ = (k : ℝ) * ∑ i : Fin n, dist (P i) (P (i + 1)) := by
        simp only [hshift, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
      _ = (min k (n - k) : ℝ) * ∑ i : Fin n, dist (P i) (P (i + 1)) := by
        rw [min_eq_left hcaseR]
  · have hcaseR : (n : ℝ) - k ≤ (k : ℝ) := by
      rw [← Nat.cast_sub hklen]
      exact_mod_cast (Nat.le_of_not_ge hcase)
    calc
      (∑ i : Fin n, dist (P i) (P (i + Fin.ofNat n k))) <
          ∑ i : Fin n, ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (n - k),
            dist (P ((i + Fin.ofNat n k) + Fin.ofNat n r))
              (P ((i + Fin.ofNat n k) + Fin.ofNat n (r + 1))) := by
        exact Finset.sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty Finset.univ_nonempty (fun i _ => hkreverse i)
      _ = ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (n - k), ∑ i : Fin n,
            dist (P ((i + Fin.ofNat n k) + Fin.ofNat n r))
              (P ((i + Fin.ofNat n k) + Fin.ofNat n (r + 1))) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      _ = ((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ) * ∑ i : Fin n, dist (P i) (P (i + 1)) := by
        simp only [hshift_add, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
      _ = ((n : ℝ) - k) * ∑ i : Fin n, dist (P i) (P (i + 1)) := by
        rw [Nat.cast_sub hklen]
      _ = (min k (n - k) : ℝ) * ∑ i : Fin n, dist (P i) (P (i + 1)) := by
        rw [min_eq_right hcaseR]

theorem imo1984p5_offset_mem_iff{n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : n > 3) (i j : Fin n) :
  (j - i).val ∈ Finset.Ico 2 (n - 1) ↔
    j ∈ Finset.univ \ {i - 1, i, i + 1} := by
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by omega
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hn0
  have hneg : ((-1 : Fin (m + 1)).val = m) := Fin.coe_neg_one
  have hone : ((1 : Fin (m + 1)).val = 1) := by
    simp [Fin.val_natCast]
    omega
  have hm : j = i - 1 ↔ j - i = -1 := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      rw [h]
      simp
    · intro h
      have h' := (sub_eq_iff_eq_add').mp h
      simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using h'
  have hp : j = i + 1 ↔ j - i = 1 := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      rw [h]
      simp
    · intro h
      have h' := (sub_eq_iff_eq_add').mp h
      exact h'
  simp only [Finset.mem_Ico, Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
    Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ h
    rcases h with h | h | h
    · have hd : j - i = -1 := hm.mp h
      have hv : (j - i).val = m := by
        rw [hd]
        exact hneg
      omega
    · have hd : j - i = 0 := sub_eq_zero.mpr h
      have hv : (j - i).val = 0 := by rw [hd]; rfl
      omega
    · have hd : j - i = 1 := hp.mp h
      have hv : (j - i).val = 1 := by
        rw [hd]
        exact hone
      omega
  · intro h
    have hd0 : (j - i).val ≠ 0 := by
      intro hv
      have hd : j - i = 0 := by
        apply Fin.ext
        exact hv
      exact h (Or.inr (Or.inl (sub_eq_zero.mp hd)))
    have hd1 : (j - i).val ≠ 1 := by
      intro hv
      have hd : j - i = 1 := by
        apply Fin.ext
        exact hv.trans hone.symm
      exact h (Or.inr (Or.inr (hp.mpr hd)))
    have hdm : (j - i).val ≠ m := by
      intro hv
      have hd : j - i = -1 := by
        apply Fin.ext
        exact hv.trans hneg.symm
      exact h (Or.inl (hm.mpr hd))
    have hlt := (j - i).isLt
    omega

theorem imo1984p5_ordered_diagonal_sum_offsets{n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : n > 3) (P : Fin n → ℝ²) :
  (∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ \ {i - 1, i, i + 1}, dist (P i) (P j)) =
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 2 (n - 1), ∑ i : Fin n, dist (P i) (P (i + Fin.ofNat n k)) := by
  classical
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  apply Finset.sum_bij (fun j _ => (j - i).val)
  · intro j hj
    exact (imo1984p5_offset_mem_iff hn i j).2 hj
  · intro j₁ hj₁ j₂ hj₂ heq
    have hsub : j₁ - i = j₂ - i := Fin.ext heq
    apply_fun (fun x : Fin n => x + i) at hsub
    simpa using hsub
  · intro k hk
    have hklt : k < n := by
      simp only [Finset.mem_Ico] at hk
      omega
    refine ⟨i + Fin.ofNat n k, ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply (imo1984p5_offset_mem_iff hn i _).1
      simpa [Fin.ofNat, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hklt] using hk
    · simpa [Fin.ofNat, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hklt]
  · intro j hj
    apply congrArg (fun x : Fin n => dist (P i) (P x))
    calc
      j = i + (j - i) := by simp
      _ = i + Fin.ofNat n (j - i).val := by
        congr 1
        apply Fin.ext
        simp [Fin.ofNat, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (j - i).isLt]

theorem imo1984p5_even_cyclic_min_sum{m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) :
  (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 2 (2 * m - 1), (min k (2 * m - k) : ℝ)) = (m : ℝ) ^ 2 - 2 := by
  have hm_top : m ≤ 2 * m - 1 := by omega
  have hlow :
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 2 m, (min k (2 * m - k) : ℝ)) =
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 2 m, (k : ℝ) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k hk
    rw [min_eq_left]
    simp only [Finset.mem_Ico] at hk
    have hkm : (k : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast (Nat.le_of_lt hk.2)
    norm_num
    linarith
  have hupper :
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico m (2 * m - 1), (min k (2 * m - k) : ℝ)) =
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 2 (m + 1), (k : ℝ) := by
    calc
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico m (2 * m - 1), (min k (2 * m - k) : ℝ)) =
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico m (2 * m - 1), (2 * m - k : ℝ) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro k hk
            rw [min_eq_right]
            simp only [Finset.mem_Ico] at hk
            have hmk : (m : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hk.1
            norm_num
            linarith
      _ = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico m (2 * m - 1), ((2 * m - k : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro k hk
            simp only [Finset.mem_Ico] at hk
            rw [Nat.cast_sub]
            · norm_num
            · omega
      _ = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 2 (m + 1), (k : ℝ) := by
            have hreflect := Finset.sum_Ico_reflect (fun k : ℕ => (k : ℝ)) m
              (m := 2 * m - 1) (n := 2 * m) (by omega)
            have h₁ : 2 * m + 1 - (2 * m - 1) = 2 := by omega
            have h₂ : 2 * m + 1 - m = m + 1 := by omega
            simpa only [h₁, h₂] using hreflect
  have hupper_sum :
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 2 (m + 1), (k : ℝ)) =
        (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 2 m, (k : ℝ)) + m := by
    simpa using Finset.sum_Ico_succ_top hm (fun k : ℕ => (k : ℝ))
  have hrange_twice :
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, (k : ℝ)) * 2 =
        (m : ℝ) * ((m : ℝ) - 1) := by
    have h := congrArg (fun x : ℕ => (x : ℝ)) (Finset.sum_range_id_mul_two m)
    simp only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_sum] at h
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega)] at h
    simpa using h
  have hIco :
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 2 m, (k : ℝ)) =
        (∑ k ∈ Finset.range m, (k : ℝ)) - 1 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_Ico_eq_sub (fun k : ℕ => (k : ℝ)) hm]
    norm_num
  have hIco_twice :
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 2 m, (k : ℝ)) * 2 =
        (m : ℝ) * ((m : ℝ) - 1) - 2 := by
    rw [hIco]
    linarith
  calc
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 2 (2 * m - 1), (min k (2 * m - k) : ℝ)) =
        (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 2 m, (min k (2 * m - k) : ℝ)) +
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico m (2 * m - 1), (min k (2 * m - k) : ℝ) := by
            symm
            exact Finset.sum_Ico_consecutive
              (fun k : ℕ => (min k (2 * m - k) : ℝ)) hm hm_top
    _ = (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 2 m, (k : ℝ)) +
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 2 (m + 1), (k : ℝ) := by rw [hlow, hupper]
    _ = (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 2 m, (k : ℝ)) +
          ((∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 2 m, (k : ℝ)) + m) := by rw [hupper_sum]
    _ = (m : ℝ) ^ 2 - 2 := by nlinarith

theorem imo1984p5_odd_cyclic_min_sum{m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) :
  (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 2 (2 * m), (min k (2 * m + 1 - k) : ℝ)) = (m : ℝ) * (m + 1) - 2 := by
  classical
  have hsplit : Finset.Ico 2 (2 * m) =
      Finset.Ico 2 (m + 1) ∪ Finset.Ico (m + 1) (2 * m) := by
    ext k
    simp only [Finset.mem_Ico, Finset.mem_union]
    omega
  rw [hsplit]
  rw [Finset.sum_union]
  · have hlower :
        (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 2 (m + 1), min (k : ℝ) (2 * (m : ℝ) + 1 - k)) =
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 2 (m + 1), (k : ℝ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k hk
      simp only [Finset.mem_Ico] at hk
      rw [min_eq_left]
      have hkm : k ≤ m := by omega
      have hkm' : (k : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hkm
      linarith
    have hupper :
        (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico (m + 1) (2 * m), min (k : ℝ) (2 * (m : ℝ) + 1 - k)) =
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico (m + 1) (2 * m), (2 * (m : ℝ) + 1 - k) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k hk
      simp only [Finset.mem_Ico] at hk
      rw [min_eq_right]
      have hmk : m + 1 ≤ k := hk.1
      have hmk' : ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hmk
      push_cast at hmk'
      linarith
    rw [hlower, hupper]
    have hsum_range (n : ℕ) :
        2 * (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (k : ℝ)) = (n : ℝ) * (n - 1 : ℕ) := by
      rw [← Nat.cast_sum]
      norm_cast
      simpa [mul_comm] using Finset.sum_range_id_mul_two n
    rw [Finset.sum_Ico_eq_sub (fun k => (k : ℝ)) (by omega)]
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_Ico_eq_sub (fun k => (k : ℝ)) (by omega)]
    rw [Nat.card_Ico]
    have hcard : ((2 * m - (m + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) = (m : ℝ) - 1 := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega)]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hcard]
    have hs1 := hsum_range (m + 1)
    have hs2 := hsum_range (2 * m)
    norm_num at hs1
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega)] at hs2
    push_cast at hs2
    norm_num at hs2 ⊢
    nlinarith
  · simp only [Finset.disjoint_left, Finset.mem_Ico]
    omega

theorem imo1984p5_cyclic_min_weight_sum{n : ℕ} (hn : n > 3) :
  (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 2 (n - 1), (min k (n - k) : ℝ)) =
    (↑⌊(↑n : ℝ) / 2⌋ : ℝ) * (↑⌊((↑n : ℝ) + 1) / 2⌋ : ℝ) - 2 := by
  let m := n / 2
  have hmod : n % 2 = 0 ∨ n % 2 = 1 := by omega
  rcases hmod with hmod | hmod
  · have hn' : n = 2 * m := by
      dsimp [m]
      omega
    have hm : 2 ≤ m := by omega
    rw [hn']
    have hsum :
        (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 2 (2 * m - 1),
          min (k : ℝ) (((2 * m : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ))) = (m : ℝ) ^ 2 - 2 := by
      simpa only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] using imo1984p5_even_cyclic_min_sum hm
    rw [hsum]
    have hf1 : ⌊((2 * m : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2⌋ = (m : ℤ) := by
      rw [Int.floor_eq_iff]
      norm_num
    have hf2 : ⌊(((2 * m : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) / 2⌋ = (m : ℤ) := by
      rw [Int.floor_eq_iff]
      constructor <;> norm_num <;> nlinarith
    rw [hf1, hf2]
    norm_num
    ring
  · have hn' : n = 2 * m + 1 := by
      dsimp [m]
      omega
    have hm : 2 ≤ m := by omega
    rw [hn']
    have hsum :
        (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 2 (2 * m + 1 - 1),
          min (k : ℝ) (((2 * m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) - (k : ℝ))) =
            (m : ℝ) * (m + 1) - 2 := by
      convert imo1984p5_odd_cyclic_min_sum hm using 1 <;> norm_num [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul]
    rw [hsum]
    have hf1 : ⌊((2 * m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2⌋ = (m : ℤ) := by
      rw [Int.floor_eq_iff]
      constructor <;> norm_num <;> nlinarith
    have hf2 : ⌊(((2 * m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) / 2⌋ = (m + 1 : ℕ) := by
      rw [Int.floor_eq_iff]
      constructor <;> norm_num <;> nlinarith
    rw [hf1, hf2]
    norm_num

theorem imo1984p5_upper_ordered_sum{n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : n > 3) (P : Fin n → ℝ²)
  (hP : ∀ (i j : Fin n), j ≠ i - 1 → j ≠ i → (∡ (P (i - 1)) (P i) (P j)).sign = 1) :
  (∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ \ {i - 1, i, i + 1}, dist (P i) (P j)) <
    ((↑⌊(↑n : ℝ) / 2⌋ : ℝ) * (↑⌊((↑n : ℝ) + 1) / 2⌋ : ℝ) - 2) *
      ∑ i : Fin n, dist (P i) (P (i + 1)) := by
  rw [imo1984p5_ordered_diagonal_sum_offsets hn P]
  calc
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 2 (n - 1), ∑ i : Fin n, dist (P i) (P (i + Fin.ofNat n k))) <
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 2 (n - 1),
          (min k (n - k) : ℝ) * ∑ i : Fin n, dist (P i) (P (i + 1)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty
      · refine ⟨2, ?_⟩
        simp only [Finset.mem_Ico]
        omega
      · intro k hk
        simp only [Finset.mem_Ico] at hk
        exact imo1984p5_offset_chord_sum_lt hn P hP hk.1 (by omega)
    _ = ((↑⌊(↑n : ℝ) / 2⌋ : ℝ) * (↑⌊((↑n : ℝ) + 1) / 2⌋ : ℝ) - 2) *
          ∑ i : Fin n, dist (P i) (P (i + 1)) := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul, imo1984p5_cyclic_min_weight_sum hn]

theorem imo1984p5_perimeter_pos{n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hn : n > 3) (P : Fin n → ℝ²)
  (hP : ∀ (i j : Fin n), j ≠ i - 1 → j ≠ i → (∡ (P (i - 1)) (P i) (P j)).sign = 1) :
  0 < ∑ i : Fin n, dist (P i) (P (i + 1)) := by
  have hn1 : 1 < n := by omega
  have hn2 : 2 < n := by omega
  have hsub : (1 : Fin n) - 1 = 0 := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hn1]
  have h20 : (2 : Fin n) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    simpa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hn2] using hv
  have h21 : (2 : Fin n) ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    simpa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hn2, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hn1] using hv
  have hang : (∡ (P 0) (P 1) (P 2)).sign = 1 := by
    simpa [hsub] using hP (1 : Fin n) (2 : Fin n) (by simpa [hsub] using h20) h21
  have hne : P 0 ≠ P 1 :=
    EuclideanGeometry.left_ne_of_oangle_sign_eq_one hang
  apply Finset.sum_pos'
  · intro i hi
    exact dist_nonneg

    [ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] (a : α) (n k : ℕ)
    (s : Set ℝ) (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    (u : Set (((Finset.Iic k → α × ℝ) × α) × (Finset.Iic n → ℝ))) (hu : MeasurableSet u)
    (hua : ∀ x ∈ u, x.1.2 = a) :
    Bandit.measure alg ν
        ({ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) | Learning.reward (k + 1) ω.1 ∈ s} ∩
          rewardByCountFiniteData a n k ⁻¹' u)
      = ν a s * Bandit.measure alg ν (rewardByCountFiniteData a n k ⁻¹' u) := by
  let f : (ℕ → α × ℝ) → ((Finset.Iic k → α × ℝ) × α) :=
    fun ω ↦ (Learning.hist k ω, Learning.action (k + 1) ω)
  let q : (ℕ → α → ℝ) → (Finset.Iic n → ℝ) := fun ω i ↦ ω (i : ℕ) a
  have hf : Measurable f := by fun_prop
  have hq : Measurable q := by fun_prop
  have htraj (v : Set ((Finset.Iic k → α × ℝ) × α)) (hv : MeasurableSet v)
      (hva : ∀ x ∈ v, x.2 = a) :
      Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν
          ({ω | Learning.reward (k + 1) ω ∈ s} ∩ f ⁻¹' v)
        = ν a s * Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν (f ⁻¹' v) := by
    have h_joint :
        (Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν).map
            (fun ω ↦ (Learning.hist k ω,
              (Learning.action (k + 1) ω, Learning.reward (k + 1) ω)))
          = (Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν).map (Learning.hist k) ⊗ₘ
              Bandit.stepKernel alg ν k := by
      unfold Bandit.trajMeasure Learning.trajMeasure Bandit.stepKernel
      rw [Learning.hist_eq_frestrictLe]
      exact ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.map_frestrictLe_trajMeasure_compProd_eq_map_trajMeasure.symm
    have h_f :
        (Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν).map f =
          (Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν).map (Learning.hist k) ⊗ₘ alg.policy k := by
      calc
        (Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν).map f =
            ((Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν).map
              (fun ω ↦ (Learning.hist k ω,
                (Learning.action (k + 1) ω, Learning.reward (k + 1) ω)))).map
              (Prod.map id Prod.fst) := by
                rw [Measure.map_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
                rfl
        _ = ((Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν).map (Learning.hist k) ⊗ₘ
              Bandit.stepKernel alg ν k).map (Prod.map id Prod.fst) := by rw [h_joint]
        _ = (Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν).map (Learning.hist k) ⊗ₘ alg.policy k := by
          rw [← Measure.compProd_map (by fun_prop),
            ← ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.fst_eq, Bandit.fst_stepKernel]
    let w : Set ((Finset.Iic k → α × ℝ) × (α × ℝ)) :=
      {x | x.2.2 ∈ s ∧ (x.1, x.2.1) ∈ v}
    have hw : MeasurableSet w := by
      exact (hs.preimage (by fun_prop)).inter (hv.preimage (by fun_prop))
    have hstep (h : Finset.Iic k → α × ℝ) :
        Bandit.stepKernel alg ν k h (Prod.mk h ⁻¹' w)
          = ν a s * alg.policy k h {b | (h, b) ∈ v} := by
      rw [Bandit.stepKernel, Learning.stepKernel, Learning.stationaryEnv_feedback,
        ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.compProd_apply (measurable_prodMk_left hw)]
      have hA : MeasurableSet {b : α | (h, b) ∈ v} := hv.preimage (by fun_prop)
      rw [← MeasureTheory.setLIntegral_const, ← MeasureTheory.lintegral_indicator hA]
      apply MeasureTheory.lintegral_congr
      intro b
      rw [ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.prodMkLeft_apply']
      by_cases hb : (h, b) ∈ v
      · have hba : b = a := hva (h, b) hb
        subst b
        simp [Set.indicator_apply, hb, w]
      · simp [Set.indicator_apply, hb, w]
    have heq :
        {ω | Learning.reward (k + 1) ω ∈ s} ∩ f ⁻¹' v =
          (fun ω ↦ (Learning.hist k ω,
            (Learning.action (k + 1) ω, Learning.reward (k + 1) ω))) ⁻¹' w := by
      ext ω
      rfl
    rw [heq, ← Measure.map_apply (by fun_prop) hw, h_joint,
      Measure.compProd_apply hw]
    simp_rw [hstep]
    rw [MeasureTheory.lintegral_const_mul]
    · congr 1
      calc
        (∫⁻ h, alg.policy k h {b | (h, b) ∈ v}
            ∂(Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν).map (Learning.hist k)) =
            ((Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν).map (Learning.hist k) ⊗ₘ alg.policy k) v := by
              exact (Measure.compProd_apply hv).symm
        _ = (Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν).map f v := by rw [h_f]
        _ = Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν (f ⁻¹' v) := Measure.map_apply hf hv
    · exact ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.measurable_kernel_prodMk_left hv
  have hD : MeasurableSet (rewardByCountFiniteData a n k ⁻¹' u) :=
    hu.preimage (by fun_prop)
  have hE : MeasurableSet
      ({ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) | Learning.reward (k + 1) ω.1 ∈ s} ∩
        rewardByCountFiniteData a n k ⁻¹' u) :=
    (hs.preimage (by fun_prop)).inter hD
  have hsection (z : ℕ → α → ℝ) :
      Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν
          ((fun x ↦ (x, z)) ⁻¹'
            ({ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) |
                Learning.reward (k + 1) ω.1 ∈ s} ∩
              rewardByCountFiniteData a n k ⁻¹' u))
        = ν a s * Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν
            ((fun x ↦ (x, z)) ⁻¹' (rewardByCountFiniteData a n k ⁻¹' u)) := by
    let vz : Set ((Finset.Iic k → α × ℝ) × α) := (fun x ↦ (x, q z)) ⁻¹' u
    have hvz : MeasurableSet vz := hu.preimage (by fun_prop)
    have hvza : ∀ x ∈ vz, x.2 = a := by
      intro x hx
      exact hua (x, q z) hx
    simpa only [f, q, rewardByCountFiniteData, Set.preimage, Set.mem_setOf_eq,
      Set.mem_inter_iff] using htraj vz hvz hvza
  unfold Bandit.measure
  rw [Measure.prod_apply_symm hE, Measure.prod_apply_symm hD]
  simp_rw [hsection]
  rw [MeasureTheory.lintegral_const_mul]
  exact measurable_measure_prodMk_right hD

theorem measurableSet_rewardByCount_previous_top_slice{α : Type*} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} [DecidableEq α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α]
    (a : α) (n : ℕ) (t : Set (Finset.Iic n → ℝ)) (ht : MeasurableSet t) :
    MeasurableSet[MeasurableSpace.comap (rewardByCountTopData a n) inferInstance]
      {ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) |
        Learning.stepsUntil a (n + 1) ω.1 = ⊤ ∧
          (fun i : Finset.Iic n ↦ Learning.rewardByCount a (i : ℕ) ω) ∈ t} := by
  classical
  rw [← measurable_indicator_const_iff (1 : ℕ)]
  let k : ((ℕ → α × ℝ) × (Finset.Iic n → ℝ)) →
      ((ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ)) := fun x =>
    (x.1, fun i b => if hi : i ∈ Finset.Iic n ∧ b = a then x.2 ⟨i, hi.1⟩ else 0)
  have hk : Measurable k := by
    unfold k
    refine Measurable.prod ?_ ?_
    · fun_prop
    · rw [measurable_pi_iff]
      intro i
      rw [measurable_pi_iff]
      intro b
      dsimp only
      split_ifs <;> fun_prop
  let φ : ((ℕ → α × ℝ) × (Finset.Iic n → ℝ)) → ℕ := fun x =>
    if Learning.stepsUntil a (n + 1) x.1 = ⊤ ∧
        (fun i : Finset.Iic n => Learning.rewardByCount a (i : ℕ) (k x)) ∈ t
    then 1 else 0
  have hprev : Measurable (fun x =>
      (fun i : Finset.Iic n => Learning.rewardByCount a (i : ℕ) (k x))) := by
    rw [measurable_pi_iff]
    intro i
    exact (Learning.measurable_rewardByCount a (i : ℕ)).comp hk
  have hcond : MeasurableSet {x : ((ℕ → α × ℝ) × (Finset.Iic n → ℝ)) |
      Learning.stepsUntil a (n + 1) x.1 = ⊤ ∧
        (fun i : Finset.Iic n => Learning.rewardByCount a (i : ℕ) (k x)) ∈ t} :=
    ((measurableSet_singleton _).preimage
      ((Learning.measurable_stepsUntil a (n + 1)).comp measurable_fst)).inter
      (ht.preimage hprev)
  have hφ : Measurable φ := by
    unfold φ
    exact Measurable.ite hcond measurable_const measurable_const
  suffices {ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) |
        Learning.stepsUntil a (n + 1) ω.1 = ⊤ ∧
          (fun i : Finset.Iic n => Learning.rewardByCount a (i : ℕ) ω) ∈ t}.indicator
          (fun _ => (1 : ℕ)) = φ ∘ rewardByCountTopData a n from
    this ▸ measurable_comp_comap _ hφ
  ext ω
  have hv : (fun i : Finset.Iic n => Learning.rewardByCount a (i : ℕ) ω) =
      (fun i : Finset.Iic n => Learning.rewardByCount a (i : ℕ)
        (k (rewardByCountTopData a n ω))) := by
    funext i
    simp [Learning.rewardByCount, k, rewardByCountTopData, Finset.mem_Iic]
  simp only [Set.indicator_apply, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Function.comp_apply, φ]
  simpa only [rewardByCountTopData, hv]

theorem measure_reserve_succ_inter_topData{α : Type*} {mα : MeasurableSpace α}
    (alg : Learning.Algorithm α ℝ) (ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α ℝ)
    [ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] (a : α) (n : ℕ)
    (s : Set ℝ) (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    (u : Set ((ℕ → α × ℝ) × (Finset.Iic n → ℝ))) (hu : MeasurableSet u) :
    Bandit.measure alg ν
        ({ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) | ω.2 (n + 1) a ∈ s} ∩
          rewardByCountTopData a n ⁻¹' u)
      = ν a s * Bandit.measure alg ν (rewardByCountTopData a n ⁻¹' u) := by
  unfold Bandit.measure
  let X : (ℕ → α → ℝ) → ℝ := fun z ↦ z (n + 1) a
  let Y : (ℕ → α → ℝ) → (Finset.Iic n → ℝ) := fun z i ↦ z (i : ℕ) a
  have hX : Measurable X := by fun_prop
  have hY : Measurable Y := by fun_prop
  have hInd : IndepFun X Y (Bandit.streamMeasure ν) := by
    exact ((iIndepFun_eval_streamMeasure'' ν a).indepFun_finset₀ {n + 1} (Iic n)
      (by simp) (fun i ↦ Measurable.aemeasurable (by fun_prop))).comp
        (measurable_pi_apply ⟨n + 1, by simp⟩) measurable_id
  have hE : MeasurableSet
      ({ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) | ω.2 (n + 1) a ∈ s} ∩
        rewardByCountTopData a n ⁻¹' u) := by
    exact (hs.preimage (by fun_prop)).inter (hu.preimage (by fun_prop))
  have hB : MeasurableSet (rewardByCountTopData a n ⁻¹' u) :=
    hu.preimage (by fun_prop)
  rw [Measure.prod_apply hE, Measure.prod_apply hB]
  have hpoint (x : ℕ → α × ℝ) :
      (Bandit.streamMeasure ν)
          (Prod.mk x ⁻¹' ({ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) |
            ω.2 (n + 1) a ∈ s} ∩ rewardByCountTopData a n ⁻¹' u))
        = (ν a) s * (Bandit.streamMeasure ν)
          (Prod.mk x ⁻¹' (rewardByCountTopData a n ⁻¹' u)) := by
    have hsec : MeasurableSet (Prod.mk x ⁻¹' u) := hu.preimage measurable_prodMk_left
    have hi := hInd.measure_inter_preimage_eq_mul s (Prod.mk x ⁻¹' u) hs hsec
    have hmarg : (Bandit.streamMeasure ν) (X ⁻¹' s) = (ν a) s := by
      rw [← (hasLaw_eval_eval_streamMeasure ν (n + 1) a).map_eq]
      exact (Measure.map_apply hX hs).symm
    rw [hmarg] at hi
    exact hi
  simp_rw [hpoint]
  rw [lintegral_const_mul]
  exact measurable_measure_prodMk_left hB

theorem measure_rewardByCount_one_zero_slice{α : Type*} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} [DecidableEq α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α]
    (alg : Learning.Algorithm α ℝ) (ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α ℝ)
    [ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] (a : α)
    (s t : Set ℝ) (hs : MeasurableSet s) (ht : MeasurableSet t) :
    Bandit.measure alg ν
        ({ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) | Learning.rewardByCount a 1 ω ∈ s} ∩
          ({ω | Learning.stepsUntil a 1 ω.1 = 0} ∩
            {ω | Learning.rewardByCount a 0 ω ∈ t}))
      = ν a s * Bandit.measure alg ν
          ({ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) |
              Learning.stepsUntil a 1 ω.1 = 0} ∩
            {ω | Learning.rewardByCount a 0 ω ∈ t}) := by
  have h_left :
      ({ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) | rewardByCount a 1 ω ∈ s} ∩
          ({ω | stepsUntil a 1 ω.1 = 0} ∩ {ω | rewardByCount a 0 ω ∈ t}))
        = ({h : ℕ → α × ℝ | action 0 h = a ∧ reward 0 h ∈ s} ×ˢ
            {z : ℕ → α → ℝ | z 0 a ∈ t}) := by
    ext ω
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hrs, hstep, hrt⟩
      have ha : action 0 ω.1 = a := by
        simpa only [stepsUntil_eq_zero_iff, one_ne_zero, false_and, true_and, false_or] using hstep
      have hr : rewardByCount a 1 ω = reward 0 ω.1 :=
        rewardByCount_of_stepsUntil_eq_coe hstep
      have htop : stepsUntil a 0 ω.1 = ⊤ := stepsUntil_zero_of_eq ha
      have hz : rewardByCount a 0 ω = ω.2 0 a :=
        rewardByCount_of_stepsUntil_eq_top htop
      have hrs' : reward 0 ω.1 ∈ s := by rw [← hr]; exact hrs
      have hrt' : ω.2 0 a ∈ t := by rw [← hz]; exact hrt
      exact ⟨⟨ha, hrs'⟩, hrt'⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨ha, hrs⟩, hrt⟩
      have hstep : stepsUntil a 1 ω.1 = 0 := by
        rw [stepsUntil_eq_zero_iff]
        exact Or.inr ⟨rfl, ha⟩
      have hr : rewardByCount a 1 ω = reward 0 ω.1 :=
        rewardByCount_of_stepsUntil_eq_coe hstep
      have htop : stepsUntil a 0 ω.1 = ⊤ := stepsUntil_zero_of_eq ha
      have hz : rewardByCount a 0 ω = ω.2 0 a :=
        rewardByCount_of_stepsUntil_eq_top htop
      have hrs' : rewardByCount a 1 ω ∈ s := by rw [hr]; exact hrs
      have hrt' : rewardByCount a 0 ω ∈ t := by rw [hz]; exact hrt
      exact ⟨hrs', hstep, hrt'⟩
  have h_right :
      ({ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) | stepsUntil a 1 ω.1 = 0} ∩
          {ω | rewardByCount a 0 ω ∈ t})
        = ({h : ℕ → α × ℝ | action 0 h = a} ×ˢ {z : ℕ → α → ℝ | z 0 a ∈ t}) := by
    ext ω
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hstep, hrt⟩
      have ha : action 0 ω.1 = a := by
        simpa only [stepsUntil_eq_zero_iff, one_ne_zero, false_and, true_and, false_or] using hstep
      have htop : stepsUntil a 0 ω.1 = ⊤ := stepsUntil_zero_of_eq ha
      have hz : rewardByCount a 0 ω = ω.2 0 a :=
        rewardByCount_of_stepsUntil_eq_top htop
      have hrt' : ω.2 0 a ∈ t := by rw [← hz]; exact hrt
      exact ⟨ha, hrt'⟩
    · rintro ⟨ha, hrt⟩
      have hstep : stepsUntil a 1 ω.1 = 0 := by
        rw [stepsUntil_eq_zero_iff]
        exact Or.inr ⟨rfl, ha⟩
      have htop : stepsUntil a 0 ω.1 = ⊤ := stepsUntil_zero_of_eq ha
      have hz : rewardByCount a 0 ω = ω.2 0 a :=
        rewardByCount_of_stepsUntil_eq_top htop
      have hrt' : rewardByCount a 0 ω ∈ t := by rw [hz]; exact hrt
      exact ⟨hstep, hrt'⟩
  have hstep :
      (Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν).map (fun h : ℕ → α × ℝ ↦ h 0) = alg.p0 ⊗ₘ ν :=
    (Bandits.hasLaw_step_zero alg ν).map_eq
  have h_traj_s :
      Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν {h : ℕ → α × ℝ | action 0 h = a ∧ reward 0 h ∈ s}
        = alg.p0 {a} * ν a s := by
    calc
      Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν {h : ℕ → α × ℝ | action 0 h = a ∧ reward 0 h ∈ s}
          = (Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν).map (fun h : ℕ → α × ℝ ↦ h 0) ({a} ×ˢ s) := by
              rw [Measure.map_apply (by fun_prop) ((measurableSet_singleton a).prod hs)]
              rfl
      _ = (alg.p0 ⊗ₘ ν) ({a} ×ˢ s) := by rw [hstep]
      _ = alg.p0 {a} * ν a s := by
              rw [Measure.compProd_apply_prod (measurableSet_singleton a) hs]
              simp
  have haction : (Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν).map (action 0) = alg.p0 := by
    exact (Learning.hasLaw_action_zero alg (stationaryEnv ν)).map_eq
  have h_traj_a :
      Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν {h : ℕ → α × ℝ | action 0 h = a} = alg.p0 {a} := by
    calc
      Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν {h : ℕ → α × ℝ | action 0 h = a}
          = (Bandit.trajMeasure alg ν).map (action 0) {a} := by
              rw [Measure.map_apply (by fun_prop) (measurableSet_singleton a)]
              rfl
      _ = alg.p0 {a} := by rw [haction]
  rw [h_left, h_right]
  unfold Bandit.measure
  rw [Measure.prod_prod, Measure.prod_prod, h_traj_s, h_traj_a]
  ac_rfl

theorem measure_rewardByCount_top_slice_previous{α : Type*} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} [DecidableEq α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α]
    (alg : Learning.Algorithm α ℝ) (ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α ℝ)
    [ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] (a : α) (n : ℕ)
    (s : Set ℝ) (t : Set (Finset.Iic n → ℝ)) (hs : MeasurableSet s) (ht : MeasurableSet t) :
    Bandit.measure alg ν
        (({ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) | Learning.rewardByCount a (n + 1) ω ∈ s} ∩
          {ω | (fun i : Finset.Iic n ↦ Learning.rewardByCount a (i : ℕ) ω) ∈ t}) ∩
          {ω | Learning.stepsUntil a (n + 1) ω.1 = ⊤})
      = ν a s * Bandit.measure alg ν
          ({ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) |
              (fun i : Finset.Iic n ↦ Learning.rewardByCount a (i : ℕ) ω) ∈ t} ∩
            {ω | Learning.stepsUntil a (n + 1) ω.1 = ⊤}) := by
  have hmeas := measurableSet_rewardByCount_previous_top_slice a n t ht
  rw [MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_comap] at hmeas
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hu_eq⟩ := hmeas
  have hA : rewardByCountTopData a n ⁻¹' u =
      ({ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) |
          (fun i : Finset.Iic n ↦ Learning.rewardByCount a (i : ℕ) ω) ∈ t} ∩
        {ω | Learning.stepsUntil a (n + 1) ω.1 = ⊤}) := by
    rw [hu_eq]
    ext ω
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff]
    exact and_comm
  have hevent :
      (({ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) |
            Learning.rewardByCount a (n + 1) ω ∈ s} ∩
          {ω | (fun i : Finset.Iic n ↦ Learning.rewardByCount a (i : ℕ) ω) ∈ t}) ∩
        {ω | Learning.stepsUntil a (n + 1) ω.1 = ⊤}) =
      ({ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) | ω.2 (n + 1) a ∈ s} ∩
        rewardByCountTopData a n ⁻¹' u) := by
    rw [hA]
    ext ω
    simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨hrs, hprev⟩, htop⟩
      refine ⟨?_, hprev, htop⟩
      rwa [Learning.rewardByCount_of_stepsUntil_eq_top htop] at hrs
    · rintro ⟨hrs, hprev, htop⟩
      refine ⟨⟨?_, hprev⟩, htop⟩
      rwa [Learning.rewardByCount_of_stepsUntil_eq_top htop]
  rw [hevent, ← hA]
  exact measure_reserve_succ_inter_topData alg ν a n s hs u hu

theorem measure_rewardByCount_finite_slice_previous{α : Type*} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} [DecidableEq α] [MeasurableSingletonClass α]
    (alg : Learning.Algorithm α ℝ) (ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α ℝ)
    [ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] (a : α) (n k : ℕ)
    (s : Set ℝ) (t : Set (Finset.Iic n → ℝ)) (hs : MeasurableSet s) (ht : MeasurableSet t) :
    Bandit.measure alg ν
        (({ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) | Learning.rewardByCount a (n + 1) ω ∈ s} ∩
          {ω | (fun i : Finset.Iic n ↦ Learning.rewardByCount a (i : ℕ) ω) ∈ t}) ∩
          {ω | Learning.stepsUntil a (n + 1) ω.1 = ↑(k + 1)})
      = ν a s * Bandit.measure alg ν
          ({ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) |
              (fun i : Finset.Iic n ↦ Learning.rewardByCount a (i : ℕ) ω) ∈ t} ∩
            {ω | Learning.stepsUntil a (n + 1) ω.1 = ↑(k + 1)}) := by
  have hcomap := measurableSet_rewardByCount_previous_finite_slice a n k t ht
  rw [MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_comap] at hcomap
  obtain ⟨u0, hu0, hpre⟩ := hcomap
  let u := u0 ∩ {x | x.1.2 = a}
  have hu : MeasurableSet u := by
    exact hu0.inter ((measurableSet_singleton a).preimage (measurable_snd.comp measurable_fst))
  have hua : ∀ x ∈ u, x.1.2 = a := by
    intro x hx
    exact hx.2
  have hpre_u :
      rewardByCountFiniteData a n k ⁻¹' u =
        {ω : (ℕ → α × ℝ) × (ℕ → α → ℝ) |
          (fun i : Finset.Iic n ↦ Learning.rewardByCount a (i : ℕ) ω) ∈ t} ∩
        {ω | Learning.stepsUntil a (n + 1) ω.1 = ↑(k + 1)} := by
    rw [show u = u0 ∩ {x | x.1.2 = a} from rfl, Set.preimage_inter, hpre]
    ext ω
    simp only [Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_preimage]
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact ⟨h.1.2, h.1.1⟩
    · intro h
