  | succ n ih =>
      have hk' : pullCount (action alg) a (n + 1) ω ≤ k := by
        exact le_trans (pullCount_mono a (by omega) ω) hk
      have hhist := ih hk'
      let b := algFunction alg n (hist alg ω n) (ω.1 (n + 1))
      let j := pullCount' n (hist alg ω n) b
      have hpath : (fun i : Iic n ↦ (action alg i ω, reward alg i ω)) = hist alg ω n := by
        simpa only [action, reward, Prod.eta] using (hist_eq alg ω n).symm
      have hj : j = pullCount (action alg) b (n + 1) ω := by
        rw [pullCount_add_one_eq_pullCount' (R' := reward alg), hpath]
      have hab : action alg (n + 1) ω = b := by
        rw [action_add_one_eq]
      have hpair : (j, b) ≠ (k, a) := by
        intro h
        have hjk : j = k := (Prod.mk.inj h).1
        have hba : b = a := (Prod.mk.inj h).2
        have hjcount : j = pullCount (action alg) a (n + 1) ω := by
          rw [← hba]
          exact hj
        have hacta : action alg (n + 1) ω = a := hab.trans hba
        have hadd := pullCount_add_one (A := action alg) (a := a) (t := n + 1) (ω := ω)
        simp only [hacta, if_true] at hadd
        omega
      rw [hist_add_one, hist_add_one]
      apply funext
      intro i
      by_cases hin : (i : ℕ) ≤ n
      · simp only [hin, ↓reduceDIte]
        rw [hhist]
      · simp only [hin, ↓reduceDIte]
        rw [hhist]
        simp only [setReward]
        change (b, if (j, b) = (k, a) then r else ω.2 j b) = (b, ω.2 j b)
        rw [if_neg hpair]

theorem hist_maskReward_of_pullCount_le{α R : Type*} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {mR : MeasurableSpace R}
    [Nonempty α] [StandardBorelSpace α] [DecidableEq α] [Countable α]
    [StandardBorelSpace R] [Nonempty R] (alg : Algorithm α R)
    (ω : probSpace α R) (n k : ℕ) (a : α)
    (hk : pullCount (action alg) a (n + 1) ω ≤ k) :
    hist alg (maskReward k a ω) n = hist alg ω n := by
  let r : R := Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty R)
  have hmask : maskReward k a ω = setReward k a r ω := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · rfl
    · funext j b
      by_cases h : (j, b) = (k, a)
      · have hj : j = k := congrArg Prod.fst h
        have hb : b = a := congrArg Prod.snd h
        subst j
        subst b
        simp [maskReward, setReward, rewardArrayOfWithout, rewardArrayWithout, r]
      · have h' : ¬(j = k ∧ b = a) := by
          intro hjb
          apply h
          exact Prod.ext hjb.1 hjb.2
        simp [maskReward, setReward, rewardArrayOfWithout, rewardArrayWithout, r, h, h']
  rw [hmask]
  exact hist_setReward_of_pullCount_le alg ω n k a r hk

theorem measurable_maskReward{α R : Type*} {mR : MeasurableSpace R} [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty R]
    (k : ℕ) (a : α) : Measurable (maskReward (R := R) k a) := by
  unfold maskReward rewardArrayOfWithout rewardArrayWithout
  apply Measurable.prodMk measurable_fst
  rw [measurable_pi_iff]
  intro j
  rw [measurable_pi_iff]
  intro b
  by_cases h : (j, b) = (k, a)
  · simp only [h, ↓reduceDIte]
    fun_prop
  · simp only [h, ↓reduceDIte]
    fun_prop

theorem indepFun_maskReward_eval{α R : Type*} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {mR : MeasurableSpace R}
    [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty R] (ν : Kernel α R) [IsMarkovKernel ν]
    (k : ℕ) (a : α) :
    IndepFun (maskReward (R := R) k a) (fun ω : probSpace α R ↦ ω.2 k a)
      (arrayMeasure ν) := by
  have h := indepFun_array_without_coord ν k a
  let F : ((ℕ → I) × ({p : ℕ × α // p ≠ (k, a)} → R)) → probSpace α R :=
    fun p ↦ (p.1, rewardArrayOfWithout k a p.2)
  have hF : Measurable F := by
    apply Measurable.prodMk measurable_fst
    rw [measurable_pi_iff]
    intro j
    rw [measurable_pi_iff]
    intro b
    unfold rewardArrayOfWithout
    by_cases hjb : (j, b) = (k, a)
    · simp only [hjb, ↓reduceDIte]
      exact measurable_const
    · simp only [hjb, ↓reduceDIte]
      fun_prop
  have hc := h.comp hF (measurable_id : Measurable (id : R → R))
  simpa only [F, Function.comp_apply, id_eq, maskReward] using hc

theorem action_pullCount_eq_of_hist_eq{α R : Type*} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {mR : MeasurableSpace R}
    [Nonempty α] [StandardBorelSpace α] [DecidableEq α] [Countable α]
    [StandardBorelSpace R] [Nonempty R] (alg : Algorithm α R)
    {ω ω' : probSpace α R} (n : ℕ)
    (hhist : hist alg ω n = hist alg ω' n)
    (hfirst : ω.1 (n + 1) = ω'.1 (n + 1)) :
    action alg (n + 1) ω = action alg (n + 1) ω' ∧
      ∀ a, pullCount (action alg) a (n + 1) ω =
        pullCount (action alg) a (n + 1) ω' := by
  constructor
  · rw [congrFun (action_add_one_eq alg n) ω,
      congrFun (action_add_one_eq alg n) ω', hhist, hfirst]
  · intro a
    apply pullCount_congr (n := n)
    intro i hi
    have hpathω : (fun j : Iic n ↦ (action alg j ω, reward alg j ω)) = hist alg ω n := by
      simpa only [action, reward, Prod.eta] using (hist_eq alg ω n).symm
    have hpathω' : (fun j : Iic n ↦ (action alg j ω', reward alg j ω')) = hist alg ω' n := by
      simpa only [action, reward, Prod.eta] using (hist_eq alg ω' n).symm
    let j : Iic n := ⟨i, by simpa using hi⟩
    have hpair := (congrFun hpathω j).trans
      ((congrFun hhist j).trans (congrFun hpathω' j).symm)
    exact congrArg Prod.fst hpair

theorem selected_state_maskReward{α R : Type*} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {mR : MeasurableSpace R}
    [Nonempty α] [StandardBorelSpace α] [DecidableEq α] [Countable α]
    [StandardBorelSpace R] [Nonempty R] (alg : Algorithm α R)
    (ω : probSpace α R) (n : ℕ) :
    let a := action alg (n + 1) ω
    let k := pullCount (action alg) a (n + 1) ω
    hist alg (maskReward k a ω) n = hist alg ω n ∧
      action alg (n + 1) (maskReward k a ω) = a ∧
      pullCount (action alg) a (n + 1) (maskReward k a ω) = k := by
  dsimp only
  let a := action alg (n + 1) ω
  let k := pullCount (action alg) a (n + 1) ω
  change hist alg (maskReward k a ω) n = hist alg ω n ∧
    action alg (n + 1) (maskReward k a ω) = a ∧
    pullCount (action alg) a (n + 1) (maskReward k a ω) = k
  have hhist : hist alg (maskReward k a ω) n = hist alg ω n :=
    hist_maskReward_of_pullCount_le alg ω n k a le_rfl
  have hnext := action_pullCount_eq_of_hist_eq alg n hhist rfl
  exact ⟨hhist, hnext.1, hnext.2 a⟩

theorem setReward_maskReward_original{α R : Type*} {mR : MeasurableSpace R} [DecidableEq α] [Nonempty R]
    (k : ℕ) (a : α) (ω : probSpace α R) :
    setReward k a (ω.2 k a) (maskReward k a ω) = ω := by
  apply Prod.ext
  · rfl
  · funext j b
    by_cases h : (j, b) = (k, a)
    · rcases Prod.mk.inj h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      simp [setReward, maskReward, rewardArrayOfWithout, rewardArrayWithout]
    · have h' : ¬(j = k ∧ b = a) := by
        intro hab
        exact h (Prod.ext hab.1 hab.2)
      simp [setReward, maskReward, rewardArrayOfWithout, rewardArrayWithout, h']

theorem selectedFiber_maskReward_iff{α R : Type*} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {mR : MeasurableSpace R}
    [Nonempty α] [StandardBorelSpace α] [DecidableEq α] [Countable α]
    [StandardBorelSpace R] [Nonempty R] (alg : Algorithm α R)
    (ω : probSpace α R) (n k : ℕ) (a : α) :
    (action alg (n + 1) (maskReward k a ω) = a ∧
      pullCount (action alg) a (n + 1) (maskReward k a ω) = k) ↔
    (action alg (n + 1) ω = a ∧
      pullCount (action alg) a (n + 1) ω = k) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ha, hc⟩
    have hhist : hist alg (setReward k a (ω.2 k a) (maskReward k a ω)) n =
        hist alg (maskReward k a ω) n :=
      hist_setReward_of_pullCount_le alg (maskReward k a ω) n k a (ω.2 k a) (by omega)
    rw [setReward_maskReward_original] at hhist
    have htransfer := action_pullCount_eq_of_hist_eq alg n hhist rfl
    exact ⟨htransfer.1.trans ha, (htransfer.2 a).trans hc⟩
  · rintro ⟨ha, hc⟩
    have hhist : hist alg (maskReward k a ω) n = hist alg ω n :=
      hist_maskReward_of_pullCount_le alg ω n k a (by omega)
    have htransfer := action_pullCount_eq_of_hist_eq alg n hhist rfl
    exact ⟨htransfer.1.trans ha, (htransfer.2 a).trans hc⟩

theorem map_restrict_preimage_of_indepFun{Ω β γ : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {mβ : MeasurableSpace β}
    {mγ : MeasurableSpace γ} {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → β} {Y : Ω → γ} (h : IndepFun X Y μ)
    (hX : Measurable X) (hY : Measurable Y) (s : Set β) (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    Measure.map (fun ω ↦ (X ω, Y ω)) (μ.restrict (X ⁻¹' s)) =
      (Measure.map X (μ.restrict (X ⁻¹' s))).prod (μ.map Y) := by
  rw [ProbabilityTheory.indepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_map_map hX.aemeasurable hY.aemeasurable] at h
  have hpre : (fun ω ↦ (X ω, Y ω)) ⁻¹' (s ×ˢ Set.univ) = X ⁻¹' s := by
    ext ω
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_prod, Set.mem_univ, and_true]
  calc
    Measure.map (fun ω ↦ (X ω, Y ω)) (μ.restrict (X ⁻¹' s)) =
        Measure.map (fun ω ↦ (X ω, Y ω))
          (μ.restrict ((fun ω ↦ (X ω, Y ω)) ⁻¹' (s ×ˢ Set.univ))) := by rw [hpre]
    _ = (Measure.map (fun ω ↦ (X ω, Y ω)) μ).restrict (s ×ˢ Set.univ) :=
      (Measure.restrict_map (hX.prodMk hY) (hs.prod MeasurableSet.univ)).symm
    _ = ((Measure.map X μ).prod (Measure.map Y μ)).restrict (s ×ˢ Set.univ) := by rw [h]
    _ = ((Measure.map X μ).restrict s).prod (Measure.map Y μ) := by
      rw [← Measure.prod_restrict s Set.univ]
      simp only [Measure.restrict_univ]
    _ = (Measure.map X (μ.restrict (X ⁻¹' s))).prod (Measure.map Y μ) := by
      rw [Measure.restrict_map hX hs]

theorem map_adaptive_eval_of_fiberwise{Ω β ι γ : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {mβ : MeasurableSpace β}
    {mι : MeasurableSpace ι} {mγ : MeasurableSpace γ}
    [Countable ι] [MeasurableSingletonClass ι]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (X : Ω → β) (q : Ω → ι)
    (Y : ι → Ω → γ) (κ : ι → Measure γ) [∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (κ i)]
    (K : Kernel β γ) [IsMarkovKernel K]
    (hX : Measurable X) (hq : Measurable q)
    (hY : AEMeasurable (fun ω ↦ Y (q ω) ω) μ)
    (qX : β → ι) (hqX : Measurable qX) (hq_eq : q = qX ∘ X)
    (hK : ∀ x, K x = κ (qX x))
    (hfiber : ∀ i,
      Measure.map (fun ω ↦ (X ω, Y i ω)) (μ.restrict (q ⁻¹' {i})) =
        Measure.map X (μ.restrict (q ⁻¹' {i})) ⊗ₘ Kernel.const β (κ i)) :
    Measure.map (fun ω ↦ (X ω, Y (q ω) ω)) μ = Measure.map X μ ⊗ₘ K := by
  have hq_fiber (i : ι) : MeasurableSet (q ⁻¹' ({i} : Set ι)) :=
    hq (measurableSet_singleton i)
  have hdisj : Pairwise (fun i j : ι => Disjoint (q ⁻¹' ({i} : Set ι)) (q ⁻¹' ({j} : Set ι))) := by
    intro i j hij
    simp only [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro ω hi hj
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hi hj
    exact hij (hi.symm.trans hj)
  have hunion : (⋃ i : ι, q ⁻¹' ({i} : Set ι)) = Set.univ := by
    ext ω
    simp
  have hμ : μ = Measure.sum (fun i : ι => μ.restrict (q ⁻¹' ({i} : Set ι))) := by
    calc
      μ = μ.restrict Set.univ := Measure.restrict_univ.symm
      _ = μ.restrict (⋃ i : ι, q ⁻¹' ({i} : Set ι)) := by rw [hunion]
      _ = Measure.sum (fun i : ι => μ.restrict (q ⁻¹' ({i} : Set ι))) :=
        Measure.restrict_iUnion hdisj hq_fiber
  have hF : AEMeasurable (fun ω => (X ω, Y (q ω) ω)) μ :=
    hX.aemeasurable.prodMk hY
  have hmap_sum :
      Measure.map (fun ω => (X ω, Y (q ω) ω)) μ =
        Measure.sum (fun i : ι =>
          Measure.map (fun ω => (X ω, Y (q ω) ω)) (μ.restrict (q ⁻¹' ({i} : Set ι)))) := by
    calc
      Measure.map (fun ω => (X ω, Y (q ω) ω)) μ =
          Measure.map (fun ω => (X ω, Y (q ω) ω))
            (Measure.sum (fun i : ι => μ.restrict (q ⁻¹' ({i} : Set ι)))) :=
        congrArg (Measure.map (fun ω => (X ω, Y (q ω) ω))) hμ
      _ = Measure.sum (fun i : ι =>
          Measure.map (fun ω => (X ω, Y (q ω) ω)) (μ.restrict (q ⁻¹' ({i} : Set ι)))) := by
        apply Measure.map_sum
        rw [← hμ]
        exact hF
  have hmap_fiber (i : ι) :
      Measure.map (fun ω => (X ω, Y (q ω) ω)) (μ.restrict (q ⁻¹' ({i} : Set ι))) =
        Measure.map (fun ω => (X ω, Y i ω)) (μ.restrict (q ⁻¹' ({i} : Set ι))) := by
    apply Measure.map_congr
    apply ae_restrict_of_forall_mem (hq_fiber i)
    intro ω hω
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hω
    change (X ω, Y (q ω) ω) = (X ω, Y i ω)
    rw [hω]
  have hqX_ae (i : ι) :
      ∀ᵐ x ∂Measure.map X (μ.restrict (q ⁻¹' ({i} : Set ι))), qX x = i := by
    rw [ae_map_iff hX.aemeasurable]
    · apply ae_restrict_of_forall_mem (hq_fiber i)
      intro ω hω
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hω
      simpa only [hq_eq, Function.comp_apply] using hω
    · exact hqX (measurableSet_singleton i)
  have hcomp_fiber (i : ι) :
      Measure.map X (μ.restrict (q ⁻¹' ({i} : Set ι))) ⊗ₘ Kernel.const β (κ i) =
        Measure.map X (μ.restrict (q ⁻¹' ({i} : Set ι))) ⊗ₘ K := by
    apply Measure.compProd_congr
    filter_upwards [hqX_ae i] with x hx
    simp only [Kernel.const_apply]
    rw [hK x, hx]
  have hmapX_sum :
      Measure.map X μ =
        Measure.sum (fun i : ι => Measure.map X (μ.restrict (q ⁻¹' ({i} : Set ι)))) := by
    calc
      Measure.map X μ =
          Measure.map X (Measure.sum (fun i : ι => μ.restrict (q ⁻¹' ({i} : Set ι)))) :=
        congrArg (Measure.map X) hμ
      _ = Measure.sum (fun i : ι => Measure.map X (μ.restrict (q ⁻¹' ({i} : Set ι)))) := by
        apply Measure.map_sum
        rw [← hμ]
        exact hX.aemeasurable
  calc
    Measure.map (fun ω ↦ (X ω, Y (q ω) ω)) μ =
        Measure.sum (fun i : ι =>
          Measure.map (fun ω => (X ω, Y (q ω) ω)) (μ.restrict (q ⁻¹' ({i} : Set ι)))) := hmap_sum
    _ = Measure.sum (fun i : ι =>
          Measure.map (fun ω => (X ω, Y i ω)) (μ.restrict (q ⁻¹' ({i} : Set ι)))) := by
      apply congrArg Measure.sum
      funext i
      exact hmap_fiber i
    _ = Measure.sum (fun i : ι =>
          Measure.map X (μ.restrict (q ⁻¹' ({i} : Set ι))) ⊗ₘ Kernel.const β (κ i)) := by
      apply congrArg Measure.sum
      funext i
      exact hfiber i
    _ = Measure.sum (fun i : ι =>
          Measure.map X (μ.restrict (q ⁻¹' ({i} : Set ι))) ⊗ₘ K) := by
      apply congrArg Measure.sum
      funext i
      exact hcomp_fiber i
    _ = Measure.sum (fun i : ι => Measure.map X (μ.restrict (q ⁻¹' ({i} : Set ι)))) ⊗ₘ K :=
      Measure.compProd_sum_left.symm
    _ = Measure.map X μ ⊗ₘ K := by rw [← hmapX_sum]

theorem pullCount_add_one_eq_hist{α R : Type*} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {mR : MeasurableSpace R}
    [Nonempty α] [StandardBorelSpace α] [DecidableEq α] [Countable α]
    [StandardBorelSpace R] [Nonempty R] (alg : Algorithm α R)
    (ω : probSpace α R) (n : ℕ) (a : α) :
    pullCount (action alg) a (n + 1) ω = pullCount' n (hist alg ω n) a := by
  rw [pullCount_add_one_eq_pullCount' (R' := reward alg)]
  have hpath : (fun i : Iic n ↦ (action alg i ω, reward alg i ω)) = hist alg ω n := by
    simpa only [action, reward, Prod.eta] using (hist_eq alg ω n).symm
  exact congrArg (fun h ↦ pullCount' n h a) hpath

theorem fresh_reward_fiber_map{α R : Type*} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {mR : MeasurableSpace R}
    [Nonempty α] [StandardBorelSpace α] [DecidableEq α] [Countable α]
    [StandardBorelSpace R] [Nonempty R]
    (alg : Algorithm α R) (ν : Kernel α R) [IsMarkovKernel ν]
    (n m : ℕ) (a : α) :
    let X : probSpace α R → ((Iic n → α × R) × α) :=
      fun ω ↦ (hist alg ω n, action alg (n + 1) ω)
    let q : probSpace α R → ℕ × α :=
      fun ω ↦ (pullCount (action alg) (action alg (n + 1) ω) (n + 1) ω,
        action alg (n + 1) ω)
    Measure.map (fun ω ↦ (X ω, ω.2 m a))
        ((arrayMeasure ν).restrict (q ⁻¹' {(m, a)})) =
      Measure.map X ((arrayMeasure ν).restrict (q ⁻¹' {(m, a)})) ⊗ₘ
        Kernel.const ((Iic n → α × R) × α) (ν a) := by
  dsimp only
  let X : probSpace α R → ((Iic n → α × R) × α) :=
    fun ω ↦ (hist alg ω n, action alg (n + 1) ω)
  let F : probSpace α R → probSpace α R := maskReward m a
  let Z : probSpace α R → R := fun ω ↦ ω.2 m a
  let U : probSpace α R → ((Iic n → α × R) × α) := X ∘ F
  let q : probSpace α R → ℕ × α :=
    fun ω ↦ (pullCount (action alg) (action alg (n + 1) ω) (n + 1) ω,
      action alg (n + 1) ω)
  let S : Set ((Iic n → α × R) × α) :=
    {x | x.2 = a ∧ pullCount' n x.1 a = m}
  have hX : Measurable X := by
    dsimp [X]
    fun_prop
  have hF : Measurable F := by
    exact measurable_maskReward (R := R) m a
  have h_indep : IndepFun U Z (arrayMeasure ν) := by
    have h := (indepFun_maskReward_eval ν m a).comp
      (φ := X) (ψ := id) hX measurable_id
    simpa only [U, F, Z, Function.comp_def, id_eq] using h
  have hU : Measurable U := hX.comp hF
  have hZ : Measurable Z := by
    simp only [Z]
    fun_prop
  have hS : MeasurableSet S := by
    exact ((measurableSet_singleton a).preimage measurable_snd).inter
      ((measurableSet_singleton m).preimage
        ((measurable_pullCount' n a).comp measurable_fst))
  have h_fiber : q ⁻¹' {(m, a)} = U ⁻¹' S := by
    ext ω
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff, q, U, S, X, F, Function.comp_apply,
      Prod.mk.injEq, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hc, ha⟩
      have horig : action alg (n + 1) ω = a ∧
          pullCount (action alg) a (n + 1) ω = m := by
        exact ⟨ha, by simpa only [ha] using hc⟩
      have hmask := (selectedFiber_maskReward_iff alg ω n m a).2 horig
      refine ⟨hmask.1, ?_⟩
      rw [← pullCount_add_one_eq_hist alg (maskReward m a ω) n a]
      exact hmask.2
    · rintro ⟨hact, hpc⟩
      have hmask : action alg (n + 1) (maskReward m a ω) = a ∧
          pullCount (action alg) a (n + 1) (maskReward m a ω) = m := by
        refine ⟨hact, ?_⟩
        rw [pullCount_add_one_eq_hist alg (maskReward m a ω) n a]
        exact hpc
      have horig := (selectedFiber_maskReward_iff alg ω n m a).1 hmask
      exact ⟨by simpa only [horig.1] using horig.2, horig.1⟩
  have hbase := map_restrict_preimage_of_indepFun h_indep hU hZ S hS
  rw [← h_fiber] at hbase
  rw [show Measure.map Z (arrayMeasure ν) = ν a by
    simpa only [Z] using map_snd_apply_arrayMeasure (ν := ν) m a] at hbase
  rw [← Measure.compProd_const] at hbase
  let E : Set (probSpace α R) := q ⁻¹' {(m, a)}
  have hE : MeasurableSet E := by
    rw [show E = q ⁻¹' {(m, a)} by rfl, h_fiber]
    exact hS.preimage hU
  have hUX : U =ᵐ[(arrayMeasure ν).restrict E] X := by
    refine ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hE ?_
    intro ω hω
    have hqa : q ω = (m, a) := by
      simpa only [E, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hω
    have hcount : pullCount (action alg) (action alg (n + 1) ω) (n + 1) ω = m := by
      simpa only [q] using congrArg Prod.fst hqa
    have hact : action alg (n + 1) ω = a := by
      simpa only [q] using congrArg Prod.snd hqa
    have hcounta : pullCount (action alg) a (n + 1) ω = m := by
      simpa only [hact] using hcount
    have hhist := hist_maskReward_of_pullCount_le alg ω n m a (le_of_eq hcounta)
    have hp := action_pullCount_eq_of_hist_eq alg n hhist (by rfl)
    change X (F ω) = X ω
    simp only [X, F]
    exact Prod.ext hhist hp.1
  have hpair : (fun ω ↦ (U ω, Z ω)) =ᵐ[(arrayMeasure ν).restrict E]
      (fun ω ↦ (X ω, Z ω)) := by

theorem isAddFundamentalDomain_of_quotient_bijOn{G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [MeasurableSpace G]

    rw [hsurj]
    exact Set.mem_univ _
  rcases hx with ⟨r, hrF, hrx⟩
  have hxr : QuotientAddGroup.mk' L x = QuotientAddGroup.mk' L r := hrx.symm
  rcases (QuotientAddGroup.mk'_eq_mk' L).mp hxr with ⟨z, hzL, hxzr⟩
  let l : L := ⟨z, hzL⟩
  have hlx : l +ᵥ x = r := by
    simpa only [AddSubgroup.vadd_def, vadd_eq_add, add_comm] using hxzr
  refine ⟨l, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [hlx] using hrF
  · intro l' hl'F
    apply Subtype.ext
    have hq_lx : QuotientAddGroup.mk' L (l +ᵥ x) = QuotientAddGroup.mk' L x := by
      simp only [AddSubgroup.vadd_def, vadd_eq_add]
      simpa only [add_comm] using QuotientAddGroup.mk_add_of_mem x l.property
    have hq_l'x : QuotientAddGroup.mk' L (l' +ᵥ x) = QuotientAddGroup.mk' L x := by
      simp only [AddSubgroup.vadd_def, vadd_eq_add]
      simpa only [add_comm] using QuotientAddGroup.mk_add_of_mem x l'.property
    have heq : l' +ᵥ x = l +ᵥ x := hinj hl'F (by simpa only [hlx] using hrF) (hq_l'x.trans hq_lx.symm)
    simpa only [AddSubgroup.vadd_def, vadd_eq_add, add_right_cancel_iff] using heq

theorem fundamentalDomain_of_finite_compact_quotient_sections{G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalAddGroup G]

    intro z

    rcases Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxpre with ⟨hji, hxpre⟩
    rw [hqx] at hxpre

theorem exists_finite_add_fundamentalDomain_of_compact_quotient{G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalAddGroup G]
    [LocallyCompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [MeasurableSpace G] [BorelSpace G]
    (L : AddSubgroup G) [Countable L] [DiscreteTopology L]
    [CompactSpace (G ⧸ L)] :
    ∃ F : Set G,
      MeasureTheory.IsAddFundamentalDomain L F MeasureTheory.Measure.addHaar ∧
      MeasureTheory.Measure.addHaar F ≠ ⊤ := by
  classical
  letI : IsClosed (L : Set G) := AddSubgroup.isClosed_of_discrete
  letI : T2Space (G ⧸ L) := inferInstance
  obtain ⟨n, K, hK, hinj, hcover⟩ := exists_finite_compact_quotient_sections L
  exact fundamentalDomain_of_finite_compact_quotient_sections L n K hK hinj hcover

theorem noncompact_of_infinite_discrete_addSubgroup{G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalAddGroup G]

theorem exists_compact_addHaar_measure_gt{G : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [TopologicalSpace G] [IsTopologicalAddGroup G]

  exact ⟨E, hE, hcE⟩

theorem heightOneSupport_finite_maximalSpectrum{A : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
  {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M]
  (hMT : Module.IsTorsion A M)
  {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module A N] [Module.Finite A N]
  (hNT : Module.IsTorsion A N) :

    {p : PrimeSpectrum A | p.asIdeal.primeHeight = 1}

  dsimp only
  intro hsigma

    (Module.support A M ∪ Module.support A N) ∩
      {p : PrimeSpectrum A | p.asIdeal.primeHeight = 1} with hsigma_def

  have hfin : sigma.Finite := by
    unfold sigma
    rw [Set.union_inter_distrib_right]
    exact (hMT.finite_primeHeight_one_support).union hNT.finite_primeHeight_one_support
  refine @Finite.of_injective _ _ ?_ _ MaximalSpectrum.toPrimeSpectrum_injective
  refine @Finite.of_injective_finite_range _ _ _
    (PrimeSpectrum.localization_comap_injective (Localization S) S) (Set.Finite.to_subtype ?_)
  rw [PrimeSpectrum.localization_comap_range (Localization S) S]
  refine (hfin.union (PrimeSpectrum.finite_setOf_isMin A)).subset ?_
  intro q hq
  simp_rw [hS_def, Submonoid.coe_iInf, ← le_compl_iff_disjoint_left,
    Set.compl_iInter, Set.le_eq_subset] at hq
  change (q.asIdeal : Set A) ⊆ ⋃ p ∈ sigma, (p.asIdealᶜᶜ : Set A) at hq

  rw [← hfin.coe_toFinset,
    Ideal.subset_union_prime hsigma.some hsigma.some fun p _ _ _ ↦ p.isPrime] at hq
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hle⟩ := hq
  have hp' : p ∈ sigma := by simpa using hp
  rw [hsigma_def] at hp'
  by_cases heq : q = p
  · left
    simpa [heq] using hp'
  · right
    change IsMin q
    rw [PrimeSpectrum.isMin_iff, ← Ideal.primeHeight_eq_zero_iff]
    have hne : q.asIdeal ≠ p.asIdeal := by
      intro h
      apply heq

    have hlt : q.asIdeal < p.asIdeal := lt_of_le_of_ne hle hne
    haveI := Ideal.finiteHeight_of_isNoetherianRing p.asIdeal

  (f : M →ₗ[A] N) (P : PrimeSpectrum (Localization S))

    have hexP : Function.Exact
        (LocalizedModule.map P.asIdeal.primeCompl

        (LocalizedModule.map P.asIdeal.primeCompl (LocalizedModule.map S f)) :=
      LocalizedModule.map_exact P.asIdeal.primeCompl _ _ hexS
    rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, LinearMap.exact_iff.mp hexP]
    apply le_antisymm
    · rintro y ⟨x, rfl⟩
      have hx : x = 0 := @Subsingleton.elim _ hkiter x 0
      simp only [hx, map_zero, Submodule.zero_mem]
    · exact bot_le
  · have hqcoker : Subsingleton
        (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl N ⧸
          LinearMap.range (LocalizedModule.map q.asIdeal.primeCompl f)) := by
      rw [Submodule.Quotient.subsingleton_iff]
      exact LinearMap.range_eq_top_of_surjective _ h.2

        (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl (N ⧸ LinearMap.range f)) :=
      (LinearMap.subsingleton_coker_convert f q.asIdeal.primeCompl).1 hqcoker

        (LocalizedModule P.asIdeal.primeCompl

    have hexS : Function.Exact

      LocalizedModule.map_exact P.asIdeal.primeCompl _ _ hexS
    rw [← LinearMap.range_eq_top, ← LinearMap.exact_iff.mp hexP]
    apply top_unique
    intro x hx

theorem heightOneSupport_local_equiv_at_maximal{A : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]

    Nonempty
      (LocalizedModule P.asIdeal.primeCompl (LocalizedModule S M) ≃ₗ[Localization P.asIdeal.primeCompl]
        LocalizedModule P.asIdeal.primeCompl (LocalizedModule S N)) := by
  let sigma := (Module.support A M ∪ Module.support A N) ∩
    {p : PrimeSpectrum A | p.asIdeal.primeHeight = 1}
  let S := ⨅ p ∈ sigma, p.asIdeal.primeCompl
  change ∀ P : MaximalSpectrum (Localization S),
    Nonempty
      (LocalizedModule P.asIdeal.primeCompl (LocalizedModule S M) ≃ₗ[Localization P.asIdeal.primeCompl]
        LocalizedModule P.asIdeal.primeCompl (LocalizedModule S N))
  intro P
  let q : PrimeSpectrum A :=
    PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A (Localization S)) P.toPrimeSpectrum
  have hsigma : sigma.Finite := by
    unfold sigma
    rw [Set.union_inter_distrib_right]
    exact (Module.IsTorsion.finite_primeHeight_one_support hMT).union
      (Module.IsTorsion.finite_primeHeight_one_support hNT)
  have hqdisj : Disjoint (S : Set A) (q.asIdeal : Set A) := by
    have hmem : q ∈ Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A (Localization S))) := by
      exact ⟨P.toPrimeSpectrum, rfl⟩
    rw [PrimeSpectrum.localization_comap_range (Localization S) S] at hmem
    exact hmem
  have hqsub : (q.asIdeal : Set A) ⊆ ⋃ p ∈ sigma, (p.asIdeal : Set A) := by
    intro x hxq
    by_contra hx
    have hxS : x ∈ S := by
      simp only [S, Submonoid.mem_iInf]
      simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, SetLike.mem_coe, exists_prop, not_exists, not_and] at hx
      intro p hp
      exact hx p hp
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hqdisj hxS hxq
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hqp⟩ :=
    (Ideal.subset_union_prime_finite hsigma q q
      (fun i _ _ _ ↦ i.isPrime)).mp hqsub

  have hqheight : q.asIdeal.primeHeight ≤ 1 := by
    rw [← hpheight]
    exact Ideal.primeHeight_mono hqp
  rw [Decidable.le_iff_eq_or_lt, ENat.lt_one_iff_eq_zero] at hqheight
  have eq_qp_of_height_one (hqheight : q.asIdeal.primeHeight = 1) : q = p := by
    haveI : p.asIdeal.FiniteHeight := p.asIdeal.finiteHeight_iff.2 <| Or.inr <| by
      rw [Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight, hpheight]
      nofun
    have hmem := mem_minimalPrimes_of_primeHeight_eq_height hqp (by
      rw [Ideal.height_eq_primeHeight, hpheight, hqheight])
    rw [Ideal.minimalPrimes_eq_subsingleton_self, Set.mem_singleton_iff,
      ← PrimeSpectrum.ext_iff] at hmem
    exact hmem.symm
  have e_q : Nonempty
      (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl M ≃ₗ[Localization q.asIdeal.primeCompl]
        LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl N) := by
    rcases hqheight with hqheight | hqheight
    · rw [eq_qp_of_height_one hqheight]
      exact H p hpheight
    · have hqmin : q.asIdeal ∈ minimalPrimes A :=
        Ideal.primeHeight_eq_zero_iff.mp hqheight
      have hdisj := Ideal.disjoint_nonZeroDivisors_of_mem_minimalPrimes hqmin
      have hMsub : Subsingleton (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl M) := by
        rw [LocalizedModule.subsingleton_iff]
        intro m
        obtain ⟨⟨s, hsne⟩, hs⟩ := @hMT m
        use s
        refine ⟨?_, by simpa using hs⟩
        change s ∉ q.asIdeal
        intro hsq
        exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj hsq hsne
      have hNsub : Subsingleton (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl N) := by
        rw [LocalizedModule.subsingleton_iff]
        intro n
        obtain ⟨⟨s, hsne⟩, hs⟩ := @hNT n
        use s
        refine ⟨?_, by simpa using hs⟩
        change s ∉ q.asIdeal
        intro hsq
        exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj hsq hsne
      letI := hMsub
      letI := hNsub
      refine ⟨LinearEquiv.ofBijective (0 :
        LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl M →ₗ[Localization q.asIdeal.primeCompl]
          LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl N) ?_⟩
      constructor
      · intro x y _
        exact Subsingleton.elim x y
      · intro y
        exact ⟨0, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := exists_map_bijective_after_localization q.asIdeal.primeCompl e_q
  have hf_iter : Function.Bijective
      (LocalizedModule.map P.asIdeal.primeCompl (LocalizedModule.map S f)) := by
    apply iterated_localized_map_bijective_of_comap S f P.toPrimeSpectrum
    simpa only [q] using hf
  exact ⟨LinearEquiv.ofBijective
    (LocalizedModule.map P.asIdeal.primeCompl (LocalizedModule.map S f)) hf_iter⟩

  (q : Localization (⨅ p ∈ sigma, p.asIdeal.primeCompl)) (hq : Irreducible q) :

theorem exists_isLocalizedModule_quotient_comap_span_pow{A : Type*} [CommRing A] (S : Submonoid A)
  (q : Localization S) (n : ℕ) :

      (Algebra.linearMap A (Localization S)) = Ideal.span {q ^ n} := by

    rw [Ideal.map_pow]
    rw [IsLocalization.map_comap S (Localization S) (Ideal.span {q})]

    (Algebra.linearMap A (Localization S))

    ((P ^ n).localized' (Localization S) S (Algebra.linearMap A (Localization S)))
    (Ideal.span {q ^ n}) hI

theorem primeSpectrum_comap_span_irreducible_mem_sigma{A : Type*} [CommRing A] (sigma : Set (PrimeSpectrum A))
  (hsigma : sigma ⊆ {p : PrimeSpectrum A | p.asIdeal.primeHeight = 1})
  (hn : sigma.Nonempty) (hfin : sigma.Finite)
  [IsDomain (Localization (⨅ p ∈ sigma, p.asIdeal.primeCompl))]

  PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A (Localization (⨅ p ∈ sigma, p.asIdeal.primeCompl))) Q ∈ sigma := by
  dsimp only
  let S : Submonoid A := ⨅ p ∈ sigma, p.asIdeal.primeCompl
  let R := Localization S
  let Q : PrimeSpectrum R :=
    ⟨Ideal.span {q}, (PrincipalIdealRing.isMaximal_of_irreducible hq).isPrime⟩

  have hPheight : P.asIdeal.primeHeight = 1 := by
    simpa only [S, R, Q, P] using
      (primeHeight_comap_span_irreducible_localization_eq_one sigma hsigma hn hfin q hq)

    change Disjoint (S : Set A)

    intro a ha
    by_contra hmem
    have haS : a ∈ S := by
      simp only [S, Submonoid.mem_iInf, Ideal.mem_primeCompl_iff]
      intro p hp hap
      apply hmem
      exact Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem p (Set.mem_iUnion_of_mem hp hap)
    exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hdisj haS ha
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hle⟩ :=
    (Ideal.subset_union_prime_finite hfin hn.some hn.some
      (fun i hi _ _ => i.isPrime)).1 hsub
  have hEq : P = r := by
    apply PrimeSpectrum.ext
    apply le_antisymm hle
    by_contra hnot
    have hlt : P.asIdeal < r.asIdeal := lt_of_le_not_le hle hnot
    have hh := Ideal.primeHeight_add_one_le_of_lt hlt
    rw [hPheight, hsigma hr] at hh
    norm_num at hh
  simpa only [P, Q, R, S, hEq] using hr

theorem pi_prime_power_quotients_isTorsion{A : Type*} [CommRing A] {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M]
  [Module.Finite A M] (hM : Module.IsTorsion A M)
  {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (p : ι → PrimeSpectrum A)
  (hpM : ∀ i, p i ∈ Module.support A M) (e : ι → ℕ) (he : ∀ i, 0 < e i) :

  classical
  obtain ⟨a, ha_ann, ha_nzd⟩ := Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr
    (Submodule.annihilator_top_inter_nonZeroDivisors hM)
  have ha_ann' : a ∈ Module.annihilator A M := by
    simpa only [Submodule.annihilator_top] using ha_ann
  have hap : ∀ i, a ∈ (p i).asIdeal := fun i ↦
    Module.annihilator_le_of_mem_support (hpM i) ha_ann'
  let J : Ideal A := ∏ i : ι, (p i).asIdeal ^ e i
  let d : A := ∏ i : ι, a ^ e i
  have hdJ : d ∈ J := by
    apply Ideal.prod_mem_prod
    intro i hi
    exact Ideal.pow_mem_pow (hap i) (e i)
  have hJann : J ≤ Module.annihilator A ((i : ι) → A ⧸ (p i).asIdeal ^ e i) := by
    rw [Module.annihilator_pi]
    refine le_iInf fun i ↦ ?_
    rw [Ideal.annihilator_quotient]
    exact le_trans Ideal.prod_le_inf (Finset.inf_le (Finset.mem_univ i))
  have hd_ann := hJann hdJ
  have hd_nzd : d ∈ nonZeroDivisors A := by
    apply Submonoid.prod_mem
    intro i hi
    exact Submonoid.pow_mem _ ha_nzd (e i)
  intro x
  exact ⟨⟨d, hd_nzd⟩, Module.mem_annihilator.mp hd_ann x⟩

theorem heightOneSupport_pi_prime_power_quotients_subset_range{A : Type*} [CommRing A] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]

  (e : ι → ℕ) (he : ∀ i, 0 < e i) :
  (Module.support A ((i : ι) → A ⧸ (p i).asIdeal ^ e i) ∩
      {r : PrimeSpectrum A | r.asIdeal.primeHeight = 1}) ⊆ Set.range p := by
  classical
  rintro r ⟨hrSupp, hrHeight⟩
  let J : Ideal A := ∏ i : ι, (p i).asIdeal ^ e i
  have hJann : J ≤ Module.annihilator A ((i : ι) → A ⧸ (p i).asIdeal ^ e i) := by
    rw [Module.annihilator_pi]
    refine le_iInf fun i ↦ ?_
    rw [Ideal.annihilator_quotient]
    exact le_trans Ideal.prod_le_inf (Finset.inf_le (Finset.mem_univ i))
  have hJr : J ≤ r.asIdeal :=
    hJann.trans (Module.annihilator_le_of_mem_support hrSupp)
  obtain ⟨i, hiuniv, hi⟩ := (Ideal.IsPrime.prod_le r.isPrime).1 (by simpa [J] using hJr)
  have hle : (p i).asIdeal ≤ r.asIdeal :=
    (Ideal.IsPrime.pow_le_iff (Nat.ne_of_gt (he i))).1 hi
  have hideal : (p i).asIdeal = r.asIdeal := by
    apply le_antisymm hle
    by_contra hnot
    have hlt : (p i).asIdeal < r.asIdeal := lt_of_le_not_le hle hnot
    have hh := Ideal.primeHeight_add_one_le_of_lt hlt
    rw [hpheight i, hrHeight] at hh
    norm_num at hh
  have hpr : p i = r := PrimeSpectrum.ext hideal
  exact ⟨i, hpr⟩

        Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.Const.mergeWith!
          affineCoeffAdd x.inner.inner y.inner.inner := by
    simpa only [affineCoeffAdd] using
      treeMap_foldl_alter_inner_eq_mergeWithBang p x y
  unfold Std.TreeMap.toList Std.DTreeMap.Const.toList
  exact congrArg Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.Const.toList
    (hleft.trans hright.symm)

theorem affineMapEval_alter_add(p : ℕ) (m : Std.TreeMap String (ZMod p)) (k : String) (v : ZMod p)
  (env : String → ZMod p) :
  affineMapEval (m.alter k (fun
    | none => some v
    | some u => some (u + v))) env =
    affineMapEval m env + v * env k := by
  let f : Option (ZMod p) → Option (ZMod p) := fun
    | none => some v
    | some u => some (u + v)
  let weight : ((_ : String) × ZMod p) → ZMod p := fun q => q.2 * env q.1
  have list_lemma : ∀ l : List ((_ : String) × ZMod p),
      List.sum (List.map weight (Std.Internal.List.Const.alterKey k f l)) =
        List.sum (List.map weight l) + v * env k := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil =>
        simp [Std.Internal.List.Const.alterKey, f, weight]
    | cons q l ih =>
        rcases q with ⟨k', u⟩
        have hp := Std.Internal.List.Const.alterKey_cons_perm
          (k := k) (f := f) (k' := k') (v' := u) (l := l)
        have hs := (hp.map weight).sum_eq
        rw [hs]
        by_cases h : k' == k
        · have hk : k' = k := eq_of_beq h
          subst k'
          simp [h, f, weight]
          ring
        · simp [h, ih, f, weight]
          ring
  have fold_eq_sum (l : List ((_ : String) × ZMod p)) :
      l.foldl (fun acc q => acc + weight q) 0 = List.sum (List.map weight l) := by
    rw [List.sum_eq_foldl]
    rw [List.foldl_map]
  have hperm : (m.alter k f).inner.inner.toListModel.Perm
      (Std.Internal.List.Const.alterKey k f m.inner.inner.toListModel) := by
    unfold Std.TreeMap.alter Std.DTreeMap.Const.alter
    exact Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.Const.toListModel_alter
      m.inner.wf.balanced m.inner.wf.ordered
  have hsumperm :
      List.sum (List.map weight (m.alter k f).inner.inner.toListModel) =
        List.sum (List.map weight
          (Std.Internal.List.Const.alterKey k f m.inner.inner.toListModel)) :=
    (hperm.map weight).sum_eq
  change (m.alter k f).inner.inner.foldl
      (fun acc k v => acc + v * env k) 0 =
    m.inner.inner.foldl (fun acc k v => acc + v * env k) 0 + v * env k
  rw [Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.foldl_eq_foldl,
    Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.foldl_eq_foldl]
  change (m.alter k f).inner.inner.toListModel.foldl
      (fun acc q => acc + weight q) 0 =
    m.inner.inner.toListModel.foldl (fun acc q => acc + weight q) 0 + v * env k
  rw [fold_eq_sum, fold_eq_sum, hsumperm, list_lemma]

theorem affineMapEval_merge_add(p : ℕ) (x y : Std.TreeMap String (ZMod p)) (env : String → ZMod p) :
  affineMapEval (x.mergeWith (fun _ v1 v2 => v1 + v2) y) env =
    affineMapEval x env + affineMapEval y env := by
  have hmerge :
      affineMapEval (x.mergeWith (fun _ v1 v2 => v1 + v2) y) env =
        affineMapEval (y.foldl (fun acc k v => acc.alter k (fun
          | none => some v
          | some u => some (u + v))) x) env := by
    unfold affineMapEval
    exact (treeMap_merge_add_equiv_foldl_alter p x y).foldl_eq
  rw [hmerge]
  have eval_updates (l : List (String × ZMod p))
      (acc : Std.TreeMap String (ZMod p)) :
      affineMapEval
          (l.foldl (fun acc kv => acc.alter kv.1 (fun
            | none => some kv.2
            | some u => some (u + kv.2))) acc) env =
        l.foldl (fun z kv => z + kv.2 * env kv.1) (affineMapEval acc env) := by
    induction l generalizing acc with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons kv l ih =>
      rcases kv with ⟨k, v⟩
      simp only [List.foldl_cons]
      rw [ih, affineMapEval_alter_add]
  have foldl_add (l : List (String × ZMod p)) (a b : ZMod p) :
      l.foldl (fun z kv => z + kv.2 * env kv.1) (a + b) =
        a + l.foldl (fun z kv => z + kv.2 * env kv.1) b := by
    induction l generalizing b with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons kv l ih =>
      rcases kv with ⟨k, v⟩
      simp only [List.foldl_cons]
      rw [add_assoc, ih]
  rw [Std.TreeMap.foldl_eq_foldl_toList, eval_updates]
  unfold affineMapEval
  repeat' rw [Std.TreeMap.foldl_eq_foldl_toList]
  simpa only [add_zero] using foldl_add y.toList
    (List.foldl (fun a b => a + b.2 * env b.1) 0 x.toList) 0

theorem affine_eval_add(p : ℕ) (x y : AffineExpression p) (env : String → ZMod p) :
  (x + y).eval env = x.eval env + y.eval env := by
  change (x.offset + y.offset) +
      affineMapEval ((x.affine.mergeWith (fun _ v1 v2 => v1 + v2) y.affine).filter (fun _ v => v ≠ 0)) env =
    (x.offset + affineMapEval x.affine env) + (y.offset + affineMapEval y.affine env)
  rw [affineMapEval_filter_ne_zero, affineMapEval_merge_add]
  ring

theorem affine_eval_mul_by_number(p : ℕ) (x : AffineExpression p) (n : ZMod p) (env : String → ZMod p) :
  (mul_by_number x n).eval env = n * x.eval env := by
  unfold mul_by_number AffineExpression.eval
  change n * x.offset + affineMapEval (Std.TreeMap.filter (fun _ v => v ≠ 0) (Std.TreeMap.map (fun _ v => n * v) x.affine)) env =
    n * (x.offset + affineMapEval x.affine env)
  rw [affineMapEval_filter_ne_zero, affineMapEval_map_mul]
  ring

theorem affine_toConstant_eval(p : ℕ) (x : AffineExpression p) (n : ZMod p) (env : String → ZMod p) :
  x.toConstant? = some n → x.eval env = n := by
  unfold AffineExpression.toConstant?
  split
  next hEmpty =>
    intro h
    have hn : x.offset = n := Option.some.inj h
    unfold AffineExpression.eval
    rw [Std.TreeMap.foldl_eq_foldl_toList]
    have hlistEmpty : x.affine.toList.isEmpty = true := by
      rw [Std.TreeMap.isEmpty_toList]
      exact hEmpty
    have hnil : x.affine.toList = [] := by
      cases hlist : x.affine.toList with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons a l =>
        rw [hlist] at hlistEmpty
        contradiction
    rw [hnil]
    simp only [List.foldl_nil, add_zero, hn]
  next hNotEmpty =>
    intro h
    contradiction

theorem affine_mul_eval(p : ℕ) (x y z : AffineExpression p) (env : String → ZMod p) :
  some z = mul? x y → z.eval env = x.eval env * y.eval env := by
  intro h
  unfold mul? at h
  cases hx : x.toConstant? with
  | none =>
      cases hy : y.toConstant? with
      | none =>
          simp only [hx, hy] at h
          cases h
      | some n =>
          simp only [hx, hy] at h
          injection h with hz
          subst z
          rw [affine_eval_mul_by_number, affine_toConstant_eval p y n env hy]
          exact mul_comm n (x.eval env)
  | some n =>
      simp only [hx] at h
      injection h with hz
      subst z
      rw [affine_eval_mul_by_number, affine_toConstant_eval p x n env hx]

theorem treeMap_listFold_alter_inner_eq(p : ℕ) (l : List (String × ZMod p))
  (x : Std.TreeMap String (ZMod p)) :
  (l.foldl (fun acc kv => acc.alter kv.1 (fun
    | none => some kv.2
    | some u => some (u + kv.2))) x).inner.inner =
  l.foldl (fun acc kv =>
    Std.DTreeMap.Internal.Impl.Const.alter! kv.1 (fun
      | none => some kv.2
      | some u => some (u + kv.2)) acc) x.inner.inner := by
  induction l generalizing x with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons kv l ih =>
    rcases kv with ⟨k, v⟩
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    rw [ih]
    rw [treeMap_alter_inner_eq_alterBang]

theorem sorrydb_487083a0bf23b66f(p : ℕ) (e : Expression p) (ae : AffineExpression p) :
  some ae = AffineExpression.ofExpression? e → ae.eval = e.eval := by
  intro h
  induction e generalizing ae with
  | const n =>
      simp only [AffineExpression.ofExpression?] at h
      cases h
      funext env
      change n + 0 = n
      exact add_zero n
  | var x =>
      simp only [AffineExpression.ofExpression?] at h
      cases h
      funext env
      change 0 + (0 + 1 * env x) = env x
      simp only [zero_add, one_mul]
  | add e1 e2 ih1 ih2 =>
      simp only [AffineExpression.ofExpression?] at h
      cases h1 : AffineExpression.ofExpression? e1 with
      | none =>
          simp only [h1] at h
          contradiction
      | some a1 =>
          cases h2 : AffineExpression.ofExpression? e2 with
          | none =>
              simp only [h1, h2] at h
              contradiction
          | some a2 =>
              simp only [h1, h2] at h
              cases h
              funext env
              rw [affine_eval_add p a1 a2 env]
              rw [congrFun (ih1 a1 h1.symm) env, congrFun (ih2 a2 h2.symm) env]
              rfl
  | mul e1 e2 ih1 ih2 =>
      simp only [AffineExpression.ofExpression?] at h
      cases h1 : AffineExpression.ofExpression? e1 with
      | none =>
          simp only [h1] at h
          contradiction
      | some a1 =>
          cases h2 : AffineExpression.ofExpression? e2 with
          | none =>
              simp only [h1, h2] at h
              contradiction
          | some a2 =>
              simp only [h1, h2] at h
              funext env
              rw [affine_mul_eval p a1 a2 ae env h]
              rw [congrFun (ih1 a1 h1.symm) env, congrFun (ih2 a2 h2.symm) env]
              rfl
